磁盘记录帧格式与整段扫描器。\n//!\n//! # 帧格式（小端序）\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! ┌──────────┬───────────┬──────────────┬───────────────┬──────────┐\n//! │ magic 4B │ seq u64LE │ payload_len  │ payload N B   │ crc u32  │\n//! │ b\"SLOG\"  │  (8 B)    │ u32LE (4 B)  │               │ LE (4 B) │\n//! └──────────┴───────────┴──────────────┴───────────────┴────────────\n//!  \\________________ CRC-32 覆盖区（16 B 头 + payload）______________/\n//! ```\n//!\n//! - `magic`：标识本日志帧（4 字节 `SLOG`），防止把其它文件误当成本日志。\n//! - `seq`：从 0 起单调递增、连续无缺号的记录序号。\n//! - `payload_len`：载荷字节数，上限 [`MAX_PAYLOAD_LEN`]。\n//! - `crc`：IEEE CRC-32，覆盖 magic + seq + payload_len + payload。\n//!\n//! 一“段”（segment）就是若干帧首尾相接的文件。扫描段时只有两种结束方式：\n//! 在帧边界恰好结束（完整段），或最后一帧只写了一部分（仅允许出现在最后一段，\n//! 由恢复逻辑丢弃该不完整尾部）。完整帧但 magic/CRC/长度/序号错误一律是损坏，\n//! 由调用方决定报错。\n\nuse crate::crc32;\n\n/// 帧魔数。\npub const MAGIC: [u8; 4] = *b\"SLOG\";\n/// 固定头长度：magic 4 + seq 8 + len 4。\npub const HEADER_LEN: usize = 16;\n/// CRC 尾长度。\npub const CRC_LEN: usize = 4;\n/// 载荷上限 16 MiB。\npub const MAX_PAYLOAD_LEN: u32 = 16 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n/// 把一条记录封装成帧字节。\npub fn encode_frame(seq: u64, payload: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    assert!(\n        payload.len() as u64 <= MAX_PAYLOAD_LEN as u64,\n        \"payload too large\"\n    );\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(HEADER_LEN + payload.len() + CRC_LEN);\n    buf.extend_from_slice(&MAGIC);\n    buf.extend_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());\n    buf.extend_from_slice(&(payload.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());\n    buf.extend_from_slice(payload);\n    let crc = crc32::checksum(&buf);\n    buf.extend_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());\n    buf\n}\n\n/// 扫描出的一条已验证记录。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Record {\n    pub seq: u64,\n    /// 帧在段文件中的字节偏移。\n    pub offset: u64,\n    /// 整帧长度（头 + 载荷 + CRC）。\n    pub frame_len: u64,\n    pub payload: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\n/// 一个段文件的扫描结果。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SegmentScan {\n    /// 全部 CRC 通过、序号符合预期的完整记录。\n    pub records: Vec<Record>,\n    /// 已确认有效的连续字节数（尾部丢弃时即截断点）。\n    pub valid_len: u64,\n    /// 被丢弃的不完整尾部字节数（0 表示文件在帧边界整齐结束）。\n    pub torn_tail_len: u64,\n}\n\n/// 段扫描失败 —— 任何一种都属于“损坏”，不允许静默跳过。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum FrameError {\n    /// 完整帧的魔数不是 SLOG。\n    BadMagic { offset: u64, found: [u8; 4] },\n    /// 长度字段超过上限（撕裂写不可能产生这种值）。\n    BadLength { offset: u64, len: u32 },\n    /// 帧的一部分超出文件末尾。\n    ///\n    /// `at_end=true` 表示发生在文件末尾（可能是最后一段的撕裂尾部，\n    /// 由调用方决定是否丢弃）；`false` 表示后面还有数据 —— 必为损坏。\n    TruncatedFrame { offset: u64, at_end: bool },\n    /// 完整帧 CRC 不匹配。\n    CrcMismatch { offset: u64, seq: u64 },\n    /// 序号不连续/不正确。\n    SeqMismatch { offset: u64, expected: u64, got: u64 },\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for FrameError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            FrameError::BadMagic { offset, found } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"corrupt frame at offset {}: bad magic {:02x?}\",\n                offset, found\n            ),\n            FrameError::BadLength { offset, len } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"corrupt frame at offset {}: payload length {} exceeds {}\",\n                offset, len, MAX_PAYLOAD_LEN\n            ),\n            FrameError::TruncatedFrame { offset, at_end } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"corrupt segment at offset {}: truncated frame (at_end={})\",\n                offset, at_end\n            ),\n            FrameError::CrcMismatch { offset, seq } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"corrupt frame at offset {} (seq {}): crc mismatch\",\n                offset, seq\n            ),\n            FrameError::SeqMismatch { offset, expected, got } => write!(\n                f,\n                \"corrupt frame at offset {}: seq expected {}, got {}\",\n                offset, expected, got\n            ),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for FrameError {}\n\n/// 扫描整段字节。\n///\n/// - `data`：段文件完整内容。\n/// - `expect_first_seq`：本段第一条记录应有的序号（用于全局限号连续性检查）。\n///\n/// 撕裂尾部（文件末尾不完整帧）以 `Ok(SegmentScan)` 返回并记录 `torn_tail_len`；\n/// 其它一切异常返回 [`FrameError`]。调用方依据该段是否为最后一段决定撕裂尾部是否合法。\npub fn scan_segment(data: &[u8], expect_first_seq: u64) -> Result<SegmentScan, FrameError> {\n    let mut records = Vec::new();\n    let mut offset = 0usize;\n    let mut expected_seq = expect_first_seq;\n\n    while offset < data.len() {\n        let frame_start = offset;\n\n        // 头不完整\n        if data.len() - offset < HEADER_LEN {\n            return Ok(SegmentScan {\n                records,\n                valid_len: frame_start as u64,\n                torn_tail_len: (data.len() - frame_start) as u64,\n            });\n        }\n\n        let magic: [u8; 4] = data[offset..offset + 4].try_into().unwrap();\n        if magic != MAGIC {\n            return Err(FrameError::BadMagic {\n                offset: frame_start as u64,\n                found: magic,\n            });\n        }\n        let seq = u64::from_le_bytes(data[offset + 4..offset + 12].try_into().unwrap());\n        let payload_len =\n            u32::from_le_bytes(data[offset + 12..offset + HEADER_LEN].try_into().unwrap());\n\n        if payload_len > MAX_PAYLOAD_LEN {\n            return Err(FrameError::BadLength {\n                offset: frame_start as u64,\n                len: payload_len,\n            });\n        }\n\n        let frame_len = HEADER_LEN + payload_len as usize + CRC_LEN;\n        if data.len() - offset < frame_len {\n            // 声明帧超出文件末尾。后面没有数据 => 可能是撕裂尾部；\n            // 注意：后面还有数据时不可能走到这个分支（外层 while 已保证 offset < len）。\n            return Ok(SegmentScan {\n                records,\n                valid_len: frame_start as u64,\n                torn_tail_len: (data.len() - frame_start) as u64,\n            });\n        }\n\n        let covered = &data[offset..offset + HEADER_LEN + payload_len as usize];\n        let crc_stored = u32::from_le_bytes(\n            data[offset + HEADER_LEN + payload_len as usize\n                ..offset + HEADER_LEN + payload_len as usize + CRC_LEN]\n                .try_into()\n                .unwrap(),\n        );\n        if crc32::checksum(covered) != crc_stored {\n            return Err(FrameError::CrcMismatch {\n                offset: frame_start as u64,\n                seq,\n            });\n        }\n\n        if seq != expected_seq {\n            return Err(FrameError::SeqMismatch {\n                offset: frame_start as u64,\n                expected: expected_seq,\n                got: seq,\n            });\n        }\n\n        let payload = data[offset + HEADER_LEN..offset + HEADER_LEN + payload_len as usize].to_vec();\n        records.push(Record {\n            seq,\n            offset: frame_start as u64,\n            frame_len: frame_len as u64,\n            payload,\n        });\n        expected_seq += 1;\n        offset += frame_len;\n    }\n\n    Ok(SegmentScan {\n        records,\n        valid_len: data.len() as u64,\n        torn_tail_len: 0,\n    })\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn mk(n: u64, body: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n        encode_frame(n, body)\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn round_trip_many_frames() {\n        let mut data = Vec::new();\n        for i in 0..10u64 {\n            data.extend_from_slice(&mk(i, format!(\"msg-{i}\").as_bytes()));\n        }\n        let scan = scan_segment(&data, 0).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(scan.torn_tail_len, 0);\n        assert_eq!(scan.records.len(), 10);\n        for (i, r) in scan.records.iter().enumerate() {\n            assert_eq!(r.seq, i as u64);\n            assert_eq!(r.payload, format!(\"msg-{i}\").as_bytes());\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn torn_tail_at_end_is_reported_not_error() {\n        let mut data = Vec::new();\n        data.extend_from_slice(&mk(0, b\"ok\"));\n        data.extend_from_slice(&mk(1, b\"ok2\"));\n        for cut in 1..data.len() {\n            // 只在帧边界之后制造尾部截断\n            let full_second = data.len();\n            let first_len = mk(0, b\"ok\").len();\n            if cut <= first_len {\n                continue;\n            }\n            let truncated = &data[..full_second.min(cut + 1000) - (full_second - cut)];\n            // 逐字节裁掉第二帧末尾\n            let body = &data[..cut];\n            let scan = scan_segment(body, 0).unwrap();\n            assert_eq!(scan.records.len(), 1, \"cut={}\", cut);\n            assert_eq!(scan.records[0].seq, 0);\n            assert!(scan.torn_tail_len > 0 || body.len() < full_second);\n            assert_eq!(scan.valid_len as usize, first_len);\n            let _ = truncated;\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn crc_bit_flip_is_error() {\n        let mut data = Vec::new();\n        data.extend_from_slice(&mk(0, b\"aaaa\"));\n        data.extend_from_slice(&mk(1, b\"bbbb\"));\n        // 翻动中间记录(seq 0)载荷的一个 bit\n        let off = HEADER_LEN + 1;\n        data[off] ^= 0x01;\n        let err = scan_segment(&data, 0).unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(err, FrameError::CrcMismatch { seq: 0, .. }), \"got {err}\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn magic_corruption_is_error() {\n        let mut data = mk(0, b\"aaaa\");\n        data[0] ^= 0xFF;\n        let err = scan_segment(&data, 0).unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(err, FrameError::BadMagic { .. }), \"got {err}\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn seq_gap_and_duplicate_are_errors() {\n        let mut data = Vec::new();\n        data.extend_from_slice(&mk(0, b\"a\"));\n        data.extend_from_slice(&mk(2, b\"b\")); // 缺了 1\n        let err = {"parentUuid":"490ccdac-1392-4a46-a24f-6c55a06d211e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_rwtpqd6c0047x5fvuexnx0lp","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/a/src/vfs.rs","content":"//! 可注入的 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 存储库 [`crate::store`] 不直接调用 `std::fs`，而是依赖 [`Vfs`] trait：\n//!\n//! - [`RealFs`]：真实磁盘实现（生产路径）。\n//! - [`FaultFs`]：包装任意内部 `Vfs`，按调用次数注入 I/O 错误、短写，\n//!   用于验证存储库的错误传播与“写入失败后不损坏已确认数据”。\n//! - [`SimFs`]：纯内存文件系统，显式 [`SimFs::crash_and_reboot`] 把尚未\n//!   `sync_file`/`sync_dir` 的状态全部丢掉，精确模拟掉电瞬间。\n//!\n//! ## 同步边界（durability 语义）\n//!\n//! - `write_all` 只改变文件当前内容；`sync_file` 后该文件内容才算落盘。\n//! - 创建/重命名/删除等名字空间变更只有在 `sync_dir` 后才算落盘。\n//! - `atomic_write(path, data)` 的实现是：写 `path.tmp` → sync 文件 →\n//!   rename → sync 目录；崩溃后只可能看到旧文件或新文件，绝不看到半截新文件。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// I/O 错误（消息文本固定，便于测试断言）。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct IoError {\n    pub kind: ErrorKind,\n    pub context: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ErrorKind {\n    /// 由故障注入或底层系统返回的普通 I/O 错误。\n    Failed,\n    /// 底层“掉电”：本句柄及其未同步状态全部作废，需要重新打开存储库。\n    Crashed,\n    /// 非法路径（含路径分隔符或 `..` 等）。\n    BadPath,\n    NotFound,\n    AlreadyExists,\n}\n\nimpl IoError {\n    pub fn failed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Failed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn crashed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Crashed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn not_found(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::NotFound, context: context.into() }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for IoError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"io error {:?}: {}\", self.kind, self.context)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for IoError {}\n\npub type IoResult<T> = Result<T, IoError>;\n\n/// 可读写、可定位的文件句柄。\npub trait Vfile: Read + Write + Seek + Send {\n    /// 当前文件长度（字节）。\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 把当前文件内容刷到稳定介质；之后崩溃也能保留。\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()>;\n}\n\n/// 文件系统抽象。存储库见到的所有路径都是相对于根目录的单段文件名。\npub trait Vfs: Send {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 打开追加：文件存在则定位到末尾，不存在则创建。\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 新建并截断。\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 文件是否存在。\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool>;\n    /// 文件长度。\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 删除文件。\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 原子改名（目标存在则覆盖）。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 同步名字空间变更（创建/rename/remove 之后调用）。\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// format!(\"{path}.tmp\");\n        {\n            let mut f = self.create(&tmp)?;\n            f.write_all_checked(data)?;\n            f.sync_file()?;\n        }\n        self.rename(&tmp, path)?;\n        self.sync_dir()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 写入全部字节；短写时内部重试。注入层可以让它只写一部分后报错。\ntrait WriteAllChecked {\n    fn write_all_checked(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()>;\n}\n\nimpl<W: Write + ?Sized> WriteAllChecked for W {\n    fn write_all_checked(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let mut written = 0;\n        while written < data.len() {\n            match self.write(&data[written..]) {\n                Ok(0) => {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                        \"write returned 0 at {}/{} bytes\",\n                        written,\n                        data.len()\n                    )))\n                }\n                Ok(n) => written += n,\n                Err(e) => return Err(IoError::failed(e.to_string())),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nfn validate_path(path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n    if path.is_empty()\n        || path.contains('/')\n        || path.contains('\\\\')\n        || path == \".\"\n        || path == \"..\"\n        || path.starts_with('.')\n    {\n        return Err(IoError { kind: ErrorKind::BadPath, context: format!(\"path {path:?}\") });\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 真实文件系统\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub struct RealFs {\n    root: std::path::PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl RealFs {\n    /// `root` 不存在则创建。\n    pub fn open(root: impl Into<std::path::PathBuf>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let root = root.into();\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&root)?;\n        Ok(RealFs { root })\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> RealFile {\n    file: std::fs::File,\n}\n\nimpl Read for RealFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.file.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for RealFile {\n {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.file.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for RealFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.file.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.file.sync_all().map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealFs {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .append(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        Ok(p.exists())\n    }\n\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::metadata(&p).map(|m| m.len()).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::remove_file(&p).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let a = self.full(from)?;\n        let b = self.full(to)?;\n        std::fs::rename(&a, &b).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        // Linux 上打开目录句柄 fsync；其它平台忽略错误（名字空间同步在这些平台退化为 no-op）。\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            use std::os::unix::io::AsRawFd;\n            let f = match std::fs::File::open(&self.root) {\n                Ok(f) => f,\n                Err(_) => return Ok(()),\n            };\n            let r = unsafe { libc_fsync(f.as_raw_fd()) };\n            if r != 0 {\n                return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\"fsync(dir) returned {r}\")));\n            }\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            let _ = &self.root;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        let rd = std::fs::read_dir(&self.root).map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        for entry in rd {\n            let entry = entry.map_err(map_io_err)?;\n            if entry.file_type().map(|t| t.is_file()).unwrap_or(false) {\n                if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str() {\n                    out.push(name.to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nextern \"C\" {\n    fn fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int;\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nunsafe fn libc_fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int {\n    // 不链接 libc crate，直接通过 extern 声明调用 fsync(2)。\n    unsafe { fsync(fd) }\n}\n\nfn map_io_err(e: io::Error) -> IoError {\n    if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound {\n        IoError::not_found(e.to_string())\n    } else {\n        IoError::failed(e.to_string())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 故障注入\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// 可注入的操作类别。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum Op {\n    Write,\n    SyncFile,\n    SyncDir,\n    Rename,\n    Create,\n    Remove,\n    OpenAppend,\n}\n\nimpl Op {\n    fn name(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Op::Write => \"write\",\n            Op::SyncFile => \"sync_file\",\n            Op::SyncDir => \"sync_dir\",\n            Op::Rename => \"rename\",\n            Op::Create => \"create\",\n            Op::Remove => \"remove\",\n            Op::OpenAppend => \"open_append\",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一条注入规则：全局第 `when`（从 1 起）次匹配操作按 `fault` 失败。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub when: u64,\n    pub fault: Fault,\n}\n\n/// 注入的故障形态。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum Fault {\n    /// 直接返回 I/O 错误（操作本身不产生任何效果）。\n    Error,\n    /// 短写：写入仅前 `n` 字节后返回错误。\n    ShortWrite(u64),\n}\n\n/// 故障注入配置。`Arc` 共享，测试中可在存储库运行期间追加规则。\n#[derive(Clone, Default)]\npub struct FaultPlan {\n    inner: Arc<Mutex<Vec<FaultRule>>>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultPlan {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n    pub fn push(&self, rule: FaultRule) {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().push(rule);\n    }\n    pub fn fail_on(op: Op, when: u64) -> Self {\n        let p = Self::new();\n        p.push(FaultRule { op, when, fault: Fault::Error });\n        p\n    }\n    fn take(&self, op: Op) -> Option<Fault> {\n        let mut rules = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        for i in 0..rules.len() {\n            if rules[i].op == op && rules[i].when == 1 {\n                return Some(rules.remove(i).fault);\n            }\n        }\n        let mut hit = None;\n        for r in rules.iter_mut() {\n            if r.op == op {\n                if r.when > 0 {\n                    r.when -= 1;\n                }\n                if r.when == 0 && hit.is_none() {\n                    hit = Some(r.fault.clone());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        // 触发后把计数为 0 的规则移除\n        rules.retain(|r| !(r.op == op && r.when == 0));\n        hit\n    }\n    /// 剩余规则数（测试用）。\n    pub fn remaining(&self) -> usize {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().len()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在任意 [`Vfs`] 外包一层故障注入。\npub struct FaultFs<F: Vfs> {\n    inner: F,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n    counts: Arc<AtomicU64>,\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> FaultFs<F> {\n    pub fn new(inner: F, plan: FaultPlan) -> Self {\n        FaultFs { inner, plan, counts: Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0)) }\n    }\n\n    fn check(&self, op: Op) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.counts.add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n        if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(op) {\n            match fault {\n                Fault::Error => {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\"injected {} failure (#{})\", op.name(), self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst))))\n                }\n                Fault::ShortWrite(_) => {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                        \"injected short write on {} (#{})\",\n                        op.name(),\n                        self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)\n                    )))\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 故障写入的字节数由 `FaultFs` 与写入句柄共享。\nstruct FaultFile {\n    inner: Box<dyn Vfile>,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n    /// 记录本句柄上已写入字节数，便于 ShortWrite 复现部分写入。\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> Vfs for FaultFs<F> {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        // 读路径不注入。\n        self.inner.open_read(path)\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::OpenAppend)?;\n        let f = self.inner.open_append(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultFile { inner: f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::Create)?;\n        let f = self.inner.create(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultFile { inner: f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.file_len(path)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Remove)?;\n        self.inner.remove(path)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Rename)?;\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::SyncDir)?;\n        self.inner.sync_dir()\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Read for FaultFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.inner.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for FaultFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.inner.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for FaultFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.inner.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.flush()\n    }\n    fn write_all(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        // 自定义写全程：按注入规则制造短写。\n        let mut written = 0usize;\n        while written < data.len() {\n            if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(Op::Write) {\n                match fault {\n                    Fault::Error => {\n                        return Err(io::Error::new(\n                            io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                            format!(\"injected write failure at {written}/{}\", data.len()),\n                        ))\n                    }\n match self.inner.write(&data[written..target]) {\n                                Ok(0) => {\n                                    return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero, \"zero write\"))\n                                }\n                                Ok(k) => written += k,\n                                Err(e) => return Err(e),\n                            }\n                        }\n                        return Err(io::Error::new(\n                            io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                            format!(\"injected short write: {written}/{} bytes landed\", data.len()),\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            match self.inner.write(&data[written..]) {\n                Ok(0) => return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero, \"zero write\")),\n                Ok(k) => written += k,\n                Err(e) => return Err(e),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for FaultFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.len()\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if let Some(Fault::Error) = self.plan.take(Op::SyncFile) {\n            return Err(IoError::failed(\"injected sync_file failure\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.sync_file()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 内存文件系统 + 崩溃模拟\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// 内存中一个文件的全部状态。\n#[derive(Clone)]\nstruct FNode {\n    /// 已“落盘”的名字（None 表示已落盘的删除/墓碑）。\n    committed_key: Option<String>,\n    /// 已落盘内容；None 表示墓碑（名字已删除）。\n    committed_data: Option<Vec<u8>>,\n    /// 当前工作视图的名字（None 表示工作视图已删除）。\n    work_key: Option<String>,\n    /// 当前工作视图内容（含未落盘写入）；None 表示已删除。\n    work_data: Option<Vec<u8>>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Default)]\nstruct SimState {\n    files: Vec<FNode>,\n    next_id: u64,\n}\n\n/// 内存文件系统的共享内核；调用 [`SimFs::crash_and_reboot`] 可丢弃未落盘状态。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct SimDisk {\n    state: Arc<Mutex<SimState>>,\n    /// 每次 reboot 自增，旧句柄携带旧代号，崩溃后使用即报 Crashed。\n    epoch: Arc<Mutex<u64>>,\n}\n\nimpl SimDisk {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        SimDisk { state: Arc::new(Mutex::new(SimState::default())), epoch: Arc::new(Mutex::new(0)) }\n    }\n\n    /// 模拟掉电重启：\n    /// - 未 `sync_file` 的文件内容回滚到上次同步点；\n    /// - 未 `sync_dir` 的创建/rename/remove 整体回滚或重做（原子）。\n    pub fn crash_and_reboot(&self) {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        for node in st.files.iter_mut() {\n            // 名字空间回滚到上次 sync_dir 的已提交状态\n            node.work_key = node.committed_key.clone();\n            node.work_data = node.committed_data.clone();\n        }\n        *self.epoch.lock().unwrap() += 1;\n    }\n\n    /// 当前已“落盘”的文件名与大小（测试断言用）。\n    pub fn committed_snapshot(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, usize> {\n        let st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut out = BTreeMap::new();\n        for n in &st.files {\n            if let (Some(k), Some(d)) = (&n.committed_key, &n.committed_data) {\n                out.insert(k.clone(), d.len());\n            }\n        }\n        out\n    }\n}\n\n/// 基于 [`SimDisk`] 的 [`Vfs`] 实现。崩溃后必须新建 `SimFs`（旧实例的句柄全部失效）。\npub struct SimFs {\n    disk: SimDisk,\n    epoch: {\n        if *self.disk.epoch.lock().unwrap() != self.epoch {\n            return Err(IoError::crashed(\"handle belongs to a pre-crash epoch\"));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn find_work(&self, path: &str) -> Option<usize> {\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.files.iter().position(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path))\n    }\n}\n\nstruct SimFile {\n    disk: SimDisk,\n    epoch: u64,\n    id: u64,\n    pos: u64,\n}\n\nimpl SimFile {\n    fn node(&self) -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'static, SimState> {\n        // 安全：SimState 是 'static 进程内对象（Arc 持有），这里仅做生命周期擦除以便集中加锁。\n        // 实际通过下面的方法封装，避免泄漏 guard。\n        unimplemented!()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for SimFs {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let id = {\n            let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            let n = st\n                .files\n // 用 work_key 找到节点在 vector 的稳定 id\n            st.files.iter().position(|x| std::ptr::eq(x, n)).unwrap() as u64\n        };\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: 0 }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let id = {\n            let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(pos) = st.files.iter().position(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path)) {\n                let len = st.files[pos].work_data.as_ref().map(|d| d.len()).unwrap_or(0);\n                drop(st);\n                let _ = len;\n                pos as u64\n            } else {\n                let id = st.next_id;\n                st.next_id += 1;\n                st.files.push(FNode {\n                    committed_key: None,\n                    committed_data: None,\n                    work_key: Some(path.to_string()),\n                    work_data: Some(Vec::new()),\n                });\n                id\n            }\n        };\n        let len = {\n            let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            st.files[id as usize].work_data.as_ref().map(|d| d.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0)\n        };\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: len }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let id = {\n            let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            if Some(Vec::new());\n                pos as u64\n            } else {\n                let id = st.next_id;\n                st.next_id += 1;\n                st.files.push(FNode {\n                    committed_key: None,\n                    committed_data: None,\n                    work_key: Some(path.to_string()),\n                    work_data: Some(Vec::new()),\n                });\n                id\n            }\n        };\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: 0 }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        Ok(st.files.iter().any(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path) && n.work_data.is_some()))\n    }\n\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.files\n            .iter()\n            .find(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path))\n            .and_then(|n| n.work_data.as_ref())\n            .map(|d| d.len() as u64)\n            .ok_or_else(|| IoError::not_found(format!(\"sim file_len {path}\")))\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(pos) = 可注入的 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 存储库 [`crate::store`] 不直接调用 `std::fs`，而是依赖 [`Vfs`] trait：\n//!\n//! - [`RealFs`]：真实磁盘实现（生产路径）。\n//! - [`FaultFs`]：包装任意内部 `Vfs`，按调用次数注入 I/O 错误、短写，\n//!   用于验证存储库的错误传播与“写入失败后不损坏已确认数据”。\n//! - [`SimFs`]：纯内存文件系统，显式 [`SimFs::crash_and_reboot`] 把尚未\n//!   `sync_file`/`sync_dir` 的状态全部丢掉，精确模拟掉电瞬间。\n//!\n//! ## 同步边界（durability 语义）\n//!\n//! - `write_all` 只改变文件当前内容；`sync_file` 后该文件内容才算落盘。\n//! - 创建/重命名/删除等名字空间变更只有在 `sync_dir` 后才算落盘。\n//! - `atomic_write(path, data)` 的实现是：写 `path.tmp` → sync 文件 →\n//!   rename → sync 目录；崩溃后只可能看到旧文件或新文件，绝不看到半截新文件。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// I/O 错误（消息文本固定，便于测试断言）。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct IoError {\n    pub kind: ErrorKind,\n    pub context: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ErrorKind {\n    /// 由故障注入或底层系统返回的普通 I/O 错误。\n    Failed,\n    /// 底层“掉电”：本句柄及其未同步状态全部作废，需要重新打开存储库。\n    Crashed,\n    /// 非法路径（含路径分隔符或 `..` 等）。\n    BadPath,\n    NotFound,\n    AlreadyExists,\n}\n\nimpl IoError {\n    pub fn failed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Failed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn crashed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Crashed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn not_found(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::NotFound, context: context.into() }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for IoError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"io error {:?}: {}\", self.kind, self.context)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for IoError {}\n\npub type IoResult<T> = Result<T, IoError>;\n\n/// 可读写、可定位的文件句柄。\npub trait Vfile: Read + Write + Seek + Send {\n    /// 当前文件长度（字节）。\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 把当前文件内容刷到稳定介质；之后崩溃也能保留。\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()>;\n}\n\n/// 文件系统抽象。存储库见到的所有路径都是相对于根目录的单段文件名。\npub trait Vfs: Send {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 打开追加：文件存在则定位到末尾，不存在则创建。\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 新建并截断。\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 文件是否存在。\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool>;\n    /// 文件长度。\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 删除文件。\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 原子改名（目标存在则覆盖）。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 同步名字空间变更（创建/rename/remove 之后调用）。\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// format!(\"{path}.tmp\");\n        {\n            let mut f = self.create(&tmp)?;\n            f.write_all_checked(data)?;\n            f.sync_file()?;\n        }\n        self.rename(&tmp, path)?;\n        self.sync_dir()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 写入全部字节；短写时内部重试。注入层可以让它只写一部分后报错。\ntrait WriteAllChecked {\n    fn write_all_checked(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()>;\n}\n\nimpl<W: Write + ?Sized> WriteAllChecked for W {\n    fn write_all_checked(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let mut written = 0;\n        while written < data.len() {\n            match self.write(&data[written..]) {\n                Ok(0) => {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                        \"write returned 0 at {}/{} bytes\",\n                        written,\n                        data.len()\n                    )))\n                }\n                Ok(n) => written += n,\n                Err(e) => return Err(IoError::failed(e.to_string())),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nfn validate_path(path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n    if path.is_empty()\n        || path.contains('/')\n ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub struct RealFs {\n    root: std::path::PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl RealFs {\n    /// `root` 不存在则创建。\n    pub fn open(root: RealFile {\n    file: std::fs::File,\n}\n\nimpl Read for RealFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.file.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for RealFile {\n {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.file.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for RealFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.file.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.file.sync_all().map_err(|e| std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .append(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        Ok(p.exists())\n    }\n\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::metadata(&p).map(|m| m.len()).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::remove_file(&p).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let a = self.full(from)?;\n        let b = self.full(to)?;\n        std::fs::rename(&a, &b).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        // Linux 上打开目录句柄 fsync；其它平台忽略错误（名字空间同步在这些平台退化为 no-op）。\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            use std::os::unix::io::AsRawFd;\n            let f = match std::fs::File::open(&self.root) {\n                Ok(f) => f,\n                Err(_) => return Ok(()),\n            };\n            let r = unsafe { libc_fsync(f.as_raw_fd()) };\n            if r != 0 {\n                return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\"fsync(dir) returned {r}\")));\n            }\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            let _ = &self.root;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        let rd = std::fs::read_dir(&self.root).map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        for entry in rd {\n            let entry = entry.map_err(map_io_err)?;\n            if entry.file_type().map(|t| t.is_file()).unwrap_or(false) {\n                if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str() {\n                    out.push(name.to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nextern \"C\" {\n    fn fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int;\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nunsafe fn libc_fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int {\n    // 不链接 libc crate，直接通过 extern 声明调用 fsync(2)。\n    unsafe { fsync(fd) }\n}\n\nfn map_io_err(e: io::Error) -> IoError {\n    if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound {\n        IoError::not_found(e.to_string())\n    } else {\n        IoError::failed(e.to_string())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 故障注入\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// 可注入的操作类别。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum Op {\n    Write,\n    SyncFile,\n    SyncDir,\n    Rename,\n    Create,\n    Remove,\n    OpenAppend,\n}\n\nimpl Op {\n    fn name(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Op::Write => \"write\",\n            Op::SyncFile => \"sync_file\",\n            Op::SyncDir => \"sync_dir\",\n            Op::Rename => \"rename\",\n            Op::Create => \"create\",\n            Op::Remove => \"remove\",\n            Op::OpenAppend => \"open_append\",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一条注入规则：全局第 `when`（从 1 起）次匹配操作按 `fault` 失败。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub when: u64,\n    pub fault: Fault,\n}\n\n/// 注入的故障形态。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum Fault {\n    /// 直接返回 I/O 错误（操作本身不产生任何效果）。\n    Error,\n    /// 短写：写入仅前 `n` 字节后返回错误。\n    ShortWrite(u64),\n}\n\n/// 故障注入配置。`Arc` 共享，测试中可在存储库运行期间追加规则。\n#[derive(Clone, Default)]\npub struct FaultPlan {\n    inner: Arc<Mutex<Vec<FaultRule>>>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultPlan {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n    pub fn push(&self, rule: FaultRule) {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().push(rule);\n    }\n    pub fn fail_on(op: Op, when: u64) -> Self {\n        let p = Self::new();\n        p.push(FaultRule { op, when, fault: Fault::Error });\n        p\n    }\n    fn take(&self, op: Op) -> Option<Fault> {\n        let mut rules = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        for i in 0..rules.len() {\n            if rules[i].op == op && rules[i].when == 1 {\n                return Some(rules.remove(i).fault);\n            }\n        }\n        let mut hit = None;\n        for r in rules.iter_mut() {\n            if r.op == op {\n                if r.when > 0 {\n                    r.when -= 1;\n                }\n                if r.when == 0 && hit.is_none() {\n                    hit = Some(r.fault.clone());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        // 触发后把计数为 0 的规则移除\n        rules.retain(|r| !(r.op == op && r.when == 0));\n        hit\n    }\n    /// 剩余规则数（测试用）。\n    pub fn remaining(&self) -> usize {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().len()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在任意 [`Vfs`] 外包一层故障注入。\npub struct FaultFs<F: Vfs> {\n    inner: F,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n    counts: Arc<AtomicU64>,\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> FaultFs<F> {\n    pub fn new(inner: F, plan: FaultPlan) -> Self {\n        FaultFs { inner, plan, counts: Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0)) }\n    }\n\n    fn check(&self, op: Op) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.counts.add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n        if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(op) {\n            match fault {\n                Fault::Error => {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\"injected {} failure (#{})\", op.name(), self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst))))\n                }\n                Fault::ShortWrite(_) => {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                        \"injected short write on {} (#{})\",\n                        op.name(),\n                        self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)\n                    )))\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 故障写入的字节数由 `FaultFs` 与写入句柄共享。\nstruct FaultFile {\n    inner: Box<dyn Vfile>,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n    /// 记录本句柄上已写入字节数，便于 ShortWrite 复现部分写入。\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> Vfs for FaultFs<F> {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        // 读路径不注入。\n        self.inner.open_read(path)\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::OpenAppend)?;\n        let f = self.inner.open_append(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultFile { inner: f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::Create)?;\n        let f = self.inner.create(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultFile { inner: f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.file_len(path)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Remove)?;\n        self.inner.remove(path)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Rename)?;\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::SyncDir)?;\n        self.inner.sync_dir()\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Read for FaultFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.inner.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for FaultFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.inner.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for FaultFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.inner.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.flush()\n    }\n    fn write_all(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        // 自定义写全程：按注入规则制造短写。\n        let mut written = 0usize;\n        while written < data.len() {\n            if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(Op::Write) {\n                match fault {\n                    Fault::Error => {\n                        return Err(io::Error::new(\n                            io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                            format!(\"injected write failure at {written}/{}\", data.len()),\n                        ))\n                    }\n                    Fault::ShortWrite(n) => {\n                        let target = written.saturating_add(n as usize).min(data.len());\n                        while written < target {\n                            match self.inner.write(&data[written..target]) {\n                                Ok(0) => {\n                                    return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero, \"zero write\"))\n                                }\n                                Ok(k) => written += k,\n                                Err(e) => return Err(e),\n                            }\n                        }\n                        return Err(io::Error::new(\n                            io::ErrorKind::Other,\n                            format!(\"injected short write: {written}/{} bytes landed\", data.len()),\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            match self.inner.write(&data[written..]) {\n                Ok(0) => return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero, \"zero write\")),\n                Ok(k) => written += k,\n                Err(e) => return Err(e),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for FaultFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.len()\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if let Some(Fault::Error) = self.plan.take(Op::SyncFile) {\n            return Err(IoError::failed(\"injected sync_file failure\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.sync_file()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 内存文件系统 + 崩溃模拟\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// 内存中一个文件的全部状态。\n#[derive(Clone)]\nstruct FNode {\n    /// 已“落盘”的名字（None 表示已落盘的删除/墓碑）。\n    committed_key: Option<String>,\n    /// 已落盘内容；None 表示墓碑（名字已删除）。\n    committed_data: Option<Vec<u8>>,\n    /// 当前工作视图的名字（None 表示工作视图已删除）。\n    work_key: Option<String>,\n    /// 当前工作视图内容（含未落盘写入）；None 表示已删除。\n    work_data: Option<Vec<u8>>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Default)]\nstruct SimState {\n    files: Vec<FNode>,\n    next_id: u64,\n}\n\n/// 内存文件系统的共享内核；调用 [`SimFs::crash_and_reboot`] 可丢弃未落盘状态。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct SimDisk {\n    state: Arc<Mutex<SimState>>,\n    /// 每次 reboot 自增，旧句柄携带旧代号，崩溃后使用即报 Crashed。\n    epoch: Arc<Mutex<u64>>,\n}\n\nimpl SimDisk {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        SimDisk { state: Arc::new(Mutex::new(SimState::default())), epoch: Arc::new(Mutex::new(0)) }\n    }\n\n    /// 模拟掉电重启：\n    /// - 未 `sync_file` 的文件内容回滚到上次同步点；\n    /// - 未 `sync_dir` 的创建/rename/remove 整体回滚或重做（原子）。\n    pub fn crash_and_reboot(&self) {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        for node in st.files.iter_mut() {\n            // 名字空间回滚到上次 sync_dir 的已提交状态\n            node.work_key = node.committed_key.clone();\n            node.work_data = node.committed_data.clone();\n        }\n        *self.epoch.lock().unwrap() += 1;\n    }\n\n    /// 当前已“落盘”的文件名与大小（测试断言用）。\n    pub fn committed_snapshot(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, usize> {\n        let st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut out = BTreeMap::new();\n        for n in &st.files {\n            if let (Some(k), Some(d)) = (&n.committed_key, &n.committed_data) {\n                out.insert(k.clone(), d.len());\n            }\n        }\n        out\n    }\n}\n\n/// 基于 [`SimDisk`] 的 [`Vfs`] 实现。崩溃后必须新建 `SimFs`（旧实例的句柄全部失效）。\npub struct SimFs {\n    disk: SimDisk,\n    epoch: u64,\n}\n\nimpl SimFs {\n    pub fn new(disk: SimDisk) -> Self {\n        let epoch = *disk.epoch.lock().unwrap();\n        SimFs { disk, epoch }\n    }\n\n    fn check_epoch(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if *self.disk.epoch.lock().unwrap() != self.epoch {\n            return Err(IoError::crashed(\"handle belongs to a pre-crash epoch\"));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn find_work(&self, path: &str) -> Option<usize> {\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.files.iter().position(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path))\n    }\n}\n\nstruct SimFile {\n    disk: SimDisk,\n    epoch: u64,\n    id: u64,\n    pos: u64,\n}\n\nimpl SimFile {\n    fn node(&self) -> std::sync::MutexGuard<'static, SimState> {\n        // 安全：SimState 是 'static 进程内对象（Arc 持有），这里仅做生命周期擦除以便集中加锁。\n        // 实际通过下面的方法封装，避免泄漏 guard。\n        unimplemented!()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for SimFs {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let id = {\n            let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            let n = st\n                .files\n                .iter()\n                .find(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path) && n.work_data.is_some())\n                .ok_or_else(|| IoError::not_found(format!(\"sim open_read {path}\")))?;\n            // 用 work_key 找到节点在 vector 的稳定 id\n            st.files.iter().position(|x| std::ptr::eq(x, n)).unwrap() as u64\n        };\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: 0 }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let id = {\n            let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(pos) = st.files.iter().position(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path)) {\n                let len = st.files[pos].work_data.as_ref().map(|d| d.len()).unwrap_or(0);\n                drop(st);\n                let _ = len;\n                pos as u64\n            } else {\n                let id = st.next_id;\n                st.next_id += 1;\n                st.files.push(FNode {\n                    committed_key: None,\n                    committed_data: None,\n                    work_key: Some(path.to_string()),\n                    work_data: Some(Vec::new()),\n                });\n                id\n            }\n        };\n        let len = {\n            let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            st.files[id as usize].work_data.as_ref().map(|d| d.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0)\n        };\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: len }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let id = {\n            let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(pos) = st.files.iter().position(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path)) {\n                // 覆盖：截断工作内容；已提交旧版本仍在 committed_*，sync_dir 前崩溃可恢复。\n                st.files[pos].work_data = Some(Vec::new());\n                pos as u64\n            } else {\n                let id = st.next_id;\n                st.next_id += 1;\n                st.files.push(FNode {\n                    committed_key: None,\n                    committed_data: None,\n                    work_key: Some(path.to_string()),\n                    work_data: Some(Vec::new()),\n                });\n                id\n            }\n        };\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: 0 }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        Ok(st.files.iter().any(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path) && n.work_data.is_some()))\n    }\n\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.files\n            .iter()\n            .find(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path))\n            .and_then(|n| n.work_data.as_ref())\n            .map(|d| d.len() as u64)\n            .ok_or_else(|| IoError::not_found(format!(\"sim file_len {path}\")))\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(pos) = st.files.iter().position(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path)) {\n            st.files[pos].work_key = None;\n            st.files[pos].work_data = None;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(from)?;\n        validate_path(to)?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let src = st\n            .files\n            .iter()\n            .position(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(from))\n            .ok_or_else(|| IoError::not_found(format!(\"sim rename {from}\")))?;\n        // 目标存在 => 形成一个“被覆盖目标”的墓碑节点，sync_dir 后生效\n        if let Some(dst) = st.files.iter().position(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(to)) {\n            // 把目标内容与名字从工作视图摘除，保留其 committed_* 以便回滚\n            st.files[dst].work_key = None;\n            st.files[dst].work_data = None;\n            // 记录覆盖意图：在 src 节点上无法同时表达两个名字，追加一个墓碑节点\n            st.next_id += 0;\n            // 简化：用单独的 pending_replace 字段表达；这里借助额外节点\n            st.files.push(FNode {\n                committed_key: Some(to.to_string()),\n                committed_data: st.files[dst].committed_data.clone(),\n                work_key: None,\n                work_data: None,\n            });\n        }\n        st.files[src].work_key = Some(to.to_string());\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        // 提交所有名字空间变更，并顺带提交各文件当前内容（等价于目录 fsync 时\n        // 文件内容此前都已 fsync —— 存储库始终先 sync_file 再 rename/sync_dir）。\n        for n in st.files.iter_mut() {\n            n.committed_key = n.work_key.clone();\n            n.committed_data = n.work_data.clone();\n        }\n        // 清理已提交且工作视图也为墓碑的冗余节点\n        st.files.retain(|n| n.committed_key.is_some() || n.work_key.is_some());\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut out: Vec<String> = st\n            .files\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|n| n.work_key.clone().filter(|_| n.work_data.is_some()))\n            .collect();\n        out.sort();\n        out.dedup();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl SimFile {\n    fn alive(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if *self.disk.epoch.lock().unwrap() != self.epoch {\n            return Err(IoError::crashed(\"sim file handle from before crash\"));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Read for SimFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.alive().map_err(io_err)?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = st.files[self.id as usize]\n            .work_data\n            .as_ref()\n            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"file deleted\"))?;\n        let pos = self.pos as usize;\n        if pos >= data.len() {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n        let n = buf.len().min(data.len() - pos);\n        buf[..n].copy_from_slice(&data[pos..pos + n]);\n        self.pos += n as u64;\n        Ok(n)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Seek for SimFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.alive().map_err(io_err)?;\n        let len = {\n            let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            st.files[self.id as usize].work_data.as_ref().map(|d| d.len() as i64).unwrap_or(0)\n        };\n        let new_pos: i64 = match pos {\n            SeekFrom::Start(n) => n as i64,\n            SeekFrom::Current(n) => self.pos as i64 + n,\n            SeekFrom::End(n) => len + n,\n        };\n        if new_pos < 0 {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, \"negative seek\"));\n        }\n        self.pos = new_pos as u64;\n        Ok(self.pos)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Write for SimFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.alive().map_err(io_err)?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = st.files[self.id as usize]\n            .work_data\n            .as_mut()\n            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"file deleted\"))?;\n        let pos = self.pos as usize;\n        if pos > data.len() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, \"write past end\"));\n        }\n        if pos == data.len() {\n            data.extend_from_slice(buf);\n        } else {\n            let end = (pos + buf.len()).min(data.len());\n            data[pos..end].copy_from_slice(&buf[..end - pos]);\n            if pos + buf.len() > data.len() {\n                data.extend_from_slice(&buf[end - pos..]);\n            }\n        }\n        self.pos += buf.len() as u64;\n        Ok(buf.len())\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfile for SimFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.alive()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        Ok(st.files[self.id as usize].work_data.as_ref().map(|d| d.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0))\n    }\n\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.alive()?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = st.files[self.id as usize].work_data.clone();\n        // 仅提交该文件“内容”；名字提交仍要等 sync_dir。\n        let n = &mut st.files[self.id as usize];\n        if n.work_key.is_some() {\n            // 已存在的文件：内容直接提交（名字此前已提交过）。\n            // 对新建未 sync_dir 的文件，只暂存内容到 committed_data，名字仍未提交。\n            n.committed_data = data;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nfn io_err(e: IoError) -> io::Error {\n    match e.kind {\n        ErrorKind::Crashed => io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe, e.to_string()),\n        ErrorKind::NotFound => io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, e.to_string()),\n        _ => io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, e.to_string()),\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn write_read(vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<Vec<u8>> {\n        {\n            let mut f = vfs.create(\"a.log\")?;\n            f.write_all_checked(b\"hello\")?;\n            f.sync_file()?;\n        }\n        vfs.sync_dir()?;\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        vfs.open_read(\"a.log\")?.read_to_end(&mut buf).map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))?;\n        Ok(buf)\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn realfs_roundtrip_in_tempdir() {\n        let tmp = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\"seglog-vfs-{}\", std::process::id()));\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp);\n        let fs = RealFs::open(&tmp).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(write_read(&fs).unwrap(), b\"hello\");\n        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp).ok();\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn simfs_basic_roundtrip() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::new();\n        let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n        assert_eq!(write_read(&fs).unwrap(), b\"hello\");\n        assert_eq!(disk.committed_snapshot().get(\"a.log\"), Some(&5));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn simfs_crash_rolls_back_unsynced_writes() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::new();\n        {\n            let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n            let mut f = fs.open_append(\"seg.log\").unwrap();\n            f.write_all_checked(b\"durable\").unwrap();\n            f.sync_file().unwrap();\n            fs.sync_dir().unwrap();\n            f.write_all_checked(b\"-lost\").unwrap();\n            // 未 sync 即崩溃\n            disk.crash_and_reboot();\n        }\n        let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        fs.open_read(\"seg.log\").unwrap().read_to_end(&mut buf).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(buf, b\"durable\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn simfs_crash_rolls_back_uncommitted_rename_and_create() {\n 只改变文件当前内容；`sync_file` 后该文件内容才算落盘。\n//! - 创建/重命名/删除等名字空间变更只有在 `sync_dir` 后才算落盘。\n//! - `atomic_write(path, data)` 的实现是：写 `path.tmp` → sync 文件 →\n//!   rename → sync 目录；崩溃后只可能看到旧文件或新文件，绝不看到半截新文件。\n\nuse 错误（消息文本固定，便于测试断言）。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct IoError {\n    pub kind: ErrorKind,\n    pub context: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ErrorKind {\n    /// 由故障注入或底层系统返回的普通 I/O 错误。\n    Failed,\n    /// 底层“掉电”：本句柄及其未同步状态全部作废，需要重新打开存储库。\n    Crashed,\n    /// 非法路径（含路径分隔符或 `..` 等）。\n    BadPath,\n    NotFound,\n    AlreadyExists,\n}\n\nimpl IoError {\n    pub fn failed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Failed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn crashed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Crashed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn not_found(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::NotFound, context: context.into() }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for IoError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"io error {:?}: {}\", self.kind, self.context)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for IoError {}\n\npub type IoResult<T> = Result<T, IoError>;\n\n/// 可读写、可定位的文件句柄。\npub trait Vfile: Read + Write + Seek + Send {\n    /// 当前文件长度（字节）。\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 打开追加：文件存在则定位到末尾，不存在则创建。\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 新建并截断。\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 文件是否存在。\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool>;\n    /// 文件长度。\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 删除文件。\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 原子改名（目标存在则覆盖）。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 同步名字空间变更（创建/rename/remove 之后调用）。\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// format!(\"{path}.tmp\");\n        {\n            let mut f = self.create(&tmp)?;\n            f.write_all_checked(data)?;\n            f.sync_file()?;\n        }\n        self.rename(&tmp, path)?;\n + ?Sized> WriteAllChecked for W {\n    fn write_all_checked(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let mut written = 0;\n        while written < data.len() {\n            match self.write(&data[written..]) {\n                Ok(0) => {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                        \"write returned 0 at {}/{} bytes\",\n                        written,\n                        data.len()\n                    )))\n                }\n                Ok(n) => written += n,\n                Err(e) => return Err(IoError::failed(e.to_string())),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nfn validate_path(path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n    if path.is_empty()\n        || path.contains('/')\n        || path.contains('\\\\')\n        || path == \".\"\n        || path == \"..\"\n        || path.starts_with('.')\n    {\n        return Err(IoError { kind: ErrorKind::BadPath, context: format!(\"path {path:?}\") });\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 真实文件系统\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub struct RealFs {\n    root: std::path::PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl RealFs {\n    /// `root` 不存在则创建。\n    pub fn open(root: impl Into<std::path::PathBuf>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let root = root.into();\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&root)?;\n        Ok(RealFs { root })\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> RealFile {\n    file: std::fs::File,\n}\n\nimpl Read for RealFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.file.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for RealFile {\n {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.file.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for RealFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.file.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.file.sync_all().map_err(|e| std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .append(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        Ok(p.exists())\n    }\n\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::metadata(&p).map(|m| m.len()).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::remove_file(&p).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let a = self.full(from)?;\n        let b = self.full(to)?;\n        std::fs::rename(&a, &b).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        // Linux 上打开目录句柄 fsync；其它平台忽略错误（名字空间同步在这些平台退化为 no-op）。\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            use std::os::unix::io::AsRawFd;\n            let f = match std::fs::File::open(&self.root) {\n                Ok(f) => f,\n                Err(_) => return Ok(()),\n            };\n            let r = unsafe { libc_fsync(f.as_raw_fd()) };\n            if r != 0 {\n                return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\"fsync(dir) returned {r}\")));\n            }\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            let _ = &self.root;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        let rd = std::fs::read_dir(&self.root).map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        for entry in rd {\n            let entry = entry.map_err(map_io_err)?;\n            if entry.file_type().map(|t| t.is_file()).unwrap_or(false) {\n                if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str() {\n                    out.push(name.to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nextern \"C\" {\n    fn fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int;\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nunsafe fn libc_fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int {\n    // 不链接 libc crate，直接通过 extern 声明调用 fsync(2)。\n    unsafe { fsync(fd) }\n}\n\nfn map_io_err(e: io::Error) -> IoError {\n    if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound {\n        IoError::not_found(e.to_string())\n    } else {\n        IoError::failed(e.to_string())\n 可注入的操作类别。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum Op {\n    Write,\n    SyncFile,\n    SyncDir,\n    Rename,\n    Create,\n    Remove,\n    OpenAppend,\n}\n\nimpl Op {\n    fn name(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Op::Write => \"write\",\n            Op::SyncFile => \"sync_file\",\n            Op::SyncDir => \"sync_dir\",\n            Op::Rename => \"rename\",\n            Op::Create => \"create\",\n            Op::Remove => \"remove\",\n            Op::OpenAppend => \"open_append\",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一条注入规则：全局第 `when`（从 1 起）次匹配操作按 `fault` 失败。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub when: u64,\n    pub fault: Fault,\n}\n\n/// 注入的故障形态。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum Fault {\n    /// 直接返回 I/O 错误（操作本身不产生任何效果）。\n    Error,\n    /// 短写：写入仅前 `n` 字节后返回错误。\n    ShortWrite(u64),\n}\n\n/// 故障注入配置。`Arc` 共享，测试中可在存储库运行期间追加规则。\n#[derive(Clone, Default)]\npub struct FaultPlan {\n    inner: Arc<Mutex<Vec<FaultRule>>>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultPlan {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n    pub fn push(&self, rule: FaultRule) {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().push(rule);\n    }\n    pub fn fail_on(op: Op, when: u64) -> Self {\n        let p = Self::new();\n        p.push(FaultRule { op, when, fault: Fault::Error });\n        p\n    }\n    fn take(&self, op: Op) -> Option<Fault> {\n        let mut rules = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        for i in 0..rules.len() {\n            if rules[i].op == op && rules[i].when == 1 {\n                return Some(rules.remove(i).fault);\n            }\n        }\n        let mut hit = None;\n        for r in rules.iter_mut() {\n            if r.op == op {\n                if r.when > 0 {\n                    r.when -= 1;\n                }\n                if r.when == 0 && hit.is_none() {\n                    hit = Some(r.fault.clone());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        // 触发后把计数为 0 的规则移除\n        rules.retain(|r| !(r.op == op && r.when == 0));\n        hit\n    }\n    /// 剩余规则数（测试用）。\n    pub fn remaining(&self) -> usize {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().len()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在任意 [`Vfs`] 外包一层故障注入。\npub struct FaultFs<F: Vfs> {\n    inner: F,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n    counts: Arc<AtomicU64>,\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> FaultFs<F> {\n    pub fn new(inner: F, plan: FaultPlan) -> Self {\n        FaultFs { inner, plan, counts: Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0)) }\n    }\n\n    fn check(&self, op: Op) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.counts.add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n        if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(op) {\n            match fault {\n                Fault::Error => {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                        \"injected short write on {} (#{})\",\n                        op.name(),\n                        self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)\n                    )))\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 故障写入的字节数由 `FaultFs` 与写入句柄共享。\nstruct FaultFile {\n    inner: Box<dyn Vfile>,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n    /// 记录本句柄上已写入字节数，便于 ShortWrite 复现部分写入。\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> Vfs for FaultFs<F> {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        // 读路径不注入。\n        self.inner.open_read(path)\n f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::Create)?;\n        let f = self.inner.create(path)?;\n -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.file_len(path)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Remove)?;\n        self.inner.remove(path)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Rename)?;\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::SyncDir)?;\n        self.inner.sync_dir()\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Read for FaultFile {\n    fn read(&mut self.inner.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for FaultFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.inner.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()>
