可注入的 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 存储库 [`crate::store`] 不直接调用 `std::fs`，而是依赖 [`Vfs`] trait：\n//!\n//! - [`RealFs`]：真实磁盘实现（生产路径）。\n//! - [`FaultFs`]：包装任意内部 `Vfs`，按调用次数注入 I/O 错误、短写，\n//!   用于验证存储库的错误传播与“写入失败后不损坏已确认数据”。\n//! - [`SimFs`]：纯内存文件系统，显式 [`SimDisk::crash_and_reboot`] 把尚未\n//!   `sync_file`/`sync_dir` 的状态全部丢掉，精确模拟掉电瞬间。\n//!\n//! ## 同步边界（durability 语义）\n//!\n//! - `write_all` 只改变文件当前内容；`sync_file` 后该文件内容才算落盘。\n//! - 创建/重命名/删除等名字空间变更只有在 `sync_dir` 后才算落盘。\n//! - `atomic_write(path, data)` 的实现是：写 `path.tmp` → sync 文件 →\n//!   rename → sync 目录；崩溃后只可能看到旧文件或新文件，绝不看到半截新文件。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// I/O 错误（消息文本固定，便于测试断言）。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct IoError {\n    pub kind: ErrorKind,\n    pub context: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ErrorKind {\n    /// 由故障注入或底层系统返回的普通 I/O 错误。\n    Failed,\n    /// 底层“掉电”：本句柄及其未同步状态全部作废，需要重新打开存储库。\n    Crashed,\n    /// 非法路径（含路径分隔符或以 `.` 开头等）。\n    BadPath,\n    NotFound,\n}\n\nimpl IoError {\n    pub fn failed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Failed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn crashed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Crashed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn not_found(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::NotFound, context: context.into() }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for IoError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"io error {:?}: {}\", self.kind, self.context)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for IoError {}\n\npub type IoResult<T> = Result<T, IoError>;\n\n/// 可读写、可定位的文件句柄。\npub trait Vfile: Read + Write + Seek + Send {\n    /// 当前文件长度（字节）。\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 把当前文件内容刷到稳定介质；之后崩溃也能保留。\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()>;\n}\n\n/// 文件系统抽象。存储库见到的所有路径都是相对于根目录的单段文件名。\npub trait Vfs: Send {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 打开追加：文件存在则定位到末尾，不存在则创建。\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 新建并截断。\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 文件是否存在。\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool>;\n    /// 文件长度。\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 删除文件。\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 原子改名（目标存在则覆盖）。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 同步名字空间变更（创建/rename/remove 之后调用）。\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 列出目录中的文件名。\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>>;\n    /// 原子写整个文件：tmp + sync + rename + sync_dir。\n    fn atomic_write(&self, path: &str, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let tmp = format!(\"{path}.tmp\");\n        {\n            let mut f = self.create(&tmp)?;\n            write_all_checked(&mut f, data)?;\n            f.sync_file()?;\n        }\n        self.rename(&tmp, path)?;\n        self.sync_dir()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 写入全部字节；短写时内部重试。注入层可以让它只写一部分后报错。\npub fn write_all_check<W: Write + ?Sized>(w: &mut W, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()> {\n    let mut written = 0;\n    while written < data.len() {\n        match w.write(&data[written..]) {\n            Ok(0) => {\n                return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                    \"write returned 0 at {}/{} bytes\",\n                    written,\n                    data.len()\n                )))\n            }\n            Ok(n) => written += n,\n            Err(e) => return Err(IoError::failed(e.to_string())),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 读取整个文件到 Vec。\npub fn read_all(vfs: &dyn Vfs, path: &str) -> IoResult<Vec<u8>> {\n    let mut f = vfs.open_read(path)?;\n    let mut buf = Vec::new();\n    f.read_to_end(&mut buf).map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))?;\n    Ok(buf)\n}\n\nfn validate_path(path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n    if path.is_empty()\n        || path.contains('/')\n        || path.contains('\\\\')\n        || path == \".\"\n        || path == \"..\"\n        || path.starts_with('.')\n    {\n        return Err(IoError { kind: ErrorKind::BadPath, context: format!(\"path {path:?}\") });\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 真实文件系统\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub struct RealFs {\n    root: std::path::PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl RealFs {\n    /// `root` 不存在则创建。\n    pub fn open(root: impl Into<std::path::PathBuf>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let root = root.into();\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&root)?;\n        Ok(RealFs { root })\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> &std::path::Path {\n        &self.root\n    }\n\n    fn full(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<std::path::PathBuf> {\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        Ok(self.root.join(path))\n    }\n}\n\nstruct RealFile {\n    file: std::fs::File,\n}\n\nimpl Read for RealFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.file.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for RealFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.file.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.file.flush()\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for RealFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.file.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for RealFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.file.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.file.sync_all().map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nextern \"C\" {\n    fn fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int;\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealFs {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).open(&p).map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .append(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        Ok(p.exists())\n    }\n\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::metadata(&p).map(|m| m.len()).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::remove_file(&p).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let a = self.full(from)?;\n        let b = self.full(to)?;\n        std::fs::rename(&a, &b).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        // Linux 上打开目录句柄 fsync；非 Unix 退化为 no-op。\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            use std::os::unix::io::AsRawFd;\n            if let Ok(f) = std::fs::File::open(&self.root) {\n                let r = unsafe { fsync(f.as_raw_fd()) };\n                if r != 0 {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                        \"fsync(dir) errno {}\",\n                        std::io::Error::last_os_error()\n                    )));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            let _ = &self.root;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        let rd = std::fs::read_dir(&self.root).map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        for entry in rd {\n            let entry = entry.map_err(map_io_err)?;\n            if entry.file_type().map(|t| t.is_file()).unwrap_or(false) {\n                if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str() {\n                    out.push(name.to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\nfn map_io_err(e: io::Error) -> IoError {\n    if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound {\n        IoError::not_found(e.to_string())\n    } else {\n        IoError::failed(e.to_string())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 故障注入\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// 可注入的操作类别。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum Op {\n    Write,\n    SyncFile,\n    SyncDir,\n    Rename,\n    Create,\n    Remove,\n    OpenAppend,\n}\n\nimpl Op {\n    fn name(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Op::Write => \"write\",\n            Op::SyncFile => \"sync_file\",\n            Op::SyncDir => \"sync_dir\",\n            Op::Rename => \"rename\",\n            Op::Create => \"create\",\n            Op::Remove => \"remove\",\n            Op::OpenAppend => \"open_append\",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一条注入规则：全局第 `when`（从 1 起）次匹配操作按 `fault` 失败。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub when: u64,\n    pub fault: Fault,\n}\n\n/// 注入的故障形态。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum Fault {\n    /// 直接返回 I/O 错误（操作本身不产生任何效果）。\n    Error,\n    /// 短写：仅前 `n` 字节落盘后返回错误。\n    ShortWrite(u64),\n}\n\n/// 故障注入配置。`Arc` 共享，测试中可在存储库运行期间追加规则。\n#[derive(Clone, Default)]\npub struct FaultPlan {\n    inner: Arc<Mutex<Vec<FaultRule>>>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultPlan {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n    pub fn push(&self, rule: FaultRule) {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().push(rule);\n    }\n    pub fn fail_on(op: Op, when: u64) -> Self {\n        let p = Self::new();\n        p.push(FaultRule { op, when, fault: Fault::Error });\n        p\n    }\n\n    /// 取走当前应触发的故障（每条规则只触发一次）。\n    fn take(&self, op: Op) -> Option<Fault> {\n        let mut rules = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        // 递减所有同类规则的计数\n        for r in rules.iter_mut() {\n            if r.op == op && r.when > 0 {\n                r.when -= 1;\n            }\n        }\n        // 取出第一个计数归零的并移除\n        if let Some(pos) = rules.iter().position(|r| r.op == op && r.when == 0) {\n            return Some(rules.remove(pos).fault);\n        }\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// 剩余规则数（测试用）。\n    pub fn remaining(&self) -> usize {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().len()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在任意 [`Vfs`] 外包一层故障注入。\npub struct FaultFs<F: Vfs> {\n    inner: F,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n    counts: Arc<AtomicU64>,\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> FaultFs<F> {\n    pub fn new(inner: F, plan: FaultPlan) -> Self {\n        FaultFs { inner, plan, counts: Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0)) }\n    }\n\n    /// 对“非数据写”操作做注入检查；命中则返回错误且不执行底层操作。\n    fn check(&self, op: Op) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.counts.add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n        if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(op) {\n            return Err(match fault {\n                Fault::Error => IoError::failed(format!(\n                    \"injected {} failure (#{})\",\n                    op.name(),\n                    self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)\n                )),\n                Fault::ShortWrite(_) => IoError::failed(format!(\n                    \"injected short-write fault on non-write op {} (#{})\",\n                    op.name(),\n                    self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)\n                )),\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> Vfs for FaultFs<F> {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        // 读路径不注入。\n        self.inner.open_read(path)\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::OpenAppend)?;\n        let f = self.inner.open_append(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultFile { inner: f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::Create)?;\n        let f = self.inner.create(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultFile { inner: f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.file_len(path)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Remove)?;\n        self.inner.remove(path)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Rename)?;\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::SyncDir)?;\n        self.inner.sync_dir()\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list()\n    }\n}\n\nstruct FaultFile {\n    inner: Box<dyn Vfile>,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n}\n\nimpl Read for FaultFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.inner.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for FaultFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.inner.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for FaultFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        // FaultFile 只实现单块 write；store 统一走 write_all。\n        self.inner.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.flush()\n    }\n    fn write_all(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        // 自定义全程：按注入规则制造“纯失败”或“短写后失败”。\n        let mut written = 0usize;\n        while written < data.len() {\n            if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(Op::Write) {\n                match fault {\n                    Fault::Error => {\n                        return Err(io::Error::other(format!(\n                            \"injected write failure at {}/{}\",\n                            written,\n                            data.len()\n                        )))\n                    }\n                    Fault::ShortWrite(n) => {\n                        let target = written.saturating_add(n as usize).min(data.len());\n                        while written < target {\n                            match self.inner.write(&data[written..target]) {\n                                Ok(0) => return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero, \"zero write\")),\n                                Ok(k) => written += k,\n                                Err(e) => return Err(e),\n                            }\n                        }\n                        return Err(io::Error::other(format!(\n                            \"injected short write: {}/{} bytes landed\",\n                            written,\n                            data.len()\n                        )));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            match self.inner.write(&data[written..]) {\n                Ok(0) => return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero, \"zero write\")),\n                Ok(k) => written += k,\n                Err(e) => return Err(e),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for FaultFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.len()\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if let Some(Fault::Error) = self.plan.take(Op::SyncFile) {\n            return Err(IoError::failed(\"injected sync_file failure\"));\n        }\n        // ShortWrite 对 sync 无意义，按纯失败处理\n        if self.plan.take(Op::SyncFile).is_some() {\n            return Err(IoError::failed(\"injected sync_file failure\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.sync_file()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 内存文件系统 + 崩溃模拟\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// 一个文件节点的全部状态。每个节点有稳定 id（vector 不做删除式压缩）。\n#[derive(Clone)]\nstruct FNode {\n    /// 工作视图中的名字；None 表示已 remove/被 rename 覆盖。\n    work_key: Option<String>,\n    /// 工作视图中的内容；None 表示不存在/已删。\n    work_data: Option<Vec<u8>>,\n    /// 上次 sync_dir 时落盘的名字。\n    committed_key: Option<String>,\n    /// 上次同步点落盘的内容。\n    committed_data: Option<Vec<u8>>,\n}\n\nstruct SimState {\n    nodes: Vec<FNode>,\n}\n\n/// 内存文件系统的共享内核；[`SimDisk::crash_and_reboot`] 丢弃未落盘状态。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct SimDisk {\n    state: Arc<Mutex<SimState>>,\n    /// 每次 reboot 自增，旧句柄携带旧代号，崩溃后再用即报 Crashed。\n    epoch: Arc<Mutex<u64>>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for SimDisk {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl SimDisk {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        SimDisk {\n            state: Arc::new(Mutex::new(SimState { nodes: Vec::new() })),\n            epoch: Arc::new(Mutex::new(0)),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 模拟掉电重启：\n    /// - 未 `sync_file` 的文件内容回滚到上次同步点；\n    /// - 未 `sync_dir` 的创建/rename/remove 整体回滚（原子，不含中间态）。\n    pub fn crash_and_reboot(&self) {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        for node in st.nodes.iter_mut() {\n            node.work_key = node.committed_key.clone();\n            node.work_data = node.committed_data.clone();\n        }\n        *self.epoch.lock().unwrap() += 1;\n    }\n\n    /// 当前已“落盘”的文件名 → 大小（测试断言用）。\n    pub fn committed_snapshot(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, usize> {\n        let st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut out = BTreeMap::new();\n        for n in &st.nodes {\n            if let (Some(k), Some(d)) = (&n.committed_key, &n.committed_data) {\n                out.insert(k.clone(), d.len());\n            }\n        }\n        out\n    }\n}\n\n/// 基于 [`SimDisk`] 的 [`Vfs`]。崩溃后必须新建 `SimFs`（旧实例句柄全部失效）。\npub struct SimFs {\n    disk: SimDisk,\n    epoch: u64,\n}\n\nimpl SimFs {\n    pub fn new(disk: SimDisk) -> Self {\n        let epoch = *disk.epoch.lock().unwrap();\n        SimFs { disk, epoch }\n    }\n\n    fn check_epoch(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if *self.disk.epoch.lock().unwrap() != self.epoch {\n            return Err(IoError::crashed(\"simfs handle belongs to a pre-crash epoch\"));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn find_work(&self, st: &SimState, path: &str) -> Option<usize> {\n        st.nodes.iter().position(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path))\n    }\n}\n\nstruct SimFile {\n    disk: SimDisk,\n    epoch: u64,\n    id: usize,\n    pos: u64,\n}\n\nimpl SimFile {\n    fn alive(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if *self.disk.epoch.lock().unwrap() != self.epoch {\n            return Err(IoError::crashed(\"sim file handle from before crash\"));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for SimFs {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let id = self\n            .find_work(&st, path)\n            .filter(|&i| st.nodes[i].work_data.is_some())\n            .ok_or_else(|| IoError::not_found(format!(\"sim open_read {path}\")))?;\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: 0 }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let (id, len) = {\n            let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(id) = self.find_work(&st, path) {\n                let len = st.nodes[id].work_data.as_ref().map(|d| d.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0);\n                (id, len)\n            } else {\n                let id = st.nodes.len();\n                st.nodes.push(FNode {\n                    work_key: Some(path.to_string()),\n                    work_data: Some(Vec::new()),\n                    committed_key: None,\n                    committed_data: None,\n                });\n                (id, 0)\n            }\n        };\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: len }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let id = {\n            let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(id) = self.find_work(&st, path) {\n                // 截断工作视图；已提交旧版本保留在 committed_*，sync_dir 前崩溃可回滚。\n                st.nodes[id].work_data = Some(Vec::new());\n                id\n            } else {\n                let id = st.nodes.len();\n                st.nodes.push(FNode {\n                    work_key: Some(path.to_string()),\n                    work_data: Some(Vec::new()),\n                    committed_key: None,\n                    committed_data: None,\n                });\n                id\n            }\n        };\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: 0 }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        Ok(self.find_work(&st, path).is_some_and(|i| st.nodes[i].work_data.is_some()))\n    }\n\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.nodes\n            .iter()\n            .find(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path))\n            .and_then(|n| n.work_data.as_ref())\n            .map(|d| d.len() as u64)\n            .ok_or_else(|| IoError::not_found(format!(\"sim file_len {path}\")))\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n   }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(from)?;\n        validate_path(to)?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let src = self\n            .find_work(&st, from)\n            .ok_or_else(|| IoError::not_found(format!(\"sim rename {from}\")))?;\n        if let Some(dst) = self.find_work(&st, to) {\n            if dst != src {\n                // 覆盖目标：从工作视图摘除。其 committed_* 仍保留，\n                // sync_dir 前崩溃，rollback 会让旧目标文件复活。\n     data[pos..existing_end].copy_from_slice(&buf[..existing_end - pos]);\n            if pos + buf.len() > data.len() {\n                data.extend_from_slice(&buf[existing_end - pos..]);\n sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.alive()?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        // 提交文件内容；名字是否可见仍由 sync_dir 决定（committed_key 不动）。\n        let snapshot = assert!(!fs.exists(\"index.json.tmp\").unwrap());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn simfs_crash_during_rename_window_keeps_old_target() {\n        // 覆盖式 rename 已发生但目录未同步 -> 旧目标复活，来源 tmp 也消失\n        let 可注入的 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 存储库 [`crate::store`] 不直接调用 `std::fs`，而是依赖 [`Vfs`] trait：\n//!\n//! - [`RealFs`]：真实磁盘实现（生产路径）。\n//! - [`FaultFs`]：包装任意内部 `Vfs`，按调用次数注入 I/O 错误、短写，\n//!   用于验证存储库的错误传播与“写入失败后不损坏已确认数据”。\n//! - [`SimFs`]：纯内存文件系统，显式 [`SimDisk::crash_and_reboot`] 把尚未\n//!   `sync_file`/`sync_dir` 的状态全部丢掉，精确模拟掉电瞬间。\n//!\n//! ## 同步边界（durability 语义）\n//!\n//! - `write_all` 只改变文件当前内容；`sync_file` 后该文件内容才算落盘。\n//! - 创建/重命名/删除等名字空间变更只有在 `sync_dir` 后才算落盘。\n//! - `atomic_write(path, data)` 的实现是：写 `path.tmp` → sync 文件 →\n//!   rename → sync 目录；崩溃后只可能看到旧文件或新文件，绝不看到半截新文件。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// I/O 错误（消息文本固定，便于测试断言）。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct IoError {\n    pub kind: ErrorKind,\n    pub context: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ErrorKind {\n    /// 由故障注入或底层系统返回的普通 I/O 错误。\n    Failed,\n    /// 底层“掉电”：本句柄及其未同步状态全部作废，需要重新打开存储库。\n    Crashed,\n    /// 非法路径（含路径分隔符或以 `.` 开头等）。\n    BadPath,\n    NotFound,\n}\n\nimpl IoError {\n    pub fn failed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Failed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn crashed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Crashed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn not_found(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::NotFound, context: context.into() }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for IoError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"io error {:?}: {}\", self.kind, self.context)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for IoError {}\n\npub type IoResult<T> = Result<T, IoError>;\n\n/// 可读写、可定位的文件句柄。\npub trait Vfile: Read + Write + Seek + Send {\n    /// 当前文件长度（字节）。\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 把当前文件内容刷到稳定介质；之后崩溃也能保留。\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()>;\n}\n\n/// 文件系统抽象。存储库见到的所有路径都是相对于根目录的单段文件名。\npub trait Vfs: Send {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 打开追加：文件存在则定位到末尾，不存在则创建。\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 新建并截断。\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 文件是否存在。\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool>;\n    /// 文件长度。\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 删除文件。\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 原子改名（目标存在则覆盖）。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 同步名字空间变更（创建/rename/remove 之后调用）。\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 列出目录中的文件名。\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>>;\n    /// 原子写整个文件：tmp + sync + rename + sync_dir。\n    fn atomic_write(&self, path: &str, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let tmp = format!(\"{path}.tmp\");\n        {\n            let mut f = self.create(&tmp)?;\n            write_all_checked(&mut f, data)?;\n            f.sync_file()?;\n        }\n        self.rename(&tmp, path)?;\n        self.sync_dir()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 写入全部字节；短写时内部重试。注入层可以让它只写一部分后报错。\npub fn write_all_check<W: Write + ?Sized>(w: &mut W, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()> {\n    let mut written = 0;\n    while written < data.len() {\n        match w.write(&data[written..]) {\n            Ok(0) => {\n                return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                    \"write returned 0 at {}/{} bytes\",\n                    written,\n                    data.len()\n                )))\n            }\n            Ok(n) => written += n,\n            Err(e) => return Err(IoError::failed(e.to_string())),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 读取整个文件到 Vec。\npub fn read_all(vfs: &dyn Vfs, path: &str) -> IoResult<Vec<u8>> {\n    let mut f = vfs.open_read(path)?;\n    let mut buf = Vec::new();\n    f.read_to_end(&mut buf).map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))?;\n    Ok(buf)\n}\n\nfn validate_path(path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n    if path.is_empty()\n        || path.contains('/')\n        || path.contains('\\\\')\n        || path == \".\"\n        || path == \"..\"\n        || path.starts_with('.')\n    {\n        return Err(IoError { kind: ErrorKind::BadPath, context: format!(\"path {path:?}\") });\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 真实文件系统\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub struct RealFs {\n    root: std::path::PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl RealFs {\n    /// `root` 不存在则创建。\n    pub fn open(root: impl Into<std::path::PathBuf>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let root = root.into();\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&root)?;\n        Ok(RealFs { root })\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> &std::path::Path {\n        &self.root\n    }\n\n    fn full(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<std::path::PathBuf> {\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        Ok(self.root.join(path))\n    }\n}\n\nstruct RealFile {\n    file: std::fs::File,\n}\n\nimpl Read for RealFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.file.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for RealFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.file.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.file.flush()\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for RealFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.file.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for RealFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.file.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.file.sync_all().map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nextern \"C\" {\n    fn fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int;\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealFs {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).open(&p).map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .append(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        Ok(p.exists())\n    }\n\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::metadata(&p).map(|m| m.len()).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::remove_file(&p).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let a = self.full(from)?;\n        let b = self.full(to)?;\n        std::fs::rename(&a, &b).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        // Linux 上打开目录句柄 fsync；非 Unix 退化为 no-op。\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            use std::os::unix::io::AsRawFd;\n            if let Ok(f) = std::fs::File::open(&self.root) {\n                let r = unsafe { fsync(f.as_raw_fd()) };\n                if r != 0 {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                        \"fsync(dir) errno {}\",\n                        std::io::Error::last_os_error()\n                    )));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            let _ = &self.root;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        let rd = std::fs::read_dir(&self.root).map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        for entry in rd {\n            let entry = entry.map_err(map_io_err)?;\n            if entry.file_type().map(|t| t.is_file()).unwrap_or(false) {\n                if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str() {\n                    out.push(name.to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\nfn map_io_err(e: io::Error) -> IoError {\n    if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound {\n        IoError::not_found(e.to_string())\n    } else {\n        IoError::failed(e.to_string())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 故障注入\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// 可注入的操作类别。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum Op {\n    Write,\n    SyncFile,\n    SyncDir,\n    Rename,\n    Create,\n    Remove,\n    OpenAppend,\n}\n\nimpl Op {\n    fn name(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Op::Write => \"write\",\n            Op::SyncFile => \"sync_file\",\n            Op::SyncDir => \"sync_dir\",\n            Op::Rename => \"rename\",\n            Op::Create => \"create\",\n            Op::Remove => \"remove\",\n            Op::OpenAppend => \"open_append\",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一条注入规则：全局第 `when`（从 1 起）次匹配操作按 `fault` 失败。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub when: u64,\n    pub fault: Fault,\n}\n\n/// 注入的故障形态。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum Fault {\n    /// 直接返回 I/O 错误（操作本身不产生任何效果）。\n    Error,\n    /// 短写：仅前 `n` 字节落盘后返回错误。\n    ShortWrite(u64),\n}\n\n/// 故障注入配置。`Arc` 共享，测试中可在存储库运行期间追加规则。\n#[derive(Clone, Default)]\npub struct FaultPlan {\n    inner: Arc<Mutex<Vec<FaultRule>>>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultPlan {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n    pub fn push(&self, rule: FaultRule) {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().push(rule);\n    }\n    pub fn fail_on(op: Op, when: u64) -> Self {\n        let p = Self::new();\n        p.push(FaultRule { op, when, fault: Fault::Error });\n        p\n    }\n\n    /// 取走当前应触发的故障（每条规则只触发一次）。\n    fn take(&self, op: Op) -> Option<Fault> {\n        let mut rules = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        // 递减所有同类规则的计数\n        for r in rules.iter_mut() {\n            if r.op == op && r.when > 0 {\n                r.when -= 1;\n            }\n        }\n        // 取出第一个计数归零的并移除\n        if let Some(pos) = rules.iter().position(|r| r.op == op && r.when == 0) {\n            return Some(rules.remove(pos).fault);\n        }\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// 剩余规则数（测试用）。\n    pub fn remaining(&self) -> usize {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().len()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在任意 [`Vfs`] 外包一层故障注入。\npub struct FaultFs<F: Vfs> {\n    inner: F,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n    counts: Arc<AtomicU64>,\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> FaultFs<F> {\n    pub fn new(inner: F, plan: FaultPlan) -> Self {\n        FaultFs { inner, plan, counts: Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0)) }\n    }\n\n    /// 对“非数据写”操作做注入检查；命中则返回错误且不执行底层操作。\n    fn check(&self, op: Op) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.counts.add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n        if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(op) {\n            return Err(match fault {\n                Fault::Error => IoError::failed(format!(\n                    \"injected {} failure (#{})\",\n                    op.name(),\n                    self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)\n                )),\n                Fault::ShortWrite(_) => IoError::failed(format!(\n                    \"injected short-write fault on non-write op {} (#{})\",\n                    op.name(),\n                    self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)\n                )),\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> Vfs for FaultFs<F> {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        // 读路径不注入。\n        self.inner.open_read(path)\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::OpenAppend)?;\n        let f = self.inner.open_append(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultFile { inner: f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::Create)?;\n        let f = self.inner.create(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultFile { inner: f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.file_len(path)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Remove)?;\n        self.inner.remove(path)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Rename)?;\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::SyncDir)?;\n        self.inner.sync_dir()\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list()\n    }\n}\n\nstruct FaultFile {\n    inner: Box<dyn Vfile>,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n}\n\nimpl Read for FaultFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.inner.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for FaultFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.inner.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for FaultFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        // FaultFile 只实现单块 write；store 统一走 write_all。\n        self.inner.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.flush()\n    }\n    fn write_all(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        // 自定义全程：按注入规则制造“纯失败”或“短写后失败”。\n        let mut written = 0usize;\n        while written < data.len() {\n            if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(Op::Write) {\n                match fault {\n                    Fault::Error => {\n                        return Err(io::Error::other(format!(\n                            \"injected write failure at {}/{}\",\n                            written,\n                            data.len()\n                        )))\n                    }\n                    Fault::ShortWrite(n) => {\n                        let target = written.saturating_add(n as usize).min(data.len());\n                        while written < target {\n                            match self.inner.write(&data[written..target]) {\n                                Ok(0) => return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero, \"zero write\")),\n                                Ok(k) => written += k,\n                                Err(e) => return Err(e),\n                            }\n                        }\n                        return Err(io::Error::other(format!(\n                            \"injected short write: {}/{} bytes landed\",\n                            written,\n                            data.len()\n                        )));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            match self.inner.write(&data[written..]) {\n                Ok(0) => return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero, \"zero write\")),\n                Ok(k) => written += k,\n                Err(e) => return Err(e),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for FaultFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.len()\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if let Some(Fault::Error) = self.plan.take(Op::SyncFile) {\n            return Err(IoError::failed(\"injected sync_file failure\"));\n        }\n        // ShortWrite 对 sync 无意义，按纯失败处理\n        if self.plan.take(Op::SyncFile).is_some() {\n            return Err(IoError::failed(\"injected sync_file failure\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.sync_file()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 内存文件系统 + 崩溃模拟\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// 一个文件节点的全部状态。每个节点有稳定 id（vector 不做删除式压缩）。\n#[derive(Clone)]\nstruct FNode {\n    /// 工作视图中的名字；None 表示已 remove/被 rename 覆盖。\n    work_key: Option<String>,\n    /// 工作视图中的内容；None 表示不存在/已删。\n    work_data: Option<Vec<u8>>,\n    /// 上次 sync_dir 时落盘的名字。\n    committed_key: Option<String>,\n    /// 上次同步点落盘的内容。\n    committed_data: Option<Vec<u8>>,\n}\n\nstruct SimState {\n    nodes: Vec<FNode>,\n}\n\n/// 内存文件系统的共享内核；[`SimDisk::crash_and_reboot`] 丢弃未落盘状态。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct SimDisk {\n    state: Arc<Mutex<SimState>>,\n    /// 每次 reboot 自增，旧句柄携带旧代号，崩溃后再用即报 Crashed。\n    epoch: Arc<Mutex<u64>>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for SimDisk {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl SimDisk {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        SimDisk {\n            state: Arc::new(Mutex::new(SimState { nodes: Vec::new() })),\n            epoch: Arc::new(Mutex::new(0)),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 模拟掉电重启：\n    /// - 未 `sync_file` 的文件内容回滚到上次同步点；\n    /// - 未 `sync_dir` 的创建/rename/remove 整体回滚（原子，不含中间态）。\n    pub fn crash_and_reboot(&self) {\n        let mut st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        for node in st.nodes.iter_mut() {\n            node.work_key = node.committed_key.clone();\n            node.work_data = node.committed_data.clone();\n        }\n        *self.epoch.lock().unwrap() += 1;\n    }\n\n    /// 当前已“落盘”的文件名 → 大小（测试断言用）。\n    pub fn committed_snapshot(&self) -> BTreeMap<String, usize> {\n        let st = self.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut out = BTreeMap::new();\n        for n in &st.nodes {\n            if let (Some(k), Some(d)) = (&n.committed_key, &n.committed_data) {\n                out.insert(k.clone(), d.len());\n            }\n        }\n        out\n    }\n}\n\n/// 基于 [`SimDisk`] 的 [`Vfs`]。崩溃后必须新建 `SimFs`（旧实例句柄全部失效）。\npub struct SimFs {\n    disk: SimDisk,\n    epoch: u64,\n}\n\nimpl SimFs {\n    pub fn new(disk: SimDisk) -> Self {\n        let epoch = *disk.epoch.lock().unwrap();\n        SimFs { disk, epoch }\n    }\n\n    fn check_epoch(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if *self.disk.epoch.lock().unwrap() != self.epoch {\n            return Err(IoError::crashed(\"simfs handle belongs to a pre-crash epoch\"));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn find_work(&self, st: &SimState, path: &str) -> Option<usize> {\n        st.nodes.iter().position(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path))\n    }\n}\n\nstruct SimFile {\n    disk: SimDisk,\n    epoch: u64,\n    id: usize,\n    pos: u64,\n}\n\nimpl SimFile {\n    fn alive(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if *self.disk.epoch.lock().unwrap() != self.epoch {\n            return Err(IoError::crashed(\"sim file handle from before crash\"));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for SimFs {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let id = self\n            .find_work(&st, path)\n            .filter(|&i| st.nodes[i].work_data.is_some())\n            .ok_or_else(|| IoError::not_found(format!(\"sim open_read {path}\")))?;\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: 0 }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let (id, len) = {\n            let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(id) = self.find_work(&st, path) {\n                let len = st.nodes[id].work_data.as_ref().map(|d| d.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0);\n                (id, len)\n            } else {\n                let id = st.nodes.len();\n                st.nodes.push(FNode {\n                    work_key: Some(path.to_string()),\n                    work_data: Some(Vec::new()),\n                    committed_key: None,\n                    committed_data: None,\n                });\n                (id, 0)\n            }\n        };\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: len }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        let id = {\n            let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            if let Some(id) = self.find_work(&st, path) {\n                // 截断工作视图；已提交旧版本保留在 committed_*，sync_dir 前崩溃可回滚。\n                st.nodes[id].work_data = Some(Vec::new());\n                id\n            } else {\n                let id = st.nodes.len();\n                st.nodes.push(FNode {\n                    work_key: Some(path.to_string()),\n                    work_data: Some(Vec::new()),\n                    committed_key: None,\n                    committed_data: None,\n                });\n                id\n            }\n        };\n        Ok(Box::new(SimFile { disk: self.disk.clone(), epoch: self.epoch, id, pos: 0 }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        Ok(self.find_work(&st, path).is_some_and(|i| st.nodes[i].work_data.is_some()))\n    }\n\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        st.nodes\n            .iter()\n            .find(|n| n.work_key.as_deref() == Some(path))\n            .and_then(|n| n.work_data.as_ref())\n            .map(|d| d.len() as u64)\n            .ok_or_else(|| IoError::not_found(format!(\"sim file_len {path}\")))\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        if let Some(id) = self.find_work(&st, path) {\n            st.nodes[id].work_key = None;\n            st.nodes[id].work_data = None;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        validate_path(from)?;\n        validate_path(to)?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let src = self\n            .find_work(&st, from)\n            .ok_or_else(|| IoError::not_found(format!(\"sim rename {from}\")))?;\n        if let Some(dst) = self.find_work(&st, to) {\n            if dst != src {\n                // 覆盖目标：从工作视图摘除。其 committed_* 仍保留，\n                // sync_dir 前崩溃，rollback 会让旧目标文件复活。\n                st.nodes[dst].work_key = None;\n                st.nodes[dst].work_data = None;\n            }\n        }\n        st.nodes[src].work_key = Some(to.to_string());\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        // 原子提交所有工作视图状态。存储库总是先 sync_file 再操作名字空间，\n        // 因此此时提交内容与 POSIX 下 fsync 文件 + fsync 目录等价。\n        for n in st.nodes.iter_mut() {\n            n.committed_key = n.work_key.clone();\n            n.committed_data = n.work_data.clone();\n        }\n        // 清理两边都不存在的墓碑节点\n        st.nodes.retain(|n| n.committed_key.is_some() || n.work_key.is_some());\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        self.check_epoch()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let mut out: Vec<String> = st\n            .nodes\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|n| n.work_key.clone().filter(|_| n.work_data.is_some()))\n            .collect();\n        out.sort();\n        out.dedup();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Read for SimFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.alive().map_err(io_err)?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = st.nodes[self.id]\n            .work_data\n            .as_ref()\n            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"file deleted\"))?;\n        let pos = self.pos as usize;\n        if pos >= data.len() {\n            return Ok(0);\n        }\n        let n = buf.len().min(data.len() - pos);\n        buf[..n].copy_from_slice(&data[pos..pos + n]);\n        self.pos += n as u64;\n        Ok(n)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Seek for SimFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.alive().map_err(io_err)?;\n        let len = {\n            let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n            st.nodes[self.id].work_data.as_ref().map(|d| d.len() as i64).unwrap_or(0)\n        };\n        let new_pos: i64 = match pos {\n            SeekFrom::Start(n) => n as i64,\n            SeekFrom::Current(n) => self.pos as i64 + n,\n            SeekFrom::End(n) => len + n,\n        };\n        if new_pos < 0 {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, \"negative seek\"));\n        }\n        self.pos = new_pos as u64;\n        Ok(self.pos)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Write for SimFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.alive().map_err(io_err)?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        let data = st.nodes[self.id]\n            .work_data\n            .as_mut()\n            .ok_or_else(|| io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, \"file deleted\"))?;\n        let pos = self.pos as usize;\n        if pos > data.len() {\n            return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, \"write past end\"));\n        }\n        if pos == data.len() {\n            data.extend_from_slice(buf);\n        } else {\n            let existing_end = (pos + buf.len()).min(data.len());\n            data[pos..existing_end].copy_from_slice(&buf[..existing_end - pos]);\n            if pos + buf.len() > data.len() {\n                data.extend_from_slice(&buf[existing_end - pos..]);\n            }\n        }\n        self.pos += buf.len() as u64;\n        Ok(buf.len())\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Vfile for SimFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.alive()?;\n        let st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        Ok(st.nodes[self.id].work_data.as_ref().map(|d| d.len() as u64).unwrap_or(0))\n    }\n\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.alive()?;\n        let mut st = self.disk.state.lock().unwrap();\n        // 提交文件内容；名字是否可见仍由 sync_dir 决定（committed_key 不动）。\n        let snapshot = st.nodes[self.id].work_data.clone();\n        st.nodes[self.id].committed_data = snapshot;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nfn io_err(e: IoError) -> io::Error {\n    match e.kind {\n        ErrorKind::Crashed => io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::BrokenPipe, e.to_string()),\n        ErrorKind::NotFound => io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::NotFound, e.to_string()),\n        _ => io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::Other, e.to_string()),\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    fn write_read(vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<Vec<u8>> {\n        {\n            let mut f = vfs.create(\"a.log\")?;\n            write_all_check(&mut f, b\"hello\")?;\n            f.sync_file()?;\n        }\n        vfs.sync_dir()?;\n        read_all(vfs, \"a.log\")\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn realfs_roundtrip_in_tempdir() {\n        let tmp = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\"seglog-vfs-{}\", std::process::id()));\n        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp);\n        let fs = RealFs::open(&tmp).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(write_read(&fs).unwrap(), b\"hello\");\n        std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp).ok();\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn simfs_basic_roundtrip() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::new();\n        let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n        assert_eq!(write_read(&fs).unwrap(), b\"hello\");\n        assert_eq!(disk.committed_snapshot().get(\"a.log\"), Some(&5));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn simfs_crash_rolls_back_unsynced_writes() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::new();\n        {\n            let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n            let mut f = fs.open_append(\"seg.log\").unwrap();\n            write_all_check(&mut f, b\"durable\").unwrap();\n            f.sync_file().unwrap();\n            fs.sync_dir().unwrap();\n            write_all_check(&mut f, b\"-lost\").unwrap();\n            // 未 sync 即崩溃\n            disk.crash_and_reboot();\n        }\n        let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n        assert_eq!(read_all(&fs, \"seg.log\").unwrap(), b\"durable\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn simfs_crash_rolls_back_uncommitted_rename() {\n        let disk = SimDisk::new();\n        {\n            let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n            fs.atomic_write(\"index.json\", b\"v1\").unwrap();\n            // 开始一次原子更新，但在 sync_dir 前崩溃\n            {\n                let mut f = fs.create(\"index.json.tmp\").unwrap();\n                write_all_check(&mut f, b\"v2\").unwrap();\n                f.sync_file().unwrap();\n            }\n            fs.rename(\"index.json.tmp\", \"index.json\").unwrap();\n            disk.crash_and_reboot();\n        }\n        let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n        assert_eq!(read_all(&fs, \"index.json\").unwrap(), b\"v1\");\n        assert!(!fs.exists(\"index.json.tmp\").unwrap());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn simfs_crash_during_rename_window_keeps_old_target() {\n        // 覆盖式 rename 已发生但目录未同步 -> 旧目标复活，来源 tmp 也消失\n        let disk = SimDisk::new();\n        {\n            let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n            fs.atomic_write(\"index.json\", b\"old\").unwrap();\n            {\n                let mut f = \"index.json\").unwrap();\n            disk.crash_and_reboot();\n        }\n        let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n        assert_eq!(read_all(&fs, \"index.json\").unwrap(), b\"old\");\n 可注入的 I/O 层。\n//!\n//! 存储库 [`crate::store`] 不直接调用 `std::fs`，而是依赖 [`Vfs`] trait：\n//!\n//! - [`RealFs`]：真实磁盘实现（生产路径）。\n//! - [`FaultFs`]：包装任意内部 `Vfs`，按调用次数注入 I/O 错误、短写，\n//!   用于验证存储库的错误传播与“写入失败后不损坏已确认数据”。\n//! - [`SimFs`]：纯内存文件系统，显式 [`SimDisk::crash_and_reboot`] 把尚未\n//!   `sync_file`/`sync_dir` 的状态全部丢掉，精确模拟掉电瞬间。\n//!\n//! ## 同步边界（durability 语义）\n//!\n//! - `write_all` 只改变文件当前内容；`sync_file` 后该文件内容才算落盘。\n//! - 创建/重命名/删除等名字空间变更只有在 `sync_dir` 后才算落盘。\n//! - `atomic_write(path, data)` 的实现是：写 `path.tmp` → sync 文件 →\n//!   rename → sync 目录；崩溃后只可能看到旧文件或新文件，绝不看到半截新文件。\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::io::{self, Read, Seek, SeekFrom, Write};\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\n/// I/O 错误（消息文本固定，便于测试断言）。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct IoError {\n    pub kind: ErrorKind,\n    pub context: String,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ErrorKind {\n    /// 由故障注入或底层系统返回的普通 I/O 错误。\n    Failed,\n    /// 底层“掉电”：本句柄及其未同步状态全部作废，需要重新打开存储库。\n    Crashed,\n    /// 非法路径（含路径分隔符或以 `.` 开头等）。\n    BadPath,\n    NotFound,\n}\n\nimpl IoError {\n    pub fn failed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Failed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn crashed(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::Crashed, context: context.into() }\n    }\n    pub fn not_found(context: impl Into<String>) -> Self {\n        IoError { kind: ErrorKind::NotFound, context: context.into() }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for IoError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"io error {:?}: {}\", self.kind, self.context)\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for IoError {}\n\npub type IoResult<T> = Result<T, IoError>;\n\n/// 可读写、可定位的文件句柄。\npub trait Vfile: Read + Write + Seek + Send {\n    /// 当前文件长度（字节）。\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 把当前文件内容刷到稳定介质；之后崩溃也能保留。\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()>;\n}\n\n/// 文件系统抽象。存储库见到的所有路径都是相对于根目录的单段文件名。\npub trait Vfs: Send {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 打开追加：文件存在则定位到末尾，不存在则创建。\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 新建并截断。\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>>;\n    /// 文件是否存在。\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool>;\n    /// 文件长度。\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64>;\n    /// 删除文件。\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 原子改名（目标存在则覆盖）。\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 同步名字空间变更（创建/rename/remove 之后调用）。\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()>;\n    /// 列出目录中的文件名。\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>>;\n    /// 原子写整个文件：tmp + sync + rename + sync_dir。\n    fn atomic_write(&self, path: &str, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let tmp = format!(\"{path}.tmp\");\n        {\n            let mut f = self.create(&tmp)?;\n            write_all_checked(&mut f, data)?;\n            f.sync_file()?;\n        }\n        self.rename(&tmp, path)?;\n        self.sync_dir()?;\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 写入全部字节；短写时内部重试。注入层可以让它只写一部分后报错。\npub fn write_all_check<W: Write + ?Sized>(w: &mut W, data: &[u8]) -> IoResult<()> {\n    let mut written = 0;\n    while written < data.len() {\n        match w.write(&data[written..]) {\n            Ok(0) => {\n                return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                    \"write returned 0 at {}/{} bytes\",\n                    written,\n                    data.len()\n                )))\n            }\n            Ok(n) => written += n,\n            Err(e) => return Err(IoError::failed(e.to_string())),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// 读取整个文件到 Vec。\npub fn read_all(vfs: &dyn Vfs, path: &str) -> IoResult<Vec<u8>> {\n    let mut f = vfs.open_read(path)?;\n    let mut buf = Vec::new();\n    f.read_to_end(&mut buf).map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))?;\n    Ok(buf)\n}\n\nfn validate_path(path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n    if path.is_empty()\n        || path.contains('/')\n        || path.contains('\\\\')\n        || path == \".\"\n        || path == \"..\"\n        || path.starts_with('.')\n    {\n        return Err(IoError { kind: ErrorKind::BadPath, context: format!(\"path {path:?}\") });\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 真实文件系统\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub struct RealFs {\n    root: std::path::PathBuf,\n}\n\nimpl RealFs {\n    /// `root` 不存在则创建。\n    pub fn open(root: impl Into<std::path::PathBuf>) -> io::Result<Self> {\n        let root = root.into();\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&root)?;\n        Ok(RealFs { root })\n    }\n\n    pub fn root(&self) -> &std::path::Path {\n        &self.root\n    }\n\n    fn full(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<std::path::PathBuf> {\n        validate_path(path)?;\n        Ok(self.root.join(path))\n    }\n}\n\nstruct RealFile {\n    file: std::fs::File,\n}\n\nimpl Read for RealFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.file.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for RealFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.file.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.file.flush()\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for RealFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.file.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for RealFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.file.metadata().map(|m| m.len()).map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.file.sync_all().map_err(|e| IoError::failed(e.to_string()))\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nextern \"C\" {\n    fn fsync(fd: std::os::unix::io::RawFd) -> std::os::raw::c_int;\n}\n\nimpl Vfs for RealFs {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new().read(true).open(&p).map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .append(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        let f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create(true)\n            .truncate(true)\n            .open(&p)\n            .map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { file: f }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        Ok(p.exists())\n    }\n\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::metadata(&p).map(|m| m.len()).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let p = self.full(path)?;\n        std::fs::remove_file(&p).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        let a = self.full(from)?;\n        let b = self.full(to)?;\n        std::fs::rename(&a, &b).map_err(map_io_err)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        // Linux 上打开目录句柄 fsync；非 Unix 退化为 no-op。\n        #[cfg(unix)]\n        {\n            use std::os::unix::io::AsRawFd;\n            if let Ok(f) = std::fs::File::open(&self.root) {\n                let r = unsafe { fsync(f.as_raw_fd()) };\n                if r != 0 {\n                    return Err(IoError::failed(format!(\n                        \"fsync(dir) errno {}\",\n                        std::io::Error::last_os_error()\n                    )));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        #[cfg(not(unix))]\n        {\n            let _ = &self.root;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        let mut out = Vec::new();\n        let rd = std::fs::read_dir(&self.root).map_err(map_io_err)?;\n        for entry in rd {\n            let entry = entry.map_err(map_io_err)?;\n            if entry.file_type().map(|t| t.is_file()).unwrap_or(false) {\n                if let Some(name) = entry.file_name().to_str() {\n                    out.push(name.to_string());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        out.sort();\n        Ok(out)\n    }\n}\n\nfn map_io_err(e: io::Error) -> IoError {\n    if e.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound {\n        IoError::not_found(e.to_string())\n    } else {\n        IoError::failed(e.to_string())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 故障注入\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// 可注入的操作类别。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum Op {\n    Write,\n    SyncFile,\n    SyncDir,\n    Rename,\n    Create,\n    Remove,\n    OpenAppend,\n}\n\nimpl Op {\n    fn name(self) -> &'static str {\n        match self {\n            Op::Write => \"write\",\n            Op::SyncFile => \"sync_file\",\n            Op::SyncDir => \"sync_dir\",\n            Op::Rename => \"rename\",\n            Op::Create => \"create\",\n            Op::Remove => \"remove\",\n            Op::OpenAppend => \"open_append\",\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// 一条注入规则：全局第 `when`（从 1 起）次匹配操作按 `fault` 失败。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct FaultRule {\n    pub op: Op,\n    pub when: u64,\n    pub fault: Fault,\n}\n\n/// 注入的故障形态。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub enum Fault {\n    /// 直接返回 I/O 错误（操作本身不产生任何效果）。\n    Error,\n    /// 短写：仅前 `n` 字节落盘后返回错误。\n    ShortWrite(u64),\n}\n\n/// 故障注入配置。`Arc` 共享，测试中可在存储库运行期间追加规则。\n#[derive(Clone, Default)]\npub struct FaultPlan {\n    inner: Arc<Mutex<Vec<FaultRule>>>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultPlan {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n    pub fn push(&self, rule: FaultRule) {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().push(rule);\n    }\n    pub fn fail_on(op: Op, when: u64) -> Self {\n        let p = Self::new();\n        p.push(FaultRule { op, when, fault: Fault::Error });\n        p\n    }\n\n    /// 取走当前应触发的故障（每条规则只触发一次）。\n    fn take(&self, op: Op) -> Option<Fault> {\n        let mut rules = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        // 递减所有同类规则的计数\n        for r in rules.iter_mut() {\n            if r.op == op && r.when > 0 {\n                r.when -= 1;\n            }\n        }\n        // 取出第一个计数归零的并移除\n        if let Some(pos) = rules.iter().position(|r| r.op == op && r.when == 0) {\n            return Some(rules.remove(pos).fault);\n        }\n        None\n    }\n\n    /// 剩余规则数（测试用）。\n    pub fn remaining(&self) -> usize {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().len()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 在任意 [`Vfs`] 外包一层故障注入。\npub struct FaultFs<F: Vfs> {\n    inner: F,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n    counts: Arc<AtomicU64>,\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> FaultFs<F> {\n    pub fn new(inner: F, plan: FaultPlan) -> Self {\n        FaultFs { inner, plan, counts: Arc::new(AtomicU64::new(0)) }\n    }\n\n    /// 对“非数据写”操作做注入检查；命中则返回错误且不执行底层操作。\n    fn check(&self, op: Op) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.counts.add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);\n        if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(op) {\n            return Err(match fault {\n                Fault::Error => IoError::failed(format!(\n                    \"injected {} failure (#{})\",\n                    op.name(),\n                    self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)\n                )),\n                Fault::ShortWrite(_) => IoError::failed(format!(\n                    \"injected short-write fault on non-write op {} (#{})\",\n                    op.name(),\n                    self.counts.load(Ordering::SeqCst)\n                )),\n            });\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl<F: Vfs> Vfs for FaultFs<F> {\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        // 读路径不注入。\n        self.inner.open_read(path)\n    }\n\n    fn open_append(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::OpenAppend)?;\n        let f = self.inner.open_append(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultFile { inner: f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn create(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<Box<dyn Vfile>> {\n        self.check(Op::Create)?;\n        let f = self.inner.create(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultFile { inner: f, plan: self.plan.clone() }))\n    }\n\n    fn exists(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<bool> {\n        self.inner.exists(path)\n    }\n    fn file_len(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.file_len(path)\n    }\n\n    fn remove(&self, path: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Remove)?;\n        self.inner.remove(path)\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &str, to: &str) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::Rename)?;\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        self.check(Op::SyncDir)?;\n        self.inner.sync_dir()\n    }\n\n    fn list(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<String>> {\n        self.inner.list()\n    }\n}\n\nstruct FaultFile {\n    inner: Box<dyn Vfile>,\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n}\n\nimpl Read for FaultFile {\n    fn read(&mut self, buf: &mut [u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.inner.read(buf)\n    }\n}\nimpl Seek for FaultFile {\n    fn seek(&mut self, pos: SeekFrom) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.inner.seek(pos)\n    }\n}\nimpl Write for FaultFile {\n    fn write(&mut self, buf: &[u8]) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        // FaultFile 只实现单块 write；store 统一走 write_all。\n        self.inner.write(buf)\n    }\n    fn flush(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.flush()\n    }\n    fn write_all(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {\n        // 自定义全程：按注入规则制造“纯失败”或“短写后失败”。\n        let mut written = 0usize;\n        while written < data.len() {\n            if let Some(fault) = self.plan.take(Op::Write) {\n                match fault {\n                    Fault::Error => {\n                        return Err(io::Error::other(format!(\n                            \"injected write failure at {}/{}\",\n                            written,\n                            data.len()\n                        )))\n                    }\n                    Fault::ShortWrite(n) => {\n                        let target = written.saturating_add(n as usize).min(data.len());\n                        while written < target {\n                            match self.inner.write(&data[written..target]) {\n                                Ok(0) => return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero, \"zero write\")),\n                                Ok(k) => written += k,\n                                Err(e) => return Err(e),\n                            }\n                        }\n                        return Err(io::Error::other(format!(\n                            \"injected short write: {}/{} bytes landed\",\n                            written,\n                            data.len()\n                        )));\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            match self.inner.write(&data[written..]) {\n                Ok(0) => return Err(io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::WriteZero, \"zero write\")),\n                Ok(k) => written += k,\n                Err(e) => return Err(e),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\nimpl Vfile for FaultFile {\n    fn len(&self) -> IoResult<u64> {\n        self.inner.len()\n    }\n    fn sync_file(&mut self) -> IoResult<()> {\n        if let Some(Fault::Error) = self.plan.take(Op::SyncFile) {\n            return Err(IoError::failed(\"injected sync_file failure\"));\n        }\n        // ShortWrite 对 sync 无意义，按纯失败处理\n        if self.plan.take(Op::SyncFile).is_some() {\n            return Err(IoError::failed(\"injected sync_file failure\"));\n        }\n        self.inner.sync_file()\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 内存文件系统 + 崩溃模拟\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// 一个文件节点的全部状态。每个节点有稳定 id（vector 不做删除式压缩）。\n#[derive(Clone)]\nstruct FNode {\n    /// 工作视图中的名字；None 表示已 remove/被 rename 覆盖。\n    work_key: Option<String>,\n    /// 工作视图中的内容；None 表示不存在/已删。\n    work_data: Option<Vec<u8>>,\n    /// 上次 sync_dir 时落盘的名字。\n    committed_key: Option<String>,\n    /// 上次同步点落盘的内容。\n    committed_data: Option<Vec<u8>>,\n}\n\nstruct SimState {\n    nodes: Vec<FNode>,\n}\n\n/// 内存文件系统的共享内核；[`SimDisk::crash_and_reboot`] 丢弃未落盘状态。\n#[derive(Clone)]\npub struct SimDisk {\n    state: Arc<Mutex<SimState>>,\n    /// 每次 reboot 自增，旧句柄携带旧代号，崩溃后再用即报 Crashed。\n    epoch: Arc<Mutex<u64>>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for SimDisk {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl SimDisk {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        SimDisk {\n            state: 索引/清单文件 `index.json` 与段元数据。\n//!\n//! 索引是**可重建的缓存**：真相永远是段文件本身。打开时若索引缺失、损坏或与\n//! 段文件不一致，存储库会从段扫描结果重建它，并用 [`Vfs::atomic_write`]\n//! （tmp + fsync + rename + fsync 目录）原子落盘 —— 因此轮转中途掉电、\n//! 索引更新到一半掉电都可以恢复。\n\nuse crate::json::Json;\nuse crate::vfs::{IoError, IoResult, Vfs};\n\n/// 索引文件名（固定）。\npub const INDEX_FILE: &str = \"index.json\";\n/// 索引格式版本。\npub const INDEX_VERSION: i64 = 1;\n/// 段文件名宽度：`seg-000000.log`。\npub const SEG_NAME_WIDTH: usize = 6;\npub const SEG_PREFIX: &str = \"seg-\";\npub const SEG_SUFFIX: &str = \".log\";\n\n/// 段文件名，如 `seg-000003.log`。\npub fn segment_file(id: u64) -> String {\n    format!(\"{SEG_PREFIX}{:0width$}{SEG_SUFFIX}\", id, width = SEG_NAME_WIDTH)\n}\n\n/// 识别段文件名并解析段 id；不匹配返回 None。\npub fn parse_segment_name(name: &str) -> Option<u64> {\n    let middle = name.strip_prefix(SEG_PREFIX)?.strip_suffix(SEG_SUFFIX)?;\n    if middle.len() != SEG_NAME_WIDTH || !middle.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {\n        return None;\n    }\n    middle.parse::<u64>().ok()\n}\n\n/// 内存中的段元数据（打开时由扫描得到，运行期维护）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SegmentInfo {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub file: String,\n    pub start_seq: u64,\n    /// 已确认记录数。\n    pub count: u64,\n    /// 每条记录在段内的字节偏移与整帧长度（按序号顺序）。\n    pub offsets: Vec<(u64, u64)>,\n}\n\nimpl SegmentInfo {\n    pub fn end_seq_exclusive(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.start_seq + self.count\n    }\n\n    pub fn contains_seq(&self, seq: u64) -> bool {\n        seq >= self.start_seq && seq < self.end_seq_exclusive()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 磁盘上的索引文档。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Index {\n    pub active_segment: u64,\n    pub next_seq: u64,\n    pub segments: Vec<IndexSegment>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct IndexSegment {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub file: String,\n    pub start_seq: u64,\n    pub count: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Index {\n    /// 由内存段信息生成索引。\n    pub fn from_infos(active_segment: u64, next_seq: u64, infos: &[SegmentInfo]) -> Index {\n        Index {\n            active_segment,\n            next_seq,\n            segments: infos\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| IndexSegment {\n                    id: s.id,\n                    file: s.file.clone(),\n                    start_seq: s.start_seq,\n                    count: s.count,\n                })\n                .collect(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 序列化为 JSON 文本（紧凑、确定顺序）。\n    pub fn to_json(&self) -> String {\n        let mut s = String::new();\n        s.push_str(\"{\\n\");\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"version\\\": {},\\n\", INDEX_VERSION));\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"active_segment\\\": {},\\n\", self.active_segment));\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"next_seq\\\": {},\\n\", self.next_seq));\n        s.push_str(\"  \\\"segments\\\": [\");\n        for (i, seg) in self.segments.iter().enumerate() {\n            if i > 0 {\n                s.push(',');\n            }\n            s.push_str(&format!(\n                \"\\n    {{\\\"id\\\": {}, \\\"file\\\": \\\"{}\\\", \\\"start_seq\\\": {}, \\\"count\\\": {}}}\",\n                seg.id, seg.file, seg.start_seq, seg.count\n            ));\n        }\n        if self.segments.is_empty() {\n            s.push(']');\n        } else {\n            s.push_str(\"\\n  ]\");\n        }\n        s.push_str(\"\\n}\\n\");\n        s\n    }\n\n    /// 解析索引文本。任何字段缺失/类型错误都返回 Err（调用方将重建）。\n    pub fn parse(text: &str) -> Result<Index, String> {\n        let doc = Json::parse(text)?;\n        let m = doc.field_map().ok_or(\"root is not object\")?;\n        let version = m.get(\"version\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing version\")?;\n        if version != INDEX_VERSION {\n            return Err(format!(\"unsupported index version {version}\"));\n        }\n        let active_segment =\n            m.get(\"active_segment\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing active_segment\")? as u64;\n        let next_seq = m.get(\"next_seq\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing next_seq\")? as u64;\n        let raw_segs = m.get(\"segments\").and_then(|v| v.as_array()).ok_or(\"missing segments\")?;\n        let mut segments = Vec::with_capacity(raw_segs.len());\n        for item in raw_segs {\n            let sm = item.field_map().ok_or(\"segment entry not object\")?;\n            let id = sm.get(\"id\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing id\")? as u64;\n            let file = sm.get(\"file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).ok_or(\"segment missing file\")?;\n            let start_seq =\n                sm.get(\"start_seq\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing start_seq\")? as u64;\n            let count = sm.get(\"count\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing count\")? as u64;\n            segments.push(IndexSegment { id, file: file.to_string(), start_seq, count });\n        }\n        Ok(Index { active_segment, next_seq, segments })\n    }\n\n    /// 与段扫描真值比较：id/文件名/start_seq/count/active/next_seq 全一致才算可信。\n    pub fn matches_truth(&self, truth: &Index) -> bool {\n        if self.active_segment != truth.active_segment || self.next_seq != truth.next_seq {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if self.segments.len() != truth.segments.len() {\n            return false;\n        }\n        self.segments.iter().zip(&truth.segments).all(|(a, b)| {\n            a.id == b.id && a.file == b.file && a.start_seq == b.start_seq && a.count == b.count\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 原子写入索引（tmp + fsync + rename + fsync 目录）。\n    pub fn persist(&self, vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<()> {\n        vfs.atomic_write(INDEX_FILE, self.to_json().as_bytes())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 读取并解析索引；文件不存在返回 Ok(None)，解析失败返回 Err。\npub fn load_index(vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<Result<Option<Index>, String>> {\n    if !vfs.exists(INDEX_FILE)? {\n        return Ok(Ok(None));\n    }\n    let data = vfs.read_index_bytes()?;\n    let text = std::str::from_utf8(&data).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    Ok(Index::parse(text).map(Some))\n}\n\n/// 小辅助 trait，避免把 read_all 暴露名冲突。\ntrait VfsExt {\n    fn read_index_bytes(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<u8>>;\n}\nimpl<F: Vfs + ?Sized> VfsExt for F {\n    fn read_index_bytes(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<u8>> {\n        crate::vfs::read_all(self, INDEX_FILE)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl From<IoError> for Index {\n    fn from(_: IoError) -> Self {\n        unreachable!()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn segment_names_roundtrip() {\n        assert_eq!(segment_file(0), \"seg-000000.log\");\n        assert_eq!(segment_file(42), \"seg-000042.log\");\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-000003.log\"), Some(3));\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-00003.log\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"index.json\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-000000.log.tmp\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-x.log\"), None);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn index_json_roundtrip_and_validation() {\n        let infos = vec![\n            SegmentInfo { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 3, offsets: vec![] },\n            SegmentInfo { id: 1, file: segment_file(1), start_seq: 3, count: 2, offsets: vec![] },\n        ];\n        let idx = Index::from_infos(1, 5, &infos);\n        let text = idx.to_json();\n        let parsed = Index::parse(&text).unwrap();\n        assert!(parsed.matches_truth(&idx));\n\n        // 坏文档\n        assert!(Index::parse(\"{\").is_err());\n        assert!(Index::parse(r#\"{\"version\":99}\"#).is_err());\n        assert!(Index::parse(r#\"{\"version\":1,\"active_segment\":0,\"next_seq\":0,\"segments\":[]}\"#).is_ok());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn mismatch_detection() {\n        let a = Index {\n            active_segment: 0,\n            next_seq: 1,\n            segments: vec![IndexSegment { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 1 }],\n        };\n        let mut b = a.clone();\n        b.next_seq = 2;\n        assert!(!a.matches_truth(&b));\n        b = a.clone();\n        b.segments[0].count = 0;\n        assert!(!a.matches_truth(&b));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn persist_and_reload_on_simfs() {\n        use crate::vfs::{SimDisk, SimFs};\n        let disk = SimDisk::new();\n        let fs = SimFs::new(disk);\n        let idx = Index {\n            active_segment: 1,\n            next_seq: 7,\n            segments: vec![\n                IndexSegment { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 5 },\n                IndexSegment { id: 1, file: segment_file(1), start_seq: 5, count: 2 },\n            ],\n        };\n        idx.persist(&fs).unwrap();\n        let loaded = load_index(&fs).unwrap().unwrap().unwrap();\n        assert!(loaded.matches_truth(&idx));\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_f1ecf273e041051979559657","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1809,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":69432,"output_tokens":4607,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_qw8boesswft1n7w1mzuodfqs":{"content":"//! None;\n    }\n    middle.parse::<u64>().ok()\n}\n\n/// 内存中的段元数据（打开时由扫描得到，运行期维护）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SegmentInfo {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub file: String,\n    pub start_seq: u64,\n
