if self.segments.is_empty() {\n            s.push(']');\n        } else {\n            s.push_str(\"\\n  ]\");\n        }\n        s.push_str(\"\\n}\\n\");\n        s\n    }\n\n    /// segments = Vec::with_capacity(raw_segs.len());\n        for item in raw_segs {\n            let sm = item.field_map().ok_or(\"segment entry not object\")?;\n            let id = next_seq, segments })\n    }\n\n    /// 与段扫描真值比较：id/文件名/start_seq/count/active/next_seq 全一致才算可信。\n    pub fn matches_truth(&self, truth: &Index) -> bool {\n        if self.active_segment != truth.active_segment || self.next_seq != truth.next_seq {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if self.segments.len() != truth.segments.len() {\n            return false;\n        }\n fsync + rename + fsync 目录）。\n    pub fn persist(&self, vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<()> {\n        vfs.atomic_write(INDEX_FILE, self.to_json().as_bytes())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 读取并解析索引；文件不存在返回 Ok(None)，解析失败返回 Err。\npub fn load_index(vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<Result<Option<Index>, String>> {\n    if !vfs.exists(INDEX_FILE)? {\n        return Ok(Ok(None));\n    }\n    let data = vfs.read_index_bytes()?;\n    let text = std::str::from_utf8(&data).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    Ok(Index::parse(text).map(Some))\n}\n\n/// 小辅助 trait，避免把 read_all 暴露名冲突。\ntrait VfsExt {\n    fn load_index(vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<Result<Option<Index>, String>> {\n    if !vfs.exists(INDEX_FILE)? {\n        return Ok(Ok(None));\n    }\n    let data = crate::vfs::read_all(vfs, INDEX_FILE)?;\n    let text = std::str::from_utf8(&data).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    Ok(Index::parse(text).map(Some))\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]","originalFile":"//! 索引/清单文件 `index.json` 与段元数据。\n//!\n//! 索引是**可重建的缓存**：真相永远是段文件本身。打开时若索引缺失、损坏或与\n//! 段文件不一致，存储库会从段扫描结果重建它，并用 [`Vfs::atomic_write`]\n//! （tmp + fsync + rename + fsync 目录）原子落盘 —— 因此轮转中途掉电、\n//! 索引更新到一半掉电都可以恢复。\n\nuse crate::json::Json;\nuse crate::vfs::{IoError, IoResult, Vfs};\n\n/// 索引文件名（固定）。\npub const INDEX_FILE: &str = \"index.json\";\n/// 索引格式版本。\npub const INDEX_VERSION: i64 = 1;\n/// 段文件名宽度：`seg-000000.log`。\npub const SEG_NAME_WIDTH: usize = 6;\npub const SEG_PREFIX: &str = \"seg-\";\npub const SEG_SUFFIX: &str = \".log\";\n\n/// 段文件名，如 `seg-000003.log`。\npub fn segment_file(id: u64) -> String {\n    format!(\"{SEG_PREFIX}{:0width$}{SEG_SUFFIX}\", id, width = SEG_NAME_WIDTH)\n}\n\n/// 识别段文件名并解析段 id；不匹配返回 None。\npub fn parse_segment_name(name: &str) -> Option<u64> {\n    let middle = name.strip_prefix(SEG_PREFIX)?.strip_suffix(SEG_SUFFIX)?;\n    if middle.len() != SEG_NAME_WIDTH || !middle.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {\n        return None;\n    }\n    middle.parse::<u64>().ok()\n}\n\n/// 内存中的段元数据（打开时由扫描得到，运行期维护）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SegmentInfo {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub file: String,\n    pub start_seq: u64,\n    /// 已确认记录数。\n    pub count: u64,\n    /// 每条记录在段内的字节偏移与整帧长度（按序号顺序）。\n    pub offsets: Vec<(u64, u64)>,\n}\n\nimpl SegmentInfo {\n    pub fn end_seq_exclusive(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.start_seq + self.count\n    }\n\n    pub fn contains_seq(&self, seq: u64) -> bool {\n        seq >= self.start_seq && seq < self.end_seq_exclusive()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 磁盘上的索引文档。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Index {\n    pub active_segment: u64,\n    pub next_seq: u64,\n    pub segments: Vec<IndexSegment>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct IndexSegment {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub file: String,\n    pub start_seq: u64,\n    pub count: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Index {\n    /// 由内存段信息生成索引。\n    pub fn from_infos(active_segment: u64, next_seq: u64, infos: &[SegmentInfo]) -> Index {\n        Index {\n            active_segment,\n            next_seq,\n            segments: infos\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| IndexSegment {\n                    id: s.id,\n                    file: s.file.clone(),\n                    start_seq: s.start_seq,\n                    count: s.count,\n                })\n                .collect(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 序列化为 JSON 文本（紧凑、确定顺序）。\n    pub fn to_json(&self) -> String {\n        let mut s = String::new();\n        s.push_str(\"{\\n\");\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"version\\\": {},\\n\", INDEX_VERSION));\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"active_segment\\\": {},\\n\", self.active_segment));\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"next_seq\\\": {},\\n\", self.next_seq));\n        s.push_str(\"  \\\"segments\\\": [\");\n        for (i, seg) in self.segments.iter().enumerate() {\n            if i > 0 {\n                s.push(',');\n            }\n            s.push_str(&format!(\n                \"\\n    {{\\\"id\\\": {}, \\\"file\\\": \\\"{}\\\", \\\"start_seq\\\": {}, \\\"count\\\": {}}}\",\n                seg.id, seg.file, seg.start_seq, seg.count\n            ));\n        }\n        if self.segments.is_empty() {\n            s.push(']');\n        } else {\n            s.push_str(\"\\n  ]\");\n        }\n        s.push_str(\"\\n}\\n\");\n        s\n    }\n\n    /// 解析索引文本。任何字段缺失/类型错误都返回 Err（调用方将重建）。\n    pub fn parse(text: &str) -> Result<Index, String> {\n        let doc = Json::parse(text)?;\n        let m = doc.field_map().ok_or(\"root is not object\")?;\n        let version = m.get(\"version\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing version\")?;\n        if version != INDEX_VERSION {\n            return Err(format!(\"unsupported index version {version}\"));\n        }\n        let active_segment =\n            m.get(\"active_segment\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing active_segment\")? as u64;\n        let next_seq = m.get(\"next_seq\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing next_seq\")? as u64;\n        let raw_segs = m.get(\"segments\").and_then(|v| v.as_array()).ok_or(\"missing segments\")?;\n        let mut segments = Vec::with_capacity(raw_segs.len());\n        for item in raw_segs {\n            let sm = item.field_map().ok_or(\"segment entry not object\")?;\n            let id = sm.get(\"id\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing id\")? as u64;\n            let file = sm.get(\"file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).ok_or(\"segment missing file\")?;\n            let start_seq =\n                sm.get(\"start_seq\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing start_seq\")? as u64;\n            let count = sm.get(\"count\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing count\")? as u64;\n            segments.push(IndexSegment { id, file: file.to_string(), start_seq, count });\n        }\n        Ok(Index { active_segment, next_seq, segments })\n    }\n\n    /// 与段扫描真值比较：id/文件名/start_seq/count/active/next_seq 全一致才算可信。\n    pub fn matches_truth(&self, truth: &Index) -> bool {\n        if self.active_segment != truth.active_segment || self.next_seq != truth.next_seq {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if self.segments.len() != truth.segments.len() {\n            return false;\n        }\n        self.segments.iter().zip(&truth.segments).all(|(a, b)| {\n            a.id == b.id && a.file == b.file && a.start_seq == b.start_seq && a.count == b.count\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 原子写入索引（tmp + fsync + rename + fsync 目录）。\n    pub fn persist(&self, vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<()> {\n        vfs.atomic_write(INDEX_FILE, self.to_json().as_bytes())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 读取并解析索引；文件不存在返回 Ok(None)，解析失败返回 Err。\npub fn load_index(vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<Result<Option<Index>, String>> {\n    if !vfs.exists(INDEX_FILE)? {\n        return Ok(Ok(None));\n    }\n    let data = vfs.read_index_bytes()?;\n    let text = std::str::from_utf8(&data).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    Ok(Index::parse(text).map(Some))\n}\n\n/// 小辅助 trait，避免把 read_all 暴露名冲突。\ntrait VfsExt {\n    fn read_index_bytes(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<u8>>;\n}\nimpl<F: Vfs + ?Sized> VfsExt for F {\n    fn read_index_bytes(&self) -> IoResult<Vec<u8>> {\n        crate::vfs::read_all(self, INDEX_FILE)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl From<IoError> for Index {\n    fn from(_: IoError) -> Self {\n        unreachable!()\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn segment_names_roundtrip() {\n        assert_eq!(segment_file(0), \"seg-000000.log\");\n        assert_eq!(segment_file(42), \"seg-000042.log\");\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-000003.log\"), Some(3));\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-00003.log\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"index.json\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-000000.log.tmp\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-x.log\"), None);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn index_json_roundtrip_and_validation() {\n        let infos = vec![\n            SegmentInfo { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 3, offsets: vec![] },\n            SegmentInfo { id: 1, file: segment_file(1), start_seq: 3, count: 2, offsets: vec![] },\n        ];\n        let idx = Index::from_infos(1, 5, &infos);\n        let text = idx.to_json();\n        let parsed = Index::parse(&text).unwrap();\n        assert!(parsed.matches_truth(&idx));\n\n        // 坏文档\n        assert!(Index::parse(\"{\").is_err());\n        assert!(Index::parse(r#\"{\"version\":99}\"#).is_err());\n        assert!(Index::parse(r#\"{\"version\":1,\"active_segment\":0,\"next_seq\":0,\"segments\":[]}\"#).is_ok());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn mismatch_detection() {\n        let a = Index {\n            active_segment: 0,\n            next_seq: 1,\n            segments: vec![IndexSegment { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 1 }],\n        };\n        let mut b = a.clone();\n        b.next_seq = 2;\n        assert!(!a.matches_truth(&b));\n        b = a.clone();\n        b.segments[0].count = 0;\n        assert!(!a.matches_truth(&b));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn persist_and_reload_on_simfs() {\n        use crate::vfs::{SimDisk, SimFs};\n        let disk = SimDisk::new();\n        let fs = SimFs::new(disk);\n        let idx = Index {\n            active_segment: 1,\n            next_seq: 7,\n            segments: vec![\n                IndexSegment { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 5 },\n                IndexSegment { id: 1, file: segment_file(1), start_seq: 5, count: 2 },\n            ],\n        };\n        idx.persist(&fs).unwrap();\n        let loaded = load_index(&fs).unwrap().unwrap().unwrap();\n        assert!(loaded.matches_truth(&idx));\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":157,"oldLines":32,"newStart":157,"newLines":16,"lines":["     }"," }"," ","-/// 读取并解析索引；文件不存在返回 Ok(None)，解析失败返回 crate::json::Json;\nuse crate::vfs::{IoError, IoResult, Vfs};","newString":"use crate::json::Json;\nuse crate::vfs::{IoResult, Vfs};","originalFile":"//! 索引/清单文件 `index.json` 与段元数据。\n//!\n//! 索引是**可重建的缓存**：真相永远是段文件本身。打开时若索引缺失、损坏或与\n//! 段文件不一致，存储库会从段扫描结果重建它，并用 [`Vfs::atomic_write`]\n//! （tmp + fsync + rename + fsync 目录）原子落盘 —— 因此轮转中途掉电、\n//! 索引更新到一半掉电都可以恢复。\n\nuse crate::json::Json;\nuse crate::vfs::{IoError, IoResult, Vfs};\n\n/// 索引文件名（固定）。\npub const INDEX_FILE: &str = \"index.json\";\n/// 索引格式版本。\npub const INDEX_VERSION: i64 = 1;\n/// 段文件名宽度：`seg-000000.log`。\npub const SEG_NAME_WIDTH: usize = 6;\npub const SEG_PREFIX: &str = \"seg-\";\npub const SEG_SUFFIX: &str = \".log\";\n\n/// 段文件名，如 `seg-000003.log`。\npub fn segment_file(id: u64) -> String {\n    format!(\"{SEG_PREFIX}{:0width$}{SEG_SUFFIX}\", id, width = SEG_NAME_WIDTH)\n}\n\n/// 识别段文件名并解析段 id；不匹配返回 None。\npub fn parse_segment_name(name: &str) -> Option<u64> {\n    let middle = name.strip_prefix(SEG_PREFIX)?.strip_suffix(SEG_SUFFIX)?;\n    if middle.len() != SEG_NAME_WIDTH || !middle.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {\n        return None;\n    }\n    middle.parse::<u64>().ok()\n}\n\n/// 内存中的段元数据（打开时由扫描得到，运行期维护）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SegmentInfo {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub file: String,\n    pub start_seq: u64,\n    /// 已确认记录数。\n    pub count: u64,\n    /// 每条记录在段内的字节偏移与整帧长度（按序号顺序）。\n    pub offsets: Vec<(u64, u64)>,\n}\n\nimpl SegmentInfo {\n    pub fn end_seq_exclusive(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.start_seq + self.count\n    }\n\n    pub fn contains_seq(&self, seq: u64) -> bool {\n        seq >= self.start_seq && seq < self.end_seq_exclusive()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 磁盘上的索引文档。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Index {\n    pub active_segment: u64,\n    pub next_seq: u64,\n    pub segments: Vec<IndexSegment>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct IndexSegment {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub file: String,\n    pub start_seq: u64,\n    pub count: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Index {\n    /// 由内存段信息生成索引。\n    pub fn from_infos(active_segment: u64, next_seq: u64, infos: &[SegmentInfo]) -> Index {\n        Index {\n            active_segment,\n            next_seq,\n            segments: infos\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| IndexSegment {\n                    id: s.id,\n                    file: s.file.clone(),\n                    start_seq: s.start_seq,\n                    count: s.count,\n                })\n                .collect(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 序列化为 JSON 文本（紧凑、确定顺序）。\n    pub fn to_json(&self) -> String {\n        let mut s = String::new();\n        s.push_str(\"{\\n\");\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"version\\\": {},\\n\", INDEX_VERSION));\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"active_segment\\\": {},\\n\", self.active_segment));\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"next_seq\\\": {},\\n\", self.next_seq));\n        s.push_str(\"  \\\"segments\\\": [\");\n        for (i, seg) in self.segments.iter().enumerate() {\n            if i > 0 {\n                s.push(',');\n            }\n            s.push_str(&format!(\n                \"\\n    {{\\\"id\\\": {}, \\\"file\\\": \\\"{}\\\", \\\"start_seq\\\": {}, \\\"count\\\": {}}}\",\n                seg.id, seg.file, seg.start_seq, seg.count\n            ));\n        }\n        if self.segments.is_empty() {\n            s.push(']');\n        } else {\n            s.push_str(\"\\n  ]\");\n        }\n        s.push_str(\"\\n}\\n\");\n        s\n    }\n\n    /// 解析索引文本。任何字段缺失/类型错误都返回 Err（调用方将重建）。\n    pub fn parse(text: &str) -> Result<Index, String> {\n        let doc = Json::parse(text)?;\n        let m = doc.field_map().ok_or(\"root is not object\")?;\n        let version = m.get(\"version\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing version\")?;\n        if version != INDEX_VERSION {\n            return Err(format!(\"unsupported index version {version}\"));\n        }\n        let active_segment =\n            m.get(\"active_segment\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing active_segment\")? as u64;\n        let next_seq = m.get(\"next_seq\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing next_seq\")? as u64;\n        let raw_segs = m.get(\"segments\").and_then(|v| v.as_array()).ok_or(\"missing segments\")?;\n        let mut segments = Vec::with_capacity(raw_segs.len());\n        for item in raw_segs {\n            let sm = item.field_map().ok_or(\"segment entry not object\")?;\n            let id = sm.get(\"id\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing id\")? as u64;\n            let file = sm.get(\"file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).ok_or(\"segment missing file\")?;\n            let start_seq =\n                sm.get(\"start_seq\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing start_seq\")? as u64;\n            let count = sm.get(\"count\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing count\")? as u64;\n            segments.push(IndexSegment { id, file: file.to_string(), start_seq, count });\n        }\n        Ok(Index { active_segment, next_seq, segments })\n    }\n\n    /// 与段扫描真值比较：id/文件名/start_seq/count/active/next_seq 全一致才算可信。\n    pub fn matches_truth(&self, truth: &Index) -> bool {\n        if self.active_segment != truth.active_segment || self.next_seq != truth.next_seq {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if self.segments.len() != truth.segments.len() {\n            return false;\n        }\n        self.segments.iter().zip(&truth.segments).all(|(a, b)| {\n            a.id == b.id && a.file == b.file && a.start_seq == b.start_seq && a.count == b.count\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 原子写入索引（tmp + fsync + rename + fsync 目录）。\n    pub fn persist(&self, vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<()> {\n        vfs.atomic_write(INDEX_FILE, self.to_json().as_bytes())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 读取并解析索引；文件不存在返回 Ok(None)，解析失败（损坏/版本不符）返回 Err。\npub fn load_index(vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<Result<Option<Index>, String>> {\n    if !vfs.exists(INDEX_FILE)? {\n        return Ok(Ok(None));\n    }\n    let data = crate::vfs::read_all(vfs, INDEX_FILE)?;\n    let text = std::str::from_utf8(&data).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    Ok(Index::parse(text).map(Some))\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn segment_names_roundtrip() {\n        assert_eq!(segment_file(0), \"seg-000000.log\");\n        assert_eq!(segment_file(42), \"seg-000042.log\");\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-000003.log\"), Some(3));\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-00003.log\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"index.json\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-000000.log.tmp\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-x.log\"), None);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn index_json_roundtrip_and_validation() {\n        let infos = vec![\n            SegmentInfo { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 3, offsets: vec![] },\n            SegmentInfo { id: 1, file: segment_file(1), start_seq: 3, count: 2, offsets: vec![] },\n        ];\n        let idx = Index::from_infos(1, 5, &infos);\n        let text = idx.to_json();\n        let parsed = Index::parse(&text).unwrap();\n        assert!(parsed.matches_truth(&idx));\n\n        // 坏文档\n        assert!(Index::parse(\"{\").is_err());\n        assert!(Index::parse(r#\"{\"version\":99}\"#).is_err());\n        assert!(Index::parse(r#\"{\"version\":1,\"active_segment\":0,\"next_seq\":0,\"segments\":[]}\"#).is_ok());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn mismatch_detection() {\n        let a = Index {\n            active_segment: 0,\n            next_seq: 1,\n            segments: vec![IndexSegment { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 1 }],\n        };\n        let mut b = a.clone();\n        b.next_seq = 2;\n        assert!(!a.matches_truth(&b));\n        b = a.clone();\n        b.segments[0].count = 0;\n        assert!(!a.matches_truth(&b));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn persist_and_reload_on_simfs() {\n        use crate::vfs::{SimDisk, SimFs};\n        let disk = SimDisk::new();\n        let fs = SimFs::new(disk);\n        let idx = Index {\n            active_segment: 1,\n            next_seq: 7,\n            segments: vec![\n                IndexSegment { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 5 },\n                IndexSegment { id: 1, file: segment_file(1), start_seq: 5, count: 2 },\n            ],\n        };\n        idx.persist(&fs).unwrap();\n        let loaded = load_index(&fs).unwrap().unwrap().unwrap();\n        assert!(loaded.matches_truth(&idx));\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":6,"oldLines":7,"newStart":6,"newLines":7,"lines":[" //! 索引更新到一半掉电都可以恢复。"," "," use crate::json::Json;","-use {"parentUuid":"49a983ba-b997-4b8b-a66a-c2106f0ff952","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_aghp2ypckm8bnmpivnocsu5c","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/a/src/store.rs","content":"//! 分段追加日志存储库。\n//!\n//! ## 磁盘布局（所有文件位于数据目录根部，扁平结构）\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! <data-dir>/\n//!   index.json            # 清单：active 段 id、next_seq、每段范围（可重建缓存）\n//!   seg-000000.log        # 第 0 段，若干帧首尾相接（帧格式见 frame 模块）\n//!   seg-000001.log\n//!   ...\n//! ```\n//!\n//! ## 同步边界（哪些操作返回成功即已落盘）\n//!\n//! - **追加**：编码帧 → `write` → `fsync(段文件)`，两步都完成才返回确认；\n//!   之后掉电该记录必在。写入/同步失败时本存储库进入 poisoned 态，必须重新\n//!   `open` 恢复（避免在不确定的文件偏移上继续追加而覆盖数据）。\n//! - **轮转**：fsync 旧段 → 创建新段文件 → fsync 新空文件 → fsync 目录\n//!   （名字落盘）→ 原子写 index.json（tmp + fsync + rename + fsync 目录）。\n//! - **索引更新**：只通过原子 rename 发布，崩溃后要么旧索引、要么新索引，\n//!   扫描段文件即可校验/重建，因此“轮转与索引更新可恢复”。\n//!\n//! ## 恢复规则\n//!\n//! - 只允许**最后一段**文件末尾存在不完整帧（撕裂尾部），打开时 fsync 截断丢弃；\n//! - 中间段的任何不完整帧、任何完整帧的 magic/CRC/长度错误、任何序号不连续，\n//!   一律 [`Error::Corrupt`] 报错，拒绝打开（不丢数据、不静默跳过）；\n//! - 最后一段若为空文件则作为当前活动段保留；中间空段是损坏。\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Seek, SeekFrom};\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\n\nuse crate::frame::{self, Record};\nuse crate::index::{\n    self, load_index, segment_file, Index, SegmentInfo, INDEX_FILE,\n};\nuse crate::vfs::{self, IoError, IoResult, Vfs};\n\n/// 默认轮转阈值（段文件达到该字节数后，下一次追加会先轮转）。\npub const DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES: u64 = 8 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n/// 存储库错误。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum Error {\n    /// 磁盘日志损坏（中间段不完整、CRC/magic/长度错、序号不连续等）。拒绝打开。\n    Corrupt(String),\n    /// I/O 故障（含被注入的故障）。\n    Io(IoError),\n    /// 载荷超过帧格式上限。\n    PayloadTooLarge { len: usize, max: u32 },\n    /// 存储库已因前一次 I/O 失败进入 poisoned 态，必须重新 open。\n    Poisoned,\n    /// 序号不存在（尚未写入或已经…本实现不支持删除，故只会是尚未写入）。\n    NoSuchSeq(u64),\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for Error {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            Error::Corrupt(s) => write!(f, \"log corrupt: {s}\"),\n            Error::Io(e) => write!(f, \"i/o error: {e}\"),\n            Error::PayloadTooLarge { len, max } => {\n                write!(f, \"payload {len} bytes exceeds max {max}\")\n            }\n            Error::Poisoned => write!(f, \"store is poisoned after an i/o failure; reopen required\"),\n            Error::NoSuchSeq(n) => write!(f, \"no record with seq {n}\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for Error {}\n\nimpl From<IoError> for Error {\n    fn from(e: IoError) -> Self {\n        Error::Io(e)\n    }\n}\n\npub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;\n\n/// 打开/恢复结果报告（可通过 HTTP `/recovery` 查看）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\npub struct OpenReport {\n    /// 打开时磁盘上的段文件数。\n    pub segment_files: usize,\n    /// 恢复后保留的段数。\n    pub segments: usize,\n    /// 下一序号（= 已确认记录数）。\n    pub next_seq: u64,\n    /// 是否丢弃了最后一段的不完整尾部。\n    pub truncated_tail: bool,\n    /// 被丢弃的尾部字节数。\n    pub truncated_bytes: u64,\n    /// 撕裂尾部所在段 id（若有）。\n    pub truncated_segment: Option<u64>,\n    /// 被删除的遗留临时文件（如 index.json.tmp、seg-*.tmp）。\n    pub removed_tmp_files: Vec<String>,\n    /// 索引此前缺失（已重建）。\n    pub index_missing: bool,\n    /// 索引此前损坏（JSON/版本非法，已重建）。\n    pub index_corrupt: bool,\n    /// 索引内容与段文件不一致（已重建）。\n    pub index_stale: bool,\n    /// 与日志无关、被忽略的文件。\n    pub ignored_files: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n/// 打开恢复的返回：存储库 + 恢复报告。\npub type RecoveryResult<T> = (T, OpenReport);\n\nstruct Inner {\n    active: Box<dyn Vfile>,\n    active_id: u64,\n    active_len: u64,\n    next_seq: u64,\n    segments: Vec<SegmentInfo>,\n    poisoned: bool,\n}\n\n/// 分段追加日志存储库。\npub struct LogStore {\n    vfs: Box<dyn Vfs>,\n    max_segment_bytes: u64,\n    inner: Mutex<Inner>,\n}\n\nimpl LogStore {\n    /// 在给定（可注入）文件系统上打开并恢复。\n    pub fn open_with(vfs: Box<dyn Vfs>, max_segment_bytes: u64) -> Result<RecoveryResult<Self>> {\n        let (segments, next_seq, active_id, report) = recover(vfs.as_ref())?;\n\n        let active_path = segment_file(active_id);\n        let active = vfs.open_append(&active_path)?;\n        let active_len = vfs.file_len(&active_path)?;\n\n        let store = LogStore {\n            vfs,\n            max_segment_bytes,\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner {\n                active,\n                active_id,\n                active_len,\n                next_seq,\n                segments,\n                poisoned: false,\n            }),\n        };\n        Ok((store, report))\n    }\n\n    /// 在真实文件系统目录上打开并恢复。\n    pub fn open_dir<P: AsRef<std::path::Path>>(\n        path: P,\n        max_segment_bytes: Option<u64>,\n    ) -> std::io::Result<RecoveryResult<Self>> {\n        let fs = vfs::RealFs::open(path)?;\n        Self::open_with(Box::new(fs), max_segment_bytes.unwrap_or(DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES))\n            .map_err(into_io_err)\n    }\n\n    /// 已确认记录数（即下一个序号）。\n    pub fn next_seq(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().next_seq\n    }\n\n    /// 当前段 id。\n    pub fn active_segment_id(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().active_id\n    }\n\n    /// 段信息快照（HTTP 状态接口用）。\n    pub fn segment_snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, String, u64, u64)> {\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        g.segments\n            .iter()\n            .map(|s| (s.id, s.file.clone(), s.start_seq, s.count))\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    /// 当前活动段大小（字节）。\n    pub fn active_len(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().active_len\n    }\n\n    /// 追加一条记录，返回分配的序号。返回成功即已 fsync 落盘。\n    pub fn append(&self, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<u64> {\n        if payload.len() as u64 > frame::MAX_PAYLOAD_LEN as u64 {\n            return Err(Error::PayloadTooLarge { len: payload.len(), max: frame::MAX_PAYLOAD_LEN });\n        }\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        if g.poisoned {\n            return Err(Error::Poisoned);\n        }\n\n        // 达到轮转阈值则先轮转（当前活动段非空才轮）。\n        if g.active_len >= self.max_segment_bytes && g.active_len > 0 {\n            if let Err(e) = self.rotate_locked(&mut g) {\n                g.poisoned = true;\n                return Err(e);\n            }\n        }\n\n        let seq = g.next_seq;\n        let frame_bytes = frame::encode_frame(seq, payload);\n        let offset = g.active_len;\n\n        // 写 + fsync；任何失败都 poison，绝不继续在该句柄上追加。\n        if let Err(e) = (|| -> IoResult<()> {\n            g.active.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset)).map_err(io_map)?;\n            vfs::write_all_check(&mut g.active, &frame_bytes)?;\n            g.active.sync_file()?;\n            Ok(())\n        })() {\n            g.poisoned = true;\n            return Err(Error::Io(e));\n        }\n\n        g.active_len += frame_bytes.len() as u64;\n        let frame_len = frame_bytes.len() as u64;\n        match g.segments.last_mut() {\n            Some(seg) if seg.id == g.active_id => {\n                seg.count += 1;\n                seg.offsets.push((offset, frame_len));\n            }\n            _ => {\n                g.segments.push(SegmentInfo {\n                    id: g.active_id,\n                    file: segment_file(g.active_id),\n                    start_seq: seq,\n                    count: 1,\n                    offsets: vec![(offset, frame_len)],\n                });\n            }\n        }\n        g.next_seq += 1;\n        Ok(seq)\n    }\n\n    /// 按序号读取已确认记录的载荷。\n    pub fn read(&self, seq: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        if seq >= g.next_seq {\n            return Err(Error::NoSuchSeq(seq));\n        }\n        let seg = g\n            .segments\n            .iter()\n            .find(|s| s.contains_seq(seq))\n            .ok_or(Error::NoSuchSeq(seq))?;\n        let idx = (seq - seg.start_seq) as usize;\n        let (offset, frame_len) = seg.offsets.get(idx).copied().ok_or(Error::NoSuchSeq(seq))?;\n        let mut f = self.vfs.open_read(&seg.file)?;\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset)).map_err(io_map)?;\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; frame_len as usize];\n        f.read_exact(&mut buf).map_err(io_map)?;\n        let (got_seq, payload) = frame::decode_one(&buf).map_err(|e| Error::Corrupt(e.to_string()))?;\n        if got_seq != seq {\n            return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                \"read seq {} but frame on disk carries seq {}\",\n                seq, got_seq\n            )));\n        }\n        Ok(payload)\n    }\n\n    /// 强制轮转：关闭当前段，启用新的空段。返回新段 id。\n    pub fn rotate(&self) -> Result<u64> {\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        if g.poisoned {\n            return Err(Error::Poisoned);\n        }\n        self.rotate_locked(&mut g)\n    }\n\n    fn rotate_locked(&self, g: &mut Inner) -> Result<u64> {\n        // 1) 旧段已 fsync（追加路径每条都 fsync，这里再确保一次）。\n        g.active.sync_file()?;\n\n        let new_id = g.active_id + 1;\n        let new_file = segment_file(new_id);\n\n        // 2) 创建新段文件并 fsync 内容（空），再 fsync 目录让名字落盘。\n        let mut new_active = self.vfs.create(&new_file)?;\n        new_active.sync_file()?;\n        drop(new_active);\n        self.vfs.sync_dir()?;\n\n        // 3) 原子更新索引。\n        let idx = Index::from_infos(new_id, g.next_seq, &g.segments);\n        idx.persist(self.vfs.as_ref())?;\n\n        // 4) 切换内存活动句柄。\n        g.active = self.vfs.open_append(&new_file)?;\n        g.active_id = new_id;\n        g.active_len = 0;\n        // 为新段建立内存元数据（count 0，后续 append 直接命中）。\n        g.segments.push(SegmentInfo {\n            id: new_id,\n            file: new_file,\n            start_seq: g.next_seq,\n            count: 0,\n            offsets: Vec::new(),\n        });\n        Ok(new_id)\n    }\n\n    /// 逐段迭代已确认记录（CLI/测试验证用）。对每个已确认记录调用 f；\n    /// f 返回 false 时提前停止。\n    pub fn scan_records(&self, mut f: impl FnMut(&Record) -> bool) -> Result<()> {\n        let snapshots: Vec<(String, u64)> = {\n            let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n            g.segments.iter().map(|s| (s.file.clone(), s.count)).collect()\n        };\n        let mut expect = 0u64;\n        for (file, count) in snapshots {\n            let data = vfs::read_all(self.vfs.as_ref(), &file)?;\n            let scan = frame::scan_segment(&data, expect)\n                .map_err(|e| Error::Corrupt(e.to_string()))?;\n            for r in &scan.records {\n                if !f(r) {\n                    return Ok(());\n                }\n            }\n            expect += scan.records.len() as u64;\n            if scan.records.len() as u64 != count {\n                return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                    \"live scan of {file} found {} records, index says {count}\",\n                    scan.records.len()\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 打开恢复\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn recover(vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> Result<(Vec<SegmentInfo>, u64, u64, OpenReport)> {\n    let mut report = OpenReport::default();\n\n    // 1) 列出文件，删除遗留 *.tmp（任何 tmp 都是未完成的原子写/轮转残留）。\n    let names = vfs.list()?;\n    let mut seg_ids: Vec<u64> = Vec::new();\n    for name in names {\n        if name.ends_with(\".tmp\") {\n            vfs.remove(&name)?;\n            vfs.sync_dir()?;\n            report.removed_tmp_files.push(name);\n            continue;\n        }\n        if name == INDEX_FILE {\n            continue;\n        }\n        if let Some(id) = index::parse_segment_name(&name) {\n            seg_ids.push(id);\n        } else {\n            report.ignored_files.push(name);\n        }\n    }\n    seg_ids.sort_unstable();\n    seg_ids.dedup();\n    report.segment_files = seg_ids.len();\n\n    // 2) 逐段扫描；只允许最后一段有撕裂尾部。\n    let mut infos: Vec<SegmentInfo> = Vec::new();\n    let mut next_seq = 0u64;\n    let mut truncated_tail = false;\n    let mut truncated_bytes = 0u64;\n    let mut truncated_segment = None;\n\n    for (pos, &id) in seg_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_last = pos + 1 == seg_ids.len();\n        let file = segment_file(id);\n        let data = vfs::read_all(vfs, &file)?;\n\n        // 中间空段是损坏（轮转要么完整提交新段+索引，要么整体没发生）。\n        if !is_last && data.is_empty() {\n            return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\"non-last segment {file} is empty\")));\n        }\n\n        let scan = frame::scan_segment(&data, next_seq).map_err(|e| {\n            Error::Corrupt(format!(\"{file}: {e}\"))\n        })?;\n\n        if scan.torn_tail_len > 0 {\n            if !is_last {\n                // scan_segment 只会在文件末尾给出 torn tail；中间段出现即损坏。\n                return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                    \"{file}: truncated frame in the middle of the log ({} trailing bytes)\",\n                    scan.torn_tail_len\n                )));\n            }\n            // 最后一段：fsync 截断到 valid_len，丢弃不完整尾部。\n            vfs.truncate(&file, scan.valid_len)?;\n            truncated_tail = true;\n            truncated_bytes = scan.torn_tail_len;\n            truncated_segment = Some(id);\n        }\n\n        let count = scan.records.len() as u64;\n        // 全空最后一段（活动段，刚轮转还没写入）也登记。\n        let offsets = scan\n            .records\n            .iter()\n            .map(|r| (r.offset, r.frame_len))\n            .collect();\n truncated_bytes;\n    report.truncated_segment = truncated_segment;\n\n    let active_id = seg_ids.last().copied();\n    let active_id = match active_id {\n        Some(id) => id,\n        None => {\n segment_file(active_id);\n        let active = vfs.open_append(&active_path)?;\n        let active_len = vfs.file_len(&active_path)?;\n\n        let store = LogStore {\n            vfs,\n self.inner.lock().unwrap().next_seq\n    }\n\n    /// 当前段 id。\n    pub fn active_segment_id(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().active_id\n    }\n\n    /// 段信息快照（HTTP 状态接口用）。\n    pub fn segment_snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, String, u64, u64)> {\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        g.segments\n            .iter()\n            .map(|s| (s.id, s.file.clone(), s.start_seq, s.count))\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    /// 当前活动段大小（字节）。\n    pub fn active_len(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().active_len\n    }\n\n    /// frame_len)],\n                });\n            }\n        }\n        g.next_seq += 1;\n        Ok(seq)\n    }\n\n    /// 按序号读取已确认记录的载荷。\n    pub fn read(&self, seq: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n {\n            if !is_last {\n                // scan_segment 只会在文件末尾给出 torn tail；中间段出现即损坏。\n                return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                    \"{file}: truncated frame in the truncated_bytes;\n    report.truncated_segment = truncated_segment;\n\n    let active_id = seg_ids.last().copied();\n    let active_id = match active_id {\n        Some(id) => id,\n        None => {\n existing.matches_truth(&truth) {\n                // 索引可信，无需重写。\n            } else {\n                report.index_stale = true;\n                truth.persist(vfs)?;\n            }\n        }\n frame 模块）\n//!   seg-000001.log\n//!   ...\n//! ```\n//!\n//! ## 同步边界（哪些操作返回成功即已落盘）\n//!\n//! - **追加**：编码帧 → `write` → `fsync(段文件)`，两步都完成才返回确认；\n//!   之后掉电该记录必在。写入/同步失败时本存储库进入 poisoned 态，必须重新\n//!   `open` 恢复（避免在不确定的文件偏移上继续追加而覆盖数据）。\n//! - **轮转**：fsync 旧段 → 创建新段文件 → fsync 新空文件 → fsync 目录\n//!   （名字落盘）→ 原子写 index.json（tmp + fsync + rename + fsync 目录）。\n//! - **索引更新**：只通过原子 rename 发布，崩溃后要么旧索引、要么新索引，\n//!   扫描段文件即可校验/重建，因此“轮转与索引更新可恢复”。\n//!\n//! ## 恢复规则\n//!\n//! - 只允许**最后一段**文件末尾存在不完整帧（撕裂尾部），打开时 fsync 截断丢弃；\n//! - 中间段的任何不完整帧、任何完整帧的 magic/CRC/长度错误、任何序号不连续，\n//!   一律 [`Error::Corrupt`] 报错，拒绝打开（不丢数据、不静默跳过）；\n//! - 最后一段若为空文件则作为当前活动段保留；中间空段是损坏。\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Seek, SeekFrom};\nuse std::sync::Mutex;\n\nuse crate::frame::{self, Record};\nuse crate::index::{\n    self, load_index, segment_file, Index, SegmentInfo, INDEX_FILE,\n};\nuse crate::vfs::{self, IoError, IoResult, Vfs};\n\n/// 默认轮转阈值（段文件达到该字节数后，下一次追加会先轮转）。\npub const DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES: u64 = 8 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n/// 存储库错误。\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub enum Error {\n    /// 磁盘日志损坏（中间段不完整、CRC/magic/长度错、序号不连续等）。拒绝打开。\n    Corrupt(String),\n    /// I/O 故障（含被注入的故障）。\n    Io(IoError),\n    /// 载荷超过帧格式上限。\n    PayloadTooLarge { len: usize, max: u32 },\n    /// 存储库已因前一次 I/O 失败进入 poisoned 态，必须重新 open。\n    Poisoned,\n    /// 序号不存在（尚未写入或已经…本实现不支持删除，故只会是尚未写入）。\n    NoSuchSeq(u64),\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for Error {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        match self {\n            Error::Corrupt(s) => write!(f, \"log corrupt: {s}\"),\n            Error::Io(e) => write!(f, \"i/o error: {e}\"),\n            Error::PayloadTooLarge { len, max } => {\n                write!(f, \"payload {len} bytes exceeds max {max}\")\n            }\n            Error::Poisoned => write!(f, \"store is poisoned after an i/o failure; reopen required\"),\n            Error::NoSuchSeq(n) => write!(f, \"no record with seq {n}\"),\n        }\n    }\n}\nimpl std::error::Error for Error {}\n\nimpl From<IoError> for Error {\n    fn from(e: IoError) -> Self {\n        Error::Io(e)\n    }\n}\n\npub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;\n\n/// 打开/恢复结果报告（可通过 HTTP `/recovery` 查看）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Default)]\npub struct OpenReport {\n    /// 打开时磁盘上的段文件数。\n    pub segment_files: usize,\n    /// 恢复后保留的段数。\n    pub segments: usize,\n    /// 下一序号（= 已确认记录数）。\n    pub next_seq: u64,\n    /// 是否丢弃了最后一段的不完整尾部。\n    pub truncated_tail: bool,\n    /// 被丢弃的尾部字节数。\n    pub truncated_bytes: u64,\n    /// 撕裂尾部所在段 id（若有）。\n    pub truncated_segment: Option<u64>,\n    /// 被删除的遗留临时文件（如 index.json.tmp、seg-*.tmp）。\n    pub removed_tmp_files: Vec<String>,\n    /// 索引此前缺失（已重建）。\n    pub index_missing: bool,\n    /// 索引此前损坏（JSON/版本非法，已重建）。\n    pub index_corrupt: bool,\n    /// 索引内容与段文件不一致（已重建）。\n    pub index_stale: bool,\n    /// 与日志无关、被忽略的文件。\n    pub ignored_files: Vec<String>,\n}\n\n/// 打开恢复的返回：存储库 + 恢复报告。\npub type RecoveryResult<T> = (T, OpenReport);\n\nstruct Inner {\n    active: Box<dyn Vfile>,\n    active_id: u64,\n    active_len: u64,\n    next_seq: u64,\n    segments: Vec<SegmentInfo>,\n    poisoned: bool,\n}\n\n/// 分段追加日志存储库。\npub struct LogStore {\n    vfs: Box<dyn Vfs>,\n    max_segment_bytes: u64,\n    inner: Mutex<Inner>,\n}\n\nimpl LogStore {\n    /// 在给定（可注入）文件系统上打开并恢复。\n    pub fn open_with(vfs: Box<dyn Vfs>, max_segment_bytes: u64) -> Result<RecoveryResult<Self>> {\n        let (segments, next_seq, active_id, report) = recover(vfs.as_ref())?;\n\n        let active_path = segment_file(active_id);\n        let active = vfs.open_append(&active_path)?;\n        let active_len = vfs.file_len(&active_path)?;\n\n        let store = LogStore {\n            vfs,\n            max_segment_bytes,\n            inner: Mutex::new(Inner {\n                active,\n                active_id,\n                active_len,\n                next_seq,\n                segments,\n                poisoned: false,\n            }),\n        };\n        Ok((store, report))\n    }\n\n    /// 在真实文件系统目录上打开并恢复。\n    pub fn open_dir<P: AsRef<std::path::Path>>(\n        path: P,\n        max_segment_bytes: Option<u64>,\n    ) -> std::io::Result<RecoveryResult<Self>> {\n        let fs = vfs::RealFs::open(path)?;\n        Self::open_with(Box::new(fs), max_segment_bytes.unwrap_or(DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES))\n            .map_err(into_io_err)\n    }\n\n    /// 已确认记录数（即下一个序号）。\n    pub fn next_seq(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().next_seq\n    }\n\n    /// 当前段 id。\n    pub fn active_segment_id(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().active_id\n    }\n\n    /// 段信息快照（HTTP 状态接口用）。\n    pub fn segment_snapshot(&self) -> Vec<(u64, String, u64, u64)> {\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        g.segments\n            .iter()\n            .map(|s| (s.id, s.file.clone(), s.start_seq, s.count))\n            .collect()\n    }\n\n    /// 当前活动段大小（字节）。\n    pub fn active_len(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.inner.lock().unwrap().active_len\n    }\n\n    /// 追加一条记录，返回分配的序号。返回成功即已 fsync 落盘。\n    pub fn append(&self, payload: &[u8]) -> Result<u64> {\n        if payload.len() as u64 > frame::MAX_PAYLOAD_LEN as u64 {\n            return Err(Error::PayloadTooLarge { len: payload.len(), max: frame::MAX_PAYLOAD_LEN });\n        }\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        if g.poisoned {\n            return Err(Error::Poisoned);\n        }\n\n        // 达到轮转阈值则先轮转（当前活动段非空才轮）。\n        if g.active_len >= self.max_segment_bytes && g.active_len > 0 {\n            if let Err(e) = self.rotate_locked(&mut g) {\n                g.poisoned = true;\n                return Err(e);\n            }\n        }\n\n        let seq = g.next_seq;\n        let frame_bytes = frame::encode_frame(seq, payload);\n        let offset = g.active_len;\n\n        // 写 + fsync；任何失败都 poison，绝不继续在该句柄上追加。\n        if let Err(e) = (|| -> IoResult<()> {\n            g.active.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset)).map_err(io_map)?;\n            vfs::write_all_check(&mut g.active, &frame_bytes)?;\n            g.active.sync_file()?;\n            Ok(())\n        })() {\n            g.poisoned = true;\n            return Err(Error::Io(e));\n        }\n\n        g.active_len += frame_bytes.len() as u64;\n        let frame_len = frame_bytes.len() as u64;\n        match g.segments.last_mut() {\n            Some(seg) if seg.id == g.active_id => {\n                seg.count += 1;\n                seg.offsets.push((offset, frame_len));\n            }\n            _ => {\n                g.segments.push(SegmentInfo {\n                    id: g.active_id,\n                    file: segment_file(g.active_id),\n                    start_seq: seq,\n                    count: 1,\n                    offsets: vec![(offset, frame_len)],\n                });\n            }\n        }\n        g.next_seq += 1;\n        Ok(seq)\n    }\n\n    /// 按序号读取已确认记录的载荷。\n    pub fn read(&self, seq: u64) -> Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        if seq >= g.next_seq {\n            return Err(Error::NoSuchSeq(seq));\n        }\n        let seg = g\n            .segments\n            .iter()\n            .find(|s| s.contains_seq(seq))\n            .ok_or(Error::NoSuchSeq(seq))?;\n        let idx = (seq - seg.start_seq) as usize;\n        let (offset, frame_len) = seg.offsets.get(idx).copied().ok_or(Error::NoSuchSeq(seq))?;\n        let mut f = self.vfs.open_read(&seg.file)?;\n        f.seek(SeekFrom::Start(offset)).map_err(io_map)?;\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; frame_len as usize];\n        f.read_exact(&mut buf).map_err(io_map)?;\n        let (got_seq, payload) = frame::decode_one(&buf).map_err(|e| Error::Corrupt(e.to_string()))?;\n        if got_seq != seq {\n            return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                \"read seq {} but frame on disk carries seq {}\",\n                seq, got_seq\n            )));\n        }\n        Ok(payload)\n    }\n\n    /// 强制轮转：关闭当前段，启用新的空段。返回新段 id。\n    pub fn rotate(&self) -> Result<u64> {\n        let mut g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n        if g.poisoned {\n            return Err(Error::Poisoned);\n        }\n        self.rotate_locked(&mut g)\n    }\n\n    fn rotate_locked(&self, g: &mut Inner) -> Result<u64> {\n        // 1) 旧段已 fsync（追加路径每条都 fsync，这里再确保一次）。\n        g.active.sync_file()?;\n\n        let new_id = g.active_id + 1;\n        let new_file = segment_file(new_id);\n\n        // 2) 创建新段文件并 fsync 内容（空），再 fsync 目录让名字落盘。\n        let mut new_active = self.vfs.create(&new_file)?;\n        new_active.sync_file()?;\n        drop(new_active);\n        self.vfs.sync_dir()?;\n\n        // 3) 原子更新索引。\n        let idx = Index::from_infos(new_id, g.next_seq, &g.segments);\n        idx.persist(self.vfs.as_ref())?;\n\n        // 4) 切换内存活动句柄。\n        g.active = self.vfs.open_append(&new_file)?;\n        g.active_id = new_id;\n        g.active_len = 0;\n        // 为新段建立内存元数据（count 0，后续 append 直接命中）。\n        g.segments.push(SegmentInfo {\n            id: new_id,\n            file: new_file,\n            start_seq: g.next_seq,\n            count: 0,\n            offsets: Vec::new(),\n        });\n        Ok(new_id)\n    }\n\n    /// 逐段迭代已确认记录（CLI/测试验证用）。对每个已确认记录调用 f；\n    /// f 返回 false 时提前停止。\n    pub fn scan_records(&self, mut f: impl FnMut(&Record) -> bool) -> Result<()> {\n        let snapshots: Vec<(String, u64)> = {\n            let g = self.inner.lock().unwrap();\n            g.segments.iter().map(|s| (s.file.clone(), s.count)).collect()\n        };\n        let mut expect = 0u64;\n        for (file, count) in snapshots {\n            let data = vfs::read_all(self.vfs.as_ref(), &file)?;\n            let scan = frame::scan_segment(&data, expect)\n                .map_err(|e| Error::Corrupt(e.to_string()))?;\n            for r in &scan.records {\n                if !f(r) {\n                    return Ok(());\n                }\n            }\n            expect += scan.records.len() as u64;\n            if scan.records.len() as u64 != count {\n                return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                    \"live scan of {file} found {} records, index says {count}\",\n                    scan.records.len()\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// 打开恢复\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn recover(vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> Result<(Vec<SegmentInfo>, u64, u64, OpenReport)> {\n    let mut report = OpenReport::default();\n\n    // 1) 列出文件，删除遗留 *.tmp（任何 tmp 都是未完成的原子写/轮转残留）。\n    let names = vfs.list()?;\n    let mut seg_ids: Vec<u64> = Vec::new();\n    for name in names {\n        if name.ends_with(\".tmp\") {\n            vfs.remove(&name)?;\n            vfs.sync_dir()?;\n            report.removed_tmp_files.push(name);\n            continue;\n        }\n        if name == INDEX_FILE {\n            continue;\n        }\n        if let Some(id) = index::parse_segment_name(&name) {\n            seg_ids.push(id);\n        } else {\n            report.ignored_files.push(name);\n        }\n    }\n    seg_ids.sort_unstable();\n    seg_ids.dedup();\n    report.segment_files = seg_ids.len();\n\n    // 2) 逐段扫描；只允许最后一段有撕裂尾部。\n    let mut infos: Vec<SegmentInfo> = Vec::new();\n    let mut next_seq = 0u64;\n    let mut truncated_tail = false;\n    let mut truncated_bytes = 0u64;\n    let mut truncated_segment = None;\n\n    for (pos, &id) in seg_ids.iter().enumerate() {\n        let is_last = pos + 1 == seg_ids.len();\n        let file = segment_file(id);\n        let data = vfs::read_all(vfs, &file)?;\n\n        // 中间空段是损坏（轮转要么完整提交新段+索引，要么整体没发生）。\n        if !is_last && data.is_empty() {\n            return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\"non-last segment {file} is empty\")));\n        }\n\n        let scan = frame::scan_segment(&data, next_seq).map_err(|e| {\n            Error::Corrupt(format!(\"{file}: {e}\"))\n        })?;\n\n        if scan.torn_tail_len > 0 {\n            if !is_last {\n                // scan_segment 只会在文件末尾给出 torn tail；中间段出现即损坏。\n                return Err(Error::Corrupt(format!(\n                    \"{file}: truncated frame in the middle of the log ({} trailing bytes)\",\n                    scan.torn_tail_len\n                )));\n            }\n            // 最后一段：fsync 截断到 valid_len，丢弃不完整尾部。\n            vfs.truncate(&file, scan.valid_len)?;\n            truncated_tail = true;\n            truncated_bytes = scan.torn_tail_len;\n            truncated_segment = Some(id);\n        }\n\n        let count = scan.records.len() as u64;\n        // 全空最后一段（活动段，刚轮转还没写入）也登记。\n        let offsets = scan\n            .records\n            .iter()\n            .map(|r| (r.offset, r.frame_len))\n            .collect();\n        infos.push(SegmentInfo { id, file: file.clone(), start_seq: next_seq, count, offsets });\n        next_seq += count;\n    }\n\n    report.truncated_tail = truncated_tail;\n    report.truncated_bytes = truncated_bytes;\n    report.truncated_segment = truncated_segment;\n\n    let active_id = seg_ids.last().copied();\n    let active_id = match active_id {\n        Some(id) => id,\n        None => {\n            // 全新存储库：创建第 0 段。\n            let f0 = segment_file(0);\n            let mut f = vfs.create(&f0)?;\n            f.sync_file()?;\n            drop(f);\n            vfs.sync_dir()?;\n            infos.push(SegmentInfo {\n                id: 0,\n                file: f0,\n                start_seq: 0,\n                count: 0,\n                offsets: Vec::new(),\n            });\n            0u64\n        }\n    };\n\n    // 3) 校验/重建索引。\n    let truth = Index::from_infos(active_id, next_seq, &infos);\n    match load_index(vfs)? {\n        Ok(Some(existing)) => {\n            if existing.matches_truth(&truth) {\n                // 索引可信，无需重写。\n            } else {\n                report.index_stale = true;\n                truth.persist(vfs)?;\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(None) => {\n            report.index_missing = true;\n            truth.persist(vfs)?;\n        }\n        Err(_bad) => {\n            report.index_corrupt = true;\n            truth.persist(vfs)?;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 截断发生后再确保目录项持久（truncate 本身已 fsync 文件；索引原子写已 fsync 目录）。\n    report.segments = infos.len();\n    report.next_seq = next_seq;\n\n    Ok((infos, next_seq, active_id, report))\n}\n\nfn io_map(e: std::io::Error) -> IoError {\n    IoError::failed(e.to_string())\n}\n\nfn into_io_err(e: Error) -> std::io::Error {\n    match e {\n        Error::Io(ioe) => std::io::Error::other(ioe.to_string()),\n        other => std::io::Error::other(other.to_string()),\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"85ab8d10-9751-4120-b492-5a9f812757bb","session_id":"0619b744-6ef1-4a24-8ae6-22ef75415811","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/a","sessionId":"0619b744-6ef1-4a24-8ae6-22ef75415811","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-a","slug":"serialized-riding-treehouse"}

本地 HTTP 验证入口。\n//!\n//! 零依赖、`std::net` 手写的小型 HTTP/1.1 服务器，仅供本地验证。\n//! 每个连接一个线程，不支持 keep-alive（响应后关闭）。\n//!\n//! ## 路由\n//!\n//! | 方法 路径 | 作用 |\n//! |---|---|\n//! | `GET  /healthz` | 存活检查 |\n//! | `GET  /status`  | next_seq、活动段、段清单、阈值 |\n//! | `GET  /recovery`| 启动恢复报告（尾部截断/索引重建等） |\n//! | `POST /append`  | body 原样作为一条记录追加；返回 seq |\n//! | `GET  /records/{seq}` | 读取一条记录（hex + base64 + 尽力 UTF-8） |\n//! | `POST /rotate`  | 强制轮转，返回新段 id |\n//!\n//! 所有响应（包括错误）都是 JSON。POST body 最大 20 MiB。\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse crate::encoding::{base64_encode, json_escape};\nuse crate::store::{LogStore, OpenReport};\nuse crate::vfs;\n\nconst MAX_BODY: usize = 20 * 1024 * 1024;\nconst READ_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);\n\n/// 服务器共享状态。\npub struct Server {\n    store: Arc<LogStore>,\n    report: OpenReport,\n    max_bytes: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Server {\n    pub fn new(store: LogStore, report: OpenReport, max_bytes: u64) -> Arc<Self> {\n        Arc::new(Server { store: Arc::new(store), report, max_bytes })\n    }\n\n    /// 阻塞监听并服务，直到进程结束。返回绑定的实际地址。\n    pub fn serve(self: Arc<Self>, bind: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(bind)?;\n        eprintln!(\"seglog listening on http://{}\", listener.local_addr()?);\n        for stream in listener.incoming() {\n            match stream {\n                Ok(stream) => {\n                    let state = self.clone();\n                    std::thread::spawn(move || {\n                        let _ = handle_connection(state, stream);\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept failed: {e}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    content_length: usize,\n}\n\nfn handle_connection(state: Arc<Server>, mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(READ_TIMEOUT))?;\n    stream.set_write_timeout(Some(READ_TIMEOUT))?;\n\n    let req = match read_request_head(&mut stream) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => {\n            send_json(&mut stream, 400, &object(&[(\"error\", json(&e))]))?;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n    };\n\n    let mut body = Vec::new();\n    if req.content_length > 0 {\n        if req.content_length > MAX_BODY {\n            send_json(\n                &mut stream,\n                413,\n                &object(&[(\"error\", json(\"request body too large\"))]),\n            )?;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        body = vec![0u8; req.content_length];\n        stream.read_exact(&mut body)?;\n    }\n\n    let status = dispatch(&state, &req, &body, &mut stream);\n    // dispatch 内部已写响应；status 仅用于日志。\n    if status >= 500 {\n        eprintln!(\"{} {} -> {}\", req.method, req.path, status);\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn read_request_head(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<Request> {\n    let mut head = Vec::new();\n    let mut byte = [0u8; 1];\n    loop {\n        if head.len() > 64 * 1024 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::other(\"request headers too large\"));\n        }\n        let n = stream.read(&mut byte)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::other(\"connection closed before request\"));\n        }\n        head.push(byte[0]);\n        if head.len() >= 4 && &head[head.len() - 4..] == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\" {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&head);\n    let mut lines = text.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let status_line = lines.next().ok_or_else(|| std::io::Error::other(\"empty request\"))?;\n    let mut parts = status_line.split_whitespace();\n    let method = parts.next().ok_or_else(|| std::io::Error::other(\"bad method\"))?;\n    let target = parts.next().ok_or_else(|| std::io::Error::other(\"bad target\"))?;\n    // 去掉 query string\n    let path = target.split('?').next().unwrap_or(\"/\");\n    let mut content_length = 0usize;\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some(rest) = line\n            .split_once(':')\n            .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_ascii_lowercase(), v.trim()))\n        {\n            if rest.0 == \"content-length\" {\n                content_length = rest\n                    .1\n                    .parse()\n                    .map_err(|_| std::io::Error::other(\"bad content-length\"))?;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(Request {\n        method: method.to_string(),\n        path: path.to_string(),\n        content_length,\n    })\n}\n\nfn dispatch(state: &Server, req: &Request, body: &[u8], out: &mut TcpStream) -> u16 {\n    match (req.method.as_str(), req.path.as_str()) {\n        (\"GET\", \"/healthz\") => send_json(out, 200, &object(&[(\"status\", json(\"ok\"))])),\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/status\") => {\n            let g = state;\n            let segs: Vec<String> = g\n                .store\n                .segment_snapshot()\n                .into_iter()\n                .map(|(id, file, start, count)| {\n                    object(&[\n                        (\"id\", num(id)),\n                        (\"file\", json(&file)),\n                        (\"start_seq\", num(start)),\n                        (\"count\", num(count)),\n                    ])\n                })\n                .collect();\n            let doc = object(&[\n                (\"next_seq\", num(state.store.next_seq())),\n                (\"active_segment\", num(state.store.active_segment_id())),\n                (\"active_segment_bytes\", num(state.store.active_len())),\n                (\"max_segment_bytes\", num(state.max_bytes)),\n                (\"segments\", array(&segs)),\n            ]);\n            send_json(out, 200, &doc)\n        }\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/recovery\") => send_json(out, 200, &recovery_json(&state.report)),\n\n        (\"POST\", \"/append\") => match state.store.append(body) {\n            Ok(seq) => send_json(\n                out,\n                200,\n                &object(&[\n                    (\"seq\", num(seq)),\n                    (\"bytes\", num(body.len() as u64)),\n                    (\"durable\", json(\"true\")),\n                ]),\n            ),\n            Err(e) => send_store_error(out, e),\n        },\n\n        (\"POST\", \"/rotate\") => match state.store.rotate() {\n            Ok(id) => send_json(out, 200, &object(&[(\"active_segment\", num(id))])),\n            Err(e) => send_store_error(out, e),\n        },\n\n        (m, p) if p.starts_with(\"/records/\") && m == \"GET\" => {\n            let raw = &p[\"/records/\".len()..];\n            match raw.parse::<u64>() {\n                Ok(seq) => match state.store.read(seq) {\n                    Ok(payload) => {\n                        let doc = object(&[\n                            (\"seq\", num(seq)),\n                            (\"bytes\", num(payload.len() as u64)),\n                            (\"hex\", json(&hex_lower(&payload))),\n                            (\"base64\", json(&base64_encode(&payload))),\n                            (\"utf8_lossy\", json(&json_escape(&payload))),\n                        ]);\n                        send_json(out, 200, &doc)\n                    }\n                    Err(crate::store::Error::NoSuchSeq(_)) => send_json(\n                        out,\n                        404,\n                        &object(&[(\"error\", json(&format!(\"no record with seq {seq}\")))]),\n                    ),\n                    Err(e) => send_store_error(out, e),\n                },\n                Err(_) => send_json(out, 400, &object(&[(\"error\", json(\"seq must be u64\"))])),\n            }\n        }\n\n        _ => send_json(\n            out,\n            404,\n            &object(&[(\"error\", json(\"no such route\") )]),\n        ),\n    }\n    .map(|_| 0)\n    .unwrap_or(500)\n}\n\nfn send_store_error(out: &mut TcpStream, e: crate::store::Error) -> std::io::Result<u16> {\n    use crate::store::Error;\n    let (code, msg) = match &e {\n        Error::NoSuchSeq(n) => (404, format!(\"no record with seq {n}\")),\n        Error::PayloadTooLarge { .. } => (413, e.to_string()),\n        Error::Corrupt(_) => (500, e.to_string()),\n        Error::Poisoned => (503, e.to_string()),\n        Error::Io(_) => (500, e.to_string()),\n    };\n    send_json(out, code, &object(&[(\"error\", json(&msg))]))?;\n    Ok(code)\n}\n\nfn recovery_json(r: &OpenReport) -> String {\n    object(&[\n        (\"segment_files\", num(r.segment_files as u64)),\n        (\"segments\", num(r.segments as u64)),\n        (\"next_seq\", num(r.next_seq)),\n        (\"truncated_tail\", json(if r.truncated_tail { \"true\" } else { \"false\" })),\n        (\"truncated_bytes\", num(r.truncated_bytes)),\n        (\n            \"truncated_segment\",\n            match r.truncated_segment {\n                Some(id) => num(id),\n                None => json(\"null\"),\n            },\n        ),\n        (\"index_missing\", json(if r.index_missing { \"true\" } else { \"false\" })),\n        (\"index_corrupt\", json(if r.index_corrupt { \"true\" } else { \"false\" })),\n        (\"index_stale\", json(if r.index_stale { \"true\" } else { \"false\" })),\n        (\n            \"removed_tmp_files\",\n            array(&r.removed_tmp_files.iter().map(|s| json(s)).collect::<Vec<_>>()),\n        ),\n        (\n            \"ignored_files\",\n            array(&r.ignored_files.iter().map(|s| json(s)).collect::<Vec<_>>()),\n        ),\n    ])\n}\n\n// --- 极简 JSON 构造（值均来自内部数据或已转义的字节串） ---\n\nfn json(s: &str) -> String {\n    // 用于已经安全（内部常量/数字转字符串）的字符串\n    format!(\"\\\"{}\\\"\", s)\n}\n\nfn num(n: u64) -> String {\n    n.to_string()\n}\n\nfn object(pairs: &[(&str, String)]) -> String {\n    let parts: Vec<String> = pairs.iter().map(|(k, v)| format!(\"\\\"{k}\\\": {v}\")).collect();\n    format!(\"{{{}}}\", parts.join(\", \"))\n}\n\nfn array(items: &[String]) -> String {\n    format!(\"[{}]\", items.join(\", \"))\n}\n\nfn hex_lower(data: &[u8]) -> String {\n    let mut s = String::with_capacity(data.len() * 2);\n    for b in data {\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"{:02x}\", b));\n    }\n    s\n}\n\nfn send_json(out: &mut TcpStream, status: u16, body: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let reason = match status {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        413 => \"Payload Too Large\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        503 => \"Service Unavailable\",\n        _ => \"OK\",\n    };\n    let resp = format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {} {}\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n{}\",\n        status,\n        reason,\n        body.len(),\n        body\n    );\n    out.write_all(resp.as_bytes())?;\n    out.flush()\n}\n\n/// 便捷启动：真实 FS + 默认阈值。\npub fn serve_dir(data_dir: &str, bind: &str, max_bytes: Option<u64>) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let threshold = max_bytes.unwrap_or(crate::store::DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES);\n    let fs = vfs::RealFs::open(data_dir)?;\n    let (store, report) = crate::store::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), threshold)\n        .map_err(|e| std::io::Error::other(e.to_string()))?;\n    let server = Server::new(store, report, threshold);\n    server.serve(bind)\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_5ea2829d8f6a4058117f46bc","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":5821,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":77624,"output_tokens":3584,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_nyg8bfexbk5p3hf7h0ijatam":{"content":"//! |\n//! | `POST /rotate`  | 强制轮转，返回新段 id |\n//!\n//! 所有响应（包括错误）都是 JSON。POST body 最大 20 MiB。\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nuse crate::encoding::{base64_encode, json_escape};\nuse crate::store::{LogStore, OpenReport};\nuse crate::vfs;\n\nconst MAX_BODY: usize = 20 * 1024 * 1024;\nconst READ_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(10);\n\n/// 服务器共享状态。\npub struct Server {\n    store: Arc<LogStore>,\n    report: OpenReport,\n    max_bytes: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Server {\n    pub fn new(store: LogStore, report: OpenReport, max_bytes: u64) -> Arc<Self> {\n        Arc::new(Server { store: Arc::new(store), report, max_bytes })\n    }\n\n    /// 阻塞监听并服务，直到进程结束。返回绑定的实际地址。\n    pub fn serve(self: Arc<Self>, bind: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(bind)?;\n        eprintln!(\"seglog listening on http://{}\", listener.local_addr()?);\n        for stream in listener.incoming() {\n            match stream {\n                Ok(stream) => {\n                    let state = self.clone();\n                    std::thread::spawn(move || {\n                        let _ = handle_connection(state, stream);\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept failed: {e}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    content_length: usize,\n}\n\nfn handle_connection(state: Arc<Server>, mut stream: TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(READ_TIMEOUT))?;\n    stream.set_write_timeout(Some(READ_TIMEOUT))?;\n\n    let req = match read_request_head(&mut stream) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => {\n            send_json(&mut stream, 400, &object(&[(\"error\", json(&e))]))?;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n    };\n\n    let mut body = Vec::new();\n    if req.content_length > 0 {\n        if req.content_length > MAX_BODY {\n            send_json(\n                &mut stream,\n                413,\n                &object(&[(\"error\", json(\"request body too large\"))]),\n            )?;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        body = vec![0u8; req.content_length];\n        stream.read_exact(&mut body)?;\n    }\n\n    let status = dispatch(&state, &req, &body, &mut stream);\n    // dispatch 内部已写响应；status 仅用于日志。\n    if status >= 500 {\n        eprintln!(\"{} {} -> {}\", req.method, req.path, status);\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn read_request_head(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> std::io::Result<Request> {\n    let mut head = Vec::new();\n    let mut byte = [0u8; 1];\n    loop {\n        if head.len() > 64 * 1024 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::other(\"request headers too large\"));\n        }\n        let n = stream.read(&mut byte)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Err(std::io::Error::other(\"connection closed before request\"));\n        }\n        head.push(byte[0]);\n        if head.len() >= 4 && &head[head.len() - 4..] == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\" {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    let text = target\"))?;\n    // 去掉 query string\n    let path = target.split('?').next().unwrap_or(\"/\");\n    let mut content_length = 0usize;\n    for line in lines {\n        if let Some(rest) = line\n            .split_once(':')\n            .map(|(k, v)| (k.to_ascii_lowercase(), v.trim()))\n        {\n            if rest.0 == \"content-length\" {\n                content_length = rest\n                    .1\n                    .parse()\n                    .map_err(|_| std::io::Error::other(\"bad content-length\"))?;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(Request {\n        method: method.to_string(),\n        path: path.to_string(),\n        content_length,\n    })\n}\n\nfn dispatch(state: &Server, req: &Request, body: &[u8], out: &mut TcpStream) -> u16 {\n    match (req.method.as_str(), req.path.as_str()) {\n        (\"GET\", \"/healthz\") => send_json(out, 200, &object(&[(\"status\", json(\"ok\"))])),\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/status\") => {\n            let g = state;\n            let segs: Vec<String> = g\n                .store\n                .segment_snapshot()\n                .into_iter()\n                .map(|(id, file, start, count)| {\n (\"count\", num(count)),\n                    ])\n                })\n                .collect();\n            let doc = object(&[\n                (\"next_seq\", num(state.store.next_seq())),\n &recovery_json(&state.report)),\n\n        (\"POST\", \"/append\") => match state.store.append(body) {\n            Ok(seq) => send_json(\n                out,\n                200,\n                &object(&[\n                    (\"seq\", num(seq)),\n                    (\"bytes\", num(body.len() as u64)),\n                    (\"durable\", json(\"true\")),\n                ]),\n            ),\n            Err(e) => send_store_error(out, e),\n        },\n\n        (\"POST\", \"/rotate\") => match state.store.rotate() {\n            Ok(id) => send_json(out, 200, &object(&[(\"active_segment\", num(id))])),\n            Err(e) => send_store_error(out, e),\n        },\n\n        (m, p) if p.starts_with(\"/records/\") && m == \"GET\" => {\n            let raw = &p[\"/records/\".len()..];\n            match raw.parse::<u64>() {\n                Ok(seq) => match state.store.read(seq) {\n                    Ok(payload) => {\n                        let doc = object(&[\n                            (\"seq\", num(seq)),\n                            (\"bytes\", num(payload.len() as u64)),\n                            (\"hex\", json(&hex_lower(&payload))),\n                            (\"base64\", json(&base64_encode(&payload))),\n                            (\"utf8_lossy\", json(&json_escape(&payload))),\n                        ]);\n                        send_json(out, 200, &doc)\n                    }\n                    Err(crate::store::Error::NoSuchSeq(_)) => send_json(\n                        out,\n                        404,\n                        &object(&[(\"error\", json(&format!(\"no record with seq {seq}\")))]),\n                    ),\n                    Err(e) => send_store_error(out, e),\n                },\n                Err(_) => send_json(out, 400, &object(&[(\"error\", json(\"seq must be u64\"))])),\n            }\n        }\n\n        _ => send_json(\n            out,\n            404,\n            &object(&[(\"error\", json(\"no such route\") )]),\n        ),\n    }\n    .map(|_| 0)\n    .unwrap_or(500)\n}\n\nfn send_store_error(out: &mut TcpStream, e: crate::store::Error) -> std::io::Result<u16> {\n    use crate::store::Error;\n    let (code, msg) = match &e {\n        Error::NoSuchSeq(n) => (404, format!(\"no record with seq {n}\")),\n        Error::PayloadTooLarge { .. } => (413, e.to_string()),\n        Error::Corrupt(_) => (500, e.to_string()),\n        Error::Poisoned => (503, e.to_string()),\n        Error::Io(_) => (500, e.to_string()),\n    };\n json(\"null\"),\n            },\n        ),\n        (\"index_missing\", json(if r.index_missing { \"true\" } else { \"false\" })),\n        (\"index_corrupt\", json(if r.index_corrupt { \"true\" } seglog 命令行入口（纯后端）。\n//!\n//! 用法：\n//! ```text\n//! seglog serve   <data-dir> [--bind 127.0.0.1:8080] [--max-segment-bytes N]\n//! seglog append  <data-dir> [--stdin | 文本参数...]   # 追加一条记录，打印 seq\n//! seglog read    <data-dir> <seq> [--hex]            # 读取一条记录\n//! seglog replay  <data-dir>                          # 顺序回放全部已确认记录\n//! ```\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\n\nuse seglog::store::{DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES, LogStore};\n\nfn main() {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();\n    let prog = args.first().map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"seglog\");\n    let code = match run(&args[..]) {\n        Ok(()) => 0,\n        Err(msg) => {\n            eprintln!(\"{prog}: {msg}\");\n            1\n        }\n    };\n    std::process::exit(code);\n}\n\nfn run(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let cmd = args.get(1).cloned().ok_or_else(|| usage())?;\n    match cmd.as_str() {\n        \"serve\" => cmd_serve(&args[2..]),\n        \"append\" => cmd_append(&args[2..]),\n        \"read\" => cmd_read(&args[2..]),\n        \"replay\" => cmd_replay(&args[2..]),\n        \"-h\" | \"--help\" | \"help\" => {\n            println!(\"{}\", usage());\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        other => Err(format!(\"unknown subcommand {other:?}\\n\\n{}\", usage())),\n    }\n}\n\nfn usage() -> String {\n    \"USAGE:\\n  \\\n     seglog serve   <data-dir> [--bind ADDR] [--max-segment-bytes N]\\n  \\\n     seglog append  <data-dir> (--stdin | <text>...)\\n  \\\n     seglog read    <data-dir> <seq> [--hex]\\n  \\\n     seglog replay  <data-dir>\"\n        .to_string()\n}\n\nfn parse_serve(args: &[String]) -> Result<(String, String, u64), String> {\n    let mut data_dir = None;\n    let mut bind = \"127.0.0.1:8080\".to_string();\n    let mut max_bytes = DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES;\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < args.len() {\n        match args[i].as_str() {\n            \"--bind\" => {\n                bind = args.get(i + 1).cloned().ok_or(\"--bind needs a value\")?;\n                i += 2;\n            }\n            \"--max-segment-bytes\" => {\n                let v = args.get(i + 1).ok_or(\"--max-segment-bytes needs a value\")?;\n                max_bytes = v.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| \"bad size\".to_string())?;\n                i += 2;\n            }\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") && data_dir.is_none() => {\n                data_dir = Some(other.to_string());\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            other => return Err(format!(\"unexpected argument {other}\")),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok((data_dir.ok_or(\"missing <data-dir>\")?, bind, max_bytes))\n}\n\nfn cmd_serve(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let (data_dir, bind, max_bytes) = parse_serve(args)?;\n    seglog::http::serve_dir(&data_dir, &bind, Some(max_bytes)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n\nfn cmd_append(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut data_dir = None;\n    let mut from_stdin = false;\n    let mut text: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n    for a in args {\n        match a.as_str() {\n            \"--stdin\" => from_stdin = true,\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") && data_dir.is_none() => data_dir = Some(other.clone()),\n            other => text.push(other.clone()),\n        }\n    }\n    let data_dir = data_dir.ok_or(\"missing <data-dir>\")?;\n    let payload: Vec<u8> = if from_stdin {\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        std::io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut buf).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n        buf\n    } else {\n        text.join(\" \").into_bytes()\n    };\n\n    let (store, report) =\n        LogStore::open_dir(&data_dir, None).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    if report.truncated_tail {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"recovery: discarded {} torn tail bytes from segment {}\",\n            report.truncated_bytes,\n            report.truncated_segment.unwrap_or(0)\n        );\n    }\n    let seq = store.append(&payload).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    println!(\"{seq}\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_read(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut data_dir = None;\n    let mut seq = None;\n    let mut hex = false;\n    for a in args {\n        match a.as_str() {\n            \"--hex\" => hex = true,\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") && data_dir.is_none() => data_dir = Some(other.clone()),\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") && seq.is_none() => {\n                seq = Some(other.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| \"seq must be u64\")?);\n            }\n            other => return Err(format!(\"unexpected argument {other}\")),\n        }\n    }\n    let data_dir = data_dir.ok_or(\"missing <data-dir>\")?;\n    let seq = seq.ok_or(\"missing <seq>\")?;\n    let (store, _) = LogStore::open_dir(&data_dir, None).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    let payload = store.read(seq).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    let mut out = std::io::stdout().lock();\n    if hex {\n        for b in &payload {\n            write!(out, \"{:02x}\", b).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n        }\n        writeln!(out).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    } else {\n        out.write_all(&payload).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n        out.write_all(b\"\\n\").map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_replay(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let data_dir = args.first().filter(|s| !s.starts_with(\"--\")).ok_or(\"missing <data-dir>\")?;\n    let (store, report) = LogStore::open_dir(data_dir, None).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    if report.truncated_tail {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"recovery: discarded {} torn tail bytes (segment {})\",\n            report.truncated_bytes,\n            report.truncated_segment.unwrap_or(0)\n        );\n    }\n    eprintln!(\n        \"replay: {} records across {} segment(s)\",\n        report.next_seq, report.segments\n    );\n    let mut out = std::io::stdout().lock();\n    store\n        .scan_records(|r| {\n            writeln!(\n                out,\n                \"seq={:<6} off={:<8} len={:<6} {}\",\n                r.seq,\n                r.offset,\n                r.payload.len(),\n                String::from_utf8_lossy(&r.payload)\n            )\n            .is_ok()\n        })\n        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_cde6aba5aa79629beab5d167","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1437,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":88888,"output_tokens":2091,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_kv2d018ofv1w3zgqu5sqoij1":{"content":"//! seglog::store::{DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES, LogStore};\n\nfn main() {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();\n    let prog = args.first().map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"seglog\");\n    let code = match run(&args[..]) {\n        Ok(()) => 0,\n        Err(msg) => {\n            eprintln!(\"{prog}: {msg}\");\n            1\n        }\n    };\n    std::process::exit(code);\n}\n\nfn run(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let cmd = args.get(1).cloned().ok_or_else(|| usage())?;\n    match cmd.as_str() {\n        \"serve\" => cmd_serve(&args[2..]),\n        \"append\" => cmd_append(&args[2..]),\n        \"read\" => cmd_read(&args[2..]),\n        \"replay\" => cmd_replay(&args[2..]),\n        \"-h\" | \"--help\" | \"help\" => {\n            println!(\"{}\", usage());\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        other => Err(format!(\"unknown subcommand {other:?}\\n\\n{}\", usage())),\n    }\n}\n\nfn usage() -> String {\n    \"USAGE:\\n  \\\n     seglog serve   <data-dir> [--bind ADDR] [--max-segment-bytes N]\\n  \\\n     seglog append  <data-dir> (--stdin | <text>...)\\n  \\\n     seglog read    <data-dir> <seq> [--hex]\\n  \\\n     seglog replay  <data-dir>\"\n        .to_string()\n}\n\nfn parse_serve(args: &[String]) -> Result<(String, String, u64), String> {\n    let mut data_dir = None;\n    let mut bind = \"127.0.0.1:8080\".to_string();\n    let mut max_bytes = DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES;\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < args.len() {\n        match args[i].as_str() {\n            \"--bind\" => {\n                bind = args.get(i + 1).cloned().ok_or(\"--bind needs a value\")?;\n                i += 2;\n            }\n            \"--max-segment-bytes\" => {\n                let v = args.get(i + 1).ok_or(\"--max-segment-bytes needs a value\")?;\n                max_bytes = v.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| \"bad size\".to_string())?;\n                i += 2;\n            }\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") && data_dir.is_none() => {\n                data_dir = Some(other.to_string());\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            other => return Err(format!(\"unexpected argument {other}\")),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok((data_dir.ok_or(\"missing <data-dir>\")?, bind, max_bytes))\n}\n\nfn cmd_serve(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let (data_dir, bind, max_bytes) = parse_serve(args)?;\n    seglog::http::serve_dir(&data_dir, &bind, Some(max_bytes)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n\nfn cmd_append(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut data_dir = None;\n    let mut from_stdin = false;\n    let mut text: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n    for a in args {\n        match a.as_str() {\n            \"--stdin\" => from_stdin = true,\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") && data_dir.is_none() => data_dir = Some(other.clone()),\n            other => text.push(other.clone()),\n        }\n    }\n    let data_dir = data_dir.ok_or(\"missing <data-dir>\")?;\n    let payload: Vec<u8> = if from_stdin {\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        std::io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut buf).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n        buf\n    } else {\n        text.join(\" \").into_bytes()\n    };\n\n    let (store, report) =\n        LogStore::open_dir(&data_dir, None).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    if report.truncated_tail {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"recovery: discarded {} torn tail bytes from segment {}\",\n            report.truncated_bytes,\n            report.truncated_segment.unwrap_or(0)\n        );\n    }\n    let seq = store.append(&payload).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    println!(\"{seq}\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_read(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut data_dir = None;\n    let mut seq = None;\n    let mut hex = false;\n    for a in args {\n        match a.as_str() {\n            \"--hex\" => hex = true,\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") && data_dir.is_none() => data_dir = Some(other.clone()),\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") && seq.is_none() => {\n                seq = Some(other.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| \"seq must be u64\")?);\n            }\n            other => return Err(format!(\"unexpected argument {other}\")),\n        }\n    }\n    let data_dir = data_dir.ok_or(\"missing <data-dir>\")?;\n    let seq = seq.ok_or(\"missing std::io::stdout().lock();\n    if hex {\n        for b in &payload {\n            write!(out, \"{:02x}\", b).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n        }\n        writeln!(out).map_err(|e|
