Ok(Index::parse(text).map(Some))","originalFile":"//! 索引/清单文件 `index.json` 与段元数据。\n//!\n//! 索引是**可重建的缓存**：真相永远是段文件本身。打开时若索引缺失、损坏或与\n//! 段文件不一致，存储库会从段扫描结果重建它，并用 [`Vfs::atomic_write`]\n//! （tmp + fsync + rename + fsync 目录）原子落盘 —— 因此轮转中途掉电、\n//! 索引更新到一半掉电都可以恢复。\n\nuse crate::json::Json;\nuse crate::vfs::{IoResult, Vfs};\n\n/// 索引文件名（固定）。\npub const INDEX_FILE: &str = \"index.json\";\n/// 索引格式版本。\npub const INDEX_VERSION: i64 = 1;\n/// 段文件名宽度：`seg-000000.log`。\npub const SEG_NAME_WIDTH: usize = 6;\npub const SEG_PREFIX: &str = \"seg-\";\npub const SEG_SUFFIX: &str = \".log\";\n\n/// 段文件名，如 `seg-000003.log`。\npub fn segment_file(id: u64) -> String {\n    format!(\"{SEG_PREFIX}{:0width$}{SEG_SUFFIX}\", id, width = SEG_NAME_WIDTH)\n}\n\n/// 识别段文件名并解析段 id；不匹配返回 None。\npub fn parse_segment_name(name: &str) -> Option<u64> {\n    let middle = name.strip_prefix(SEG_PREFIX)?.strip_suffix(SEG_SUFFIX)?;\n    if middle.len() != SEG_NAME_WIDTH || !middle.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) {\n        return None;\n    }\n    middle.parse::<u64>().ok()\n}\n\n/// 内存中的段元数据（打开时由扫描得到，运行期维护）。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SegmentInfo {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub file: String,\n    pub start_seq: u64,\n    /// 已确认记录数。\n    pub count: u64,\n    /// 每条记录在段内的字节偏移与整帧长度（按序号顺序）。\n    pub offsets: Vec<(u64, u64)>,\n}\n\nimpl SegmentInfo {\n    pub fn end_seq_exclusive(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.start_seq + self.count\n    }\n\n    pub fn contains_seq(&self, seq: u64) -> bool {\n        seq >= self.start_seq && seq < self.end_seq_exclusive()\n    }\n}\n\n/// 磁盘上的索引文档。\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Index {\n    pub active_segment: u64,\n    pub next_seq: u64,\n    pub segments: Vec<IndexSegment>,\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct IndexSegment {\n    pub id: u64,\n    pub file: String,\n    pub start_seq: u64,\n    pub count: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Index {\n    /// 由内存段信息生成索引。\n    pub fn from_infos(active_segment: u64, next_seq: u64, infos: &[SegmentInfo]) -> Index {\n        Index {\n            active_segment,\n            next_seq,\n            segments: infos\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| IndexSegment {\n                    id: s.id,\n                    file: s.file.clone(),\n                    start_seq: s.start_seq,\n                    count: s.count,\n                })\n                .collect(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// 序列化为 JSON 文本（紧凑、确定顺序）。\n    pub fn to_json(&self) -> String {\n        let mut s = String::new();\n        s.push_str(\"{\\n\");\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"version\\\": {},\\n\", INDEX_VERSION));\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"active_segment\\\": {},\\n\", self.active_segment));\n        s.push_str(&format!(\"  \\\"next_seq\\\": {},\\n\", self.next_seq));\n        s.push_str(\"  \\\"segments\\\": [\");\n        for (i, seg) in self.segments.iter().enumerate() {\n            if i > 0 {\n                s.push(',');\n            }\n            s.push_str(&format!(\n                \"\\n    {{\\\"id\\\": {}, \\\"file\\\": \\\"{}\\\", \\\"start_seq\\\": {}, \\\"count\\\": {}}}\",\n                seg.id, seg.file, seg.start_seq, seg.count\n            ));\n        }\n        if self.segments.is_empty() {\n            s.push(']');\n        } else {\n            s.push_str(\"\\n  ]\");\n        }\n        s.push_str(\"\\n}\\n\");\n        s\n    }\n\n    /// 解析索引文本。任何字段缺失/类型错误都返回 Err（调用方将重建）。\n    pub fn parse(text: &str) -> Result<Index, String> {\n        let doc = Json::parse(text)?;\n        let m = doc.field_map().ok_or(\"root is not object\")?;\n        let version = m.get(\"version\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing version\")?;\n        if version != INDEX_VERSION {\n            return Err(format!(\"unsupported index version {version}\"));\n        }\n        let active_segment =\n            m.get(\"active_segment\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing active_segment\")? as u64;\n        let next_seq = m.get(\"next_seq\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"missing next_seq\")? as u64;\n        let raw_segs = m.get(\"segments\").and_then(|v| v.as_array()).ok_or(\"missing segments\")?;\n        let mut segments = Vec::with_capacity(raw_segs.len());\n        for item in raw_segs {\n            let sm = item.field_map().ok_or(\"segment entry not object\")?;\n            let id = sm.get(\"id\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing id\")? as u64;\n            let file = sm.get(\"file\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).ok_or(\"segment missing file\")?;\n            let start_seq =\n                sm.get(\"start_seq\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing start_seq\")? as u64;\n            let count = sm.get(\"count\").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).ok_or(\"segment missing count\")? as u64;\n            segments.push(IndexSegment { id, file: file.to_string(), start_seq, count });\n        }\n        Ok(Index { active_segment, next_seq, segments })\n    }\n\n    /// 与段扫描真值比较：id/文件名/start_seq/count/active/next_seq 全一致才算可信。\n    pub fn matches_truth(&self, truth: &Index) -> bool {\n        if self.active_segment != truth.active_segment || self.next_seq != truth.next_seq {\n            return false;\n        }\n        if self.segments.len() != truth.segments.len() {\n            return false;\n        }\n        self.segments.iter().zip(&truth.segments).all(|(a, b)| {\n            a.id == b.id && a.file == b.file && a.start_seq == b.start_seq && a.count == b.count\n        })\n    }\n\n    /// 原子写入索引（tmp + fsync + rename + fsync 目录）。\n    pub fn persist(&self, vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<()> {\n        vfs.atomic_write(INDEX_FILE, self.to_json().as_bytes())\n    }\n}\n\n/// 读取并解析索引；文件不存在返回 Ok(None)，解析失败（损坏/版本不符）返回 Err。\npub fn load_index(vfs: &dyn Vfs) -> IoResult<Result<Option<Index>, String>> {\n    if !vfs.exists(INDEX_FILE)? {\n        return Ok(Ok(None));\n    }\n    let data = crate::vfs::read_all(vfs, INDEX_FILE)?;\n    let text = std::str::from_utf8(&data).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    Ok(Index::parse(text).map(Some))\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn segment_names_roundtrip() {\n        assert_eq!(segment_file(0), \"seg-000000.log\");\n        assert_eq!(segment_file(42), \"seg-000042.log\");\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-000003.log\"), Some(3));\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-00003.log\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"index.json\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-000000.log.tmp\"), None);\n        assert_eq!(parse_segment_name(\"seg-x.log\"), None);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn index_json_roundtrip_and_validation() {\n        let infos = vec![\n            SegmentInfo { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 3, offsets: vec![] },\n            SegmentInfo { id: 1, file: segment_file(1), start_seq: 3, count: 2, offsets: vec![] },\n        ];\n        let idx = Index::from_infos(1, 5, &infos);\n        let text = idx.to_json();\n        let parsed = Index::parse(&text).unwrap();\n        assert!(parsed.matches_truth(&idx));\n\n        // 坏文档\n        assert!(Index::parse(\"{\").is_err());\n        assert!(Index::parse(r#\"{\"version\":99}\"#).is_err());\n        assert!(Index::parse(r#\"{\"version\":1,\"active_segment\":0,\"next_seq\":0,\"segments\":[]}\"#).is_ok());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn mismatch_detection() {\n        let a = Index {\n            active_segment: 0,\n            next_seq: 1,\n            segments: vec![IndexSegment { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 1 }],\n        };\n        let mut b = a.clone();\n        b.next_seq = 2;\n        assert!(!a.matches_truth(&b));\n        b = a.clone();\n        b.segments[0].count = 0;\n        assert!(!a.matches_truth(&b));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn persist_and_reload_on_simfs() {\n        use crate::vfs::{SimDisk, SimFs};\n        let disk = SimDisk::new();\n        let fs = SimFs::new(disk);\n        let idx = Index {\n            active_segment: 1,\n            next_seq: 7,\n            segments: vec![\n                IndexSegment { id: 0, file: segment_file(0), start_seq: 0, count: 5 },\n                IndexSegment { id: 1, file: segment_file(1), start_seq: 5, count: 2 },\n            ],\n        };\n        idx.persist(&fs).unwrap();\n        let loaded = load_index(&fs).unwrap().unwrap().unwrap();\n        assert!(loaded.matches_truth(&idx));\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":163,"oldLines":7,"newStart":163,"newLines":10,"lines":["         return Ok(Ok(None));","     }","     let data = IEEE 802.3 CRC-32（与 zlib/PNG 一致：poly 0xEDB88320，初值/异或出值 0xFFFFFFFF）。\n\n/// 计算 `data` 的 CRC-32。空输入返回 0。\npub fn checksum(data: &[u8]) -> u32 {\n    let mut crc: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;\n    for &b in data {\n        crc = (crc >> 8) ^ TABLE[((crc ^ b as u32) & 0xFF) as usize];\n    }\n    crc ^ 0xFFFF_FFFF\n}\n\nstatic TABLE: [u32; 256] = build_table();\n\nconst fn build_table() -> [u32; 256] {\n    let mut table = [0u32; 256];\n    let mut n = 0usize;\n    while n < 256 {\n        let mut c = n as u32;\n        let mut k = 0;\n        while k < 8 {\n            c = if c & 1 != 0 { 0xEDB8_8320 ^ (c >> 1) } else { c >> 1 };\n            k += 1;\n        }\n        table[n] = c;\n        n += 1;\n    }\n    table\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn known_vectors() {\n        // 标准 CRC-32 校验向量\n        assert_eq!(checksum(b\"\"), 0x0000_0000);\n        assert_eq!(checksum(b\"123456789\"), 0xCBF4_3926);\n        assert_eq!(checksum(b\"a\"), 0xE8B7_BE16);\n        assert_eq!(checksum(b\"hello\"), 0x3610_A686);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn any_single_bit_flip_changes_crc() {\n        let mut buf = vec![0u8; 64];\n        for (i, b) in buf.iter_mut().enumerate() {\n            *b = i as u8;\n        }\n        let base = checksum(&buf);\n        for byte in 0..buf.len() {\n            for bit in 0..8 {\n                let mut c = buf.clone();\n                c[byte] ^= 1 << bit;\n                assert_ne!(checksum(&c), base, \"flip {}:{} undetected\", byte, bit);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":36,"oldLines":7,"newStart":36,"newLines":7,"lines":["         // 标准 CRC-32 校验向量","         assert_eq!(checksum(b\"\"), 0x0000_0000);","         assert_eq!(checksum(b\"123456789\"), 0xCBF4_3926);","-        assert_eq!(checksum(b\"a\"), 0xE8B7_BE16);","+        assert_eq!(checksum(b\"a\"), 0xE8B7BE43);","         assert_eq!(checksum(b\"hello\"), 0x3610_A686);","     }"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"4823e113-bfec-45e9-a90c-51f708c201ae","session_id":"0619b744-6ef1-4a24-8ae6-22ef75415811","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/a","sessionId":"0619b744-6ef1-4a24-8ae6-22ef75415811","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp4-a","slug":"serialized-riding-treehouse"}

{"parentUuid":"107d2bb6-6394-47da-af2f-87ea079cd334","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_v4w8a7ipl9ov7qgj883xme89","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/a/tests/recovery.rs","content":"//! 恢复语义集成测试 —— 在真实文件系统上直接篡改段文件字节。\n//!\n//! 覆盖验收点：\n//! - 尾记录逐字节截断：只允许丢弃最后一段的不完整尾部，恢复后序号连续；\n//! - 对中间记录翻位（bit flip）：必须报错，拒绝打开；\n//! - 恢复后再次追加不覆盖已确认数据；\n//! - 多段轮转场景下同样成立；\n//! - 索引缺失/损坏/陈旧时自动重建。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::{open, open_report, rm_dir, temp_dir};\nuse seglog::frame;\nuse seglog::store::Error;\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nfn seg_path(dir: &Path, id: u64) -> PathBuf {\n    dir.join(format!(\"seg-{id:06}.log\"))\n}\n\n/// 写入 n 条记录，载荷里带序号，便于比对。\nfn fill(store: &seglog::LogStore, n: u64) {\n    for i in 0..n {\n        let payload = format!(\"record-{i}\").into_bytes();\n        let seq = store.append(&payload).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(seq, i);\n    }\n}\n\nfn assert_all_records(store: &seglog::LogStore, n: u64) {\n    for i in 0..n {\n        assert_eq!(store.read(i).unwrap(), format!(\"record-{i}\").as_bytes());\n    }\n    assert_eq!(store.next_seq(), n);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn reopen_preserves_all_confirmed_records() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"reopen\");\n    {\n        let store = open(&dir, None);\n        fill(&store, 20);\n    } // drop\n    let (store, report) = open_report(&dir, None);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 20);\n    assert!(!report.truncated_tail);\n    assert_all_records(&store, 20);\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn byte_by_byte_truncation_of_last_record() {\n    // 写 3 条记录；把最后一条记录从末尾逐字节切掉。\n    // 每个切点都重新打开：seq 0、1 必须完整可读，撕裂尾部被报告并丢弃。\n    let base_dir = temp_dir(\"tail-base\");\n    {\n        let store = open(&base_dir, None);\n        fill(&store, 3);\n    }\n    let segment = seg_path(&base_dir, 0);\n    let full = fs::read(&segment).unwrap();\n    // 算出前两条记录的完整字节长度\n    let f0 = frame::encode_frame(0, b\"record-0\");\n    let f1 = frame::encode_frame(1, b\"record-1\");\n    let prefix_len = f0.len() + f1.len();\n    assert_eq!(full.len(), prefix_len + frame::encode_frame(2, b\"record-2\").len());\n\n    for cut in (prefix_len + 1)..full.len() {\n        let dir = temp_dir(&format!(\"tail-cut-{cut}\"));\n        fs::copy(&segment, seg_path(&dir, 0)).unwrap();\n        let (store, report) = open_report(&dir, None);\n        assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 2, \"cut={cut}\");\n        assert!(report.truncated_tail, \"cut={cut}\");\n        assert_eq!(report.truncated_bytes as usize, cut - prefix_len, \"cut={cut}\");\n        assert_eq!(report.truncated_segment, Some(0));\n        assert_all_records(&store, 2);\n        // 物理文件已被 fsync 截断到边界\n        assert_eq!(fs::metadata(seg_path(&dir, 0)).unwrap().len(), prefix_len as u64);\n        // 恢复后继续追加：新记录得到 seq 2，不覆盖任何已确认数据\n        let seq = store.append(b\"record-2-replacement\").unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(seq, 2);\n        assert_eq!(store.read(0).unwrap(), b\"record-0\");\n        assert_eq!(store.read(1).unwrap(), b\"record-1\");\n        assert_eq!(store.read(2).unwrap(), b\"record-2-replacement\");\n        rm_dir(&dir);\n    }\n    rm_dir(&base_dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn truncation_stops_at_frame_boundary_and_zero_tail_is_fine() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"tail-exact\");\n    {\n        let store = open(&dir, None);\n        fill(&store, 2);\n    }\n    // 切到恰好帧边界：没有撕裂尾部，什么也不丢\n    let segment = seg_path(&dir, 0);\n    let full = fs::read(&segment).unwrap();\n    let f0len = frame::encode_frame(0, b\"record-0\").len();\n    let truncated = full[..full.len() - frame::encode_frame(1, b\"record-1\").len()].to_vec();\n    assert_eq!(truncated.len(), f0len);\n    fs::write(&segment, truncated).unwrap();\n    let (store, report) = open_report(&dir, None);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 1);\n    assert!(!report.truncated_tail);\n    assert_eq!(store.read(0).unwrap(), b\"record-0\");\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn torn_tail_in_non_last_segment_is_corruption() {\n    // 两段：手动截断第一段尾部，但保留第二段 -> 必须 Corrupt\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"mid-trunc\");\n    {\n        let store = open(&dir, Some(1)); // 阈值 1 字节 => 每条追加都轮转\n        for i in 0..4u64 {\n            store.append(format!(\"r{i}\").as_bytes()).unwrap();\n        }\n        assert!(store.active_segment_id() >= 3);\n    }\n    // 截断 seg-1 的最后一帧（该段含 1 条记录，切掉其尾部若干字节）\n    let seg1 = seg_path(&dir, 1);\n    let data = fs::read(&seg1).unwrap();\n    fs::write(&seg1, &data[..data.len() - 2]).unwrap();\n\n    let err = seglog::LogStore::open_dir(&dir, None).unwrap_err();\n    let msg = err.to_string();\n    assert!(msg.contains(\"corrupt\"), \"expected corrupt error, got: {msg}\");\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn bit_flip_in_middle_record_payload_is_corruption() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"flip-payload\");\n    {\n        let store = open(&dir, None);\n        fill(&store, 6);\n    }\n    let segment = seg_path(&dir, 0);\n    let mut data = fs::read(&segment).unwrap();\n    // 翻动第 2 条记录（中间记录）载荷中间的一个 bit\n    let f0len = frame::encode_frame(0, b\"record-0\").len();\n    let f1len = frame::encode_frame(1, b\"record-1\").len();\n    let offset = f0len + frame::HEADER_LEN + 2;\n    assert!(offset < f0len + f1len);\n    data[offset] ^= 0x01;\n    fs::write(&segment, data).unwrap();\n\n    let err = seglog::LogStore::open_dir(&dir, None).unwrap_err();\n    match err.downcast_corrupt() {\n        Some(msg) => assert!(msg.contains(\"crc mismatch\"), \"got: {msg}\"),\n        None => panic!(\"expected Corrupt, got io error\"),\n    }\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn bit_flip_in_middle_record_crc_field_is_corruption() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"flip-crc\");\n    {\n        let store = open(&dir, None);\n        fill(&store, 4);\n    }\n    let segment = seg_path(&dir, 0);\n    let mut data = fs::read(&segment).unwrap();\n    let f0len = frame::encode_frame(0, b\"record-0\").len();\n    // 第 0 帧 CRC 尾的第一字节\n    data[f0len - 4] ^= 0x80;\n    fs::write(&segment, data).unwrap();\n\n    let err = seglog::LogStore::open_dir(&dir, None).unwrap_err();\n    let msg = err.to_string();\n    assert!(msg.contains(\"crc mismatch\"), \"got: {msg}\");\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn bit_flip_in_magic_is_corruption_even_in_last_segment() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"flip-magic\");\n    {\n        let store = open(&dir, None);\n        fill(&store, 3);\n    }\n    let segment = seg_path(&dir, 0);\n    let mut data = fs::read(&segment).unwrap();\n    let f0len = frame::encode_frame(0, b\"record-0\").len();\n    // 翻动最后一段里第二帧的 magic（完整帧，绝不允许当撕裂尾部丢弃）\n    data[f0len] ^= 0xFF;\n    fs::write(&segment, data).unwrap();\n\n    let err = seglog::LogStore::open_dir(&dir, None).unwrap_err();\n    let msg = err.to_string();\n    assert!(msg.contains(\"bad magic\"), \"got: {msg}\");\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn corrupted_length_field_is_corruption_not_silent_drop() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"flip-len\");\n    {\n        let store = open(&dir, None);\n        fill(&store, 2);\n    }\n    let segment = seg_path(&dir, 0);\n    let mut data = fs::read(&segment).unwrap();\n    let f0len = frame::encode_frame(0, b\"record-0\").len();\n    // 中间帧（第一帧）长度字段改为超大值 -> BadLength，即使在文件末尾也不能丢\n    data[f0len + 12..f0len + 16]\n        .copy_from_slice(&(frame::MAX_PAYLOAD_LEN + 1).to_le_bytes());\n    fs::write(&segment, data).unwrap();\n\n    let err = seglog::LogStore::open_dir(&dir, None).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(err.to_string().contains(\"payload length\"), \"got: {}\", err);\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn seq_continuity_across_rotation_and_reopen() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"rotate-seq\");\n    {\n        // 极小阈值，强制多次轮转\n        let store = open(&dir, Some(1));\n        for i in 0..15u64 {\n            let seq = store.append(format!(\"seg-msg-{i}\").as_bytes()).unwrap();\n            assert_eq!(seq, i);\n        }\n    }\n    let (store, report) = open_report(&dir, Some(1));\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 15);\n    for i in 0..15u64 {\n        assert_eq!(store.read(i).unwrap(), format!(\"seg-msg-{i}\").as_bytes());\n    }\n    // 继续追加，序号接着走，旧数据不变\n    let seq = store.append(b\"after-reopen\").unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(seq, 15);\n    assert_eq!(store.read(15).unwrap(), b\"after-reopen\");\n    assert_eq!(store.read(0).unwrap(), b\"seg-msg-0\");\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn index_missing_corrupt_and_stale_are_rebuilt() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"idx-rebuild\");\n    {\n        let store = open(&dir, None);\n        fill(&store, 5);\n    }\n    // 1) 删除索引 -> missing\n    fs::remove_file(dir.join(\"index.json\")).unwrap();\n    let (_, r1) = open_report(&dir, None);\n    assert!(r1.index_missing);\n\n    // 2) 写坏索引 -> corrupt\n    fs::write(dir.join(\"index.json\"), b\"{not json\").unwrap();\n    let (_, r2) = open_report(&dir, None);\n    assert!(r2.index_corrupt);\n\n    // 3) 写一个结构合法但内容陈旧的索引 -> stale\n    fs::write(\n        dir.join(\"index.json\"),\n        br#\"{\"version\":1,\"active_segment\":0,\"next_seq\":999,\n             \"segments\":[{\"id\":0,\"file\":\"seg-000000.log\",\"start_seq\":0,\"count\":999}]}\"#,\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    let (store, r3) = open_report(&dir, None);\n    assert!(r3.index_stale);\n    assert_all_records(&store, 5);\n\n    // 重建后的索引再次打开应完全可信\n    let (_, r4) = open_report(&dir, None);\n    assert!(!r4.index_stale && !r4.index_missing && !r4.index_corrupt);\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn append_after_recovery_does_not_overwrite() {\n    // 综合验收：截断 -> 恢复 -> 再追加 -> 再打开，确认已确认字节从未被覆盖\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"no-overwrite\");\n    {\n        let store = open(&dir, None);\n        store.append(b\"alpha\").unwrap(); // 0\n        store.append(b\"beta\").unwrap();  // 1\n        store.append(b\"gamma\").unwrap(); // 2\n    }\n    let segment = seg_path(&dir, 0);\n    let mut data = fs::read(&segment).unwrap();\n    // 切掉 gamma 帧尾部 4 字节\n    data.truncate(data.len() - 4);\n    fs::write(&segment, data).unwrap();\n\n    {\n        let store = open(&dir, None);\n        assert_eq!(store.next_seq(), 2);\n        assert_eq!(store.append(b\"delta\").unwrap(), 2);\n        assert_eq!(store.append(b\"epsilon\").unwrap(), 3);\n        // 物理文件上：alpha/beta 之后紧跟 delta/epsilon\n        let raw = fs::read(seg_path(&dir, 0)).unwrap();\n        assert!(raw.windows(5).any(|w| w == b\"alpha\"));\n        assert!(raw.windows(4).any(|w| w == b\"beta\"));\n        assert!(!raw.windows(5).any(|w| w == b\"gamma\"));\n        assert!(raw.windows(5).any(|w| w == b\"delta\"));\n        assert!(raw.windows(7).any(|w| w == b\"epsilon\"));\n    }\n    // 再次打开仍一致\n    let store = open(&dir, None);\n b\"epsilon\");\n    assert_eq!(store.next_seq(), 4);\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n// 让测试能区分 Error::Corrupt 与 io::Error\ntrait DowncastCorrupt {\n    fn downcast_corrupt(&self) -> Option<String>;\n}\nimpl {"parentUuid":"2aad5857-eb1b-41df-9b09-f4788defb1e7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_61xzyrqoybxl7e5vkxamhnej","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/a/tests/fault_injection.rs","content":"//! 故障注入与掉电恢复集成测试。\n//!\n//! - `FaultFs` 在真实追加路径上注入写入失败 / 短写 / sync 失败：\n//!   失败的追加不产生确认记录；重新打开后从撕裂尾部恢复，已确认数据不丢；\n//!   存储库在故障后进入 poisoned 态，拒绝继续写入。\n//! - `SimFs` + `crash_and_reboot` 在追加/轮转/索引更新的每个持久化步骤上\n//!   注入掉电：反复重启直到收敛，所有此前已确认记录始终可读、序号连续。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse seglog::frame;\nuse seglog::store::Error;\nuse seglog::vfs::{\n    FaultFs, FaultPlan, FaultRule, Fault, Op, SimDisk, SimFs, Vfs,\n};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\n/// 带 FaultFs 的 store 构造（plan 用 Arc 暴露给测试）。\nfn open_fault(\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n) -> (\n    seglog::LogStore,\n    seglog::OpenReport,\n    Arc<std::sync::Mutex<usize>>,\n) {\n    // SimFs 更快且确定性强；短写语义在两种实现上一致。\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let fs = FaultFs::new(SimFs::new(disk), plan);\n    let (store, report) = seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), 1024).unwrap();\n    (store, report, Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(0)))\n}\n\n/// 在可崩溃 SimDisk 上打开。\nfn open_sim(disk: &SimDisk, threshold: u64) -> (seglog::LogStore, seglog::OpenReport) {\n    let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n    seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), threshold).unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn plain_writes_roundtrip_through_simfs_store() {\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let (store, _) = open_sim(&disk, 1024);\n    for i in 0..20u64 {\n        assert_eq!(store.append(format!(\"m{i}\").as_bytes()).unwrap(), i);\n    }\n    disk.crash_and_reboot();\n    let (store, report) = open_sim(&disk, 1024);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 20);\n    for i in 0..20u64 {\n        assert_eq!(store.read(i).unwrap(), format!(\"m{i}\").as_bytes());\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_write_error_does_not_advance_seq_and_poisons() {\n    let plan = FaultPlan::new();\n    let (store, _, _) = open_fault(plan.clone());\n    assert_eq!(store.append(b\"good-0\").unwrap(), 0);\n    assert_eq!(store.append(b\"good-1\").unwrap(), 1);\n\n    // 下一次数据写直接失败（什么都不落地）\n    plan.push(FaultRule { op: Op::Write, when: 1, fault: Fault::Error });\n    let err = store.append(b\"lost\").unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"got {err}\");\n\n    // poisoned：必须重开才能继续\n    assert!(matches!(store.append(b\"x\").unwrap_err(), Error::Poisoned));\n    assert_eq!(store.next_seq(), 2);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_short_write_leaves_torn_tail_and_recovery_discards_it() {\n    // 用真实 FS 才能在进程内直接观察到半截帧文件并重新打开（SimFs + FaultFs\n    // 也可以，这里直接走 SimFs 组合，避免落盘目录管理）。\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let plan = FaultPlan::new();\n    {\n        let fs = FaultFs::new(SimFs::new(disk.clone()), plan.clone());\n        let (store, _) = seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), 4096).unwrap();\n        store.append(b\"confirmed-zero\").unwrap();\n        store.append(b\"confirmed-one\").unwrap();\n        // 让下一条记录的帧只落地 7 字节就失败（撕裂尾部）\n        plan.push(FaultRule { op: Op::Write, when: 1, fault: Fault::ShortWrite(7) });\n        let err = store.append(b\"torn-record\").unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)));\n        assert!(matches!(store.append(b\"z\").unwrap_err(), Error::Poisoned));\n    }\n    // 重启恢复：撕裂尾部被丢弃，前两条已确认记录完好\n    let (store, report) = open_sim(&disk, 4096);\n    assert!(report.truncated_tail);\n    assert_eq!(report.truncated_bytes, 7);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 2);\n    assert_eq!(store.read(0).unwrap(), b\"confirmed-zero\");\n    assert_eq!(store.read(1).unwrap(), b\"confirmed-one\");\n    // 重新追加拿到 seq 2\n    assert_eq!(store.append(b\"after\").unwrap(), 2);\n    assert_eq!(store.read(2).unwrap(), b\"after\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_sync_file_failure_then_reopen_keeps_prior_acks() {\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let plan = FaultPlan::new();\n    {\n        let fs = FaultFs::new(SimFs::new(disk.clone()), plan.clone());\n        let (store, _) = seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), 4096).unwrap();\n        store.append(b\"a0\").unwrap();\n        // 下一次 fsync 失败：帧可能已写入工作缓冲但未确认。\n        plan.push(FaultRule { op: Op::SyncFile, when: 1, fault: Fault::Error });\n        let _ = store.append(b\"unacked\");\n        assert!(matches!(store.append(b\"z\").unwrap_err(), Error::Poisoned));\n    }\n    // 重启：最坏情况下 unacked 整帧落地 —— 它位于末尾，按撕裂尾部或“多一条\n    // 完整未确认帧”处理。本实现中未 fsync 的写入在 SimFs 崩溃后不存在；\n    // 这里不主动 crash（sync 失败不等于掉电），所以它会作为撕裂尾部被截断。\n    let (store, report) = open_sim(&disk, 4096);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 1);\n    assert_eq!(store.read(0).unwrap(), b\"a0\");\n}\n\n/// 在 SimDisk 上执行一次完整的“追加若干条 + 每步后崩溃重启”的压力循环。\n#[test]\nfn crash_loop_append_every_step_all_acks_survive() {\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let target = 12u64;\n    let mut written = 0u64;\n    let mut guard = 0usize;\n    while written < target {\n        guard += 1;\n        assert!(guard < 500, \"recovery did not converge\");\n        let attempt = {\n            let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n            seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), 4096)\n        };\n        let (store, _report) = match attempt {\n            Ok(x) => x,\n            Err(e) => {\n                // 打开过程中（截断/重建索引）也可能崩溃：重启再来\n                disk.crash_and_reboot();\n                continue;\n            }\n        };\n        // 已确认数据在崩溃前必须自洽\n        verify_prefix(&store, written);\n        let seq = store.append(format!(\"crash-{written}\").as_bytes());\n        match seq {\n            Ok(s) => {\n                assert_eq!(s, written);\n                written += 1;\n                // 确认后再崩溃：记录必须活下来\n                disk.crash_and_reboot();\n            }\n            Err(_) => {\n                // 未确认即崩溃\n                disk.crash_and_reboot();\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    let (store, report) = open_sim(&disk, 4096);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, target);\n    verify_prefix(&store, target);\n}\n\n/// 轮转的每个同步步骤后都可能崩溃：重启自动收敛，记录不丢、序号连续。\n#[test]\nfn crash_loop_rotation_and_index_update() {\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let mut written = 0u64;\n    let target = 12u64;\n    // 小阈值：大约每 1~2 条就触发一次轮转\n    let threshold = frame::encode_frame(0, b\"x\").len() as u64 + 10;\n    let mut guard = 0;\n    while written < target {\n        guard += 1;\n        assert!(guard < 1000, \"rotation recovery did not converge\");\n        let (store, report) = {\n            let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n            match seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), threshold) {\n                Ok(x) => x,\n                Err(_) => {\n                    disk.crash_and_reboot();\n                    continue;\n                }\n            }\n        };\n        // 恢复报告必须与已确认数一致\n        assert_eq!(report.next_seq, written, \"recovery report inconsistent\");\n        verify_prefix(&store, written);\n        match store.append(format!(\"rot-{written}\").as_bytes()) {\n            Ok(seq) => {\n                assert_eq!(seq, written);\n                written += 1;\n            }\n            Err(e) => panic!(\"append failed after successful recovery: {e}\"),\n        }\n        disk.crash_and_reboot();\n    }\n    let (store, report) = open_sim(&disk, threshold);\n    assert!(report.segments >= 2, \"expected rotation to have produced segments\");\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, target);\n    verify_prefix(&store, target);\n}\n\nfn verify_prefix(store: &seglog::LogStore, n: u64) {\n    for i in 0..n {\n        // 两种载荷前缀都接受（本文件中不同用例不会混用同一 disk）\n HTTP 验证入口的端到端测试：真起一个线程内服务器，走 TCP 手写 HTTP/1.1 请求。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::{rm_dir, temp_dir};\nuse seglog::http::Server;\nuse seglog::store::LogStore;\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nfn start_server(dir: &std::path::Path) -> (String, std::thread::JoinHandle<()>) {\n    let (store, report) = LogStore::open_dir(dir, Some(64)).unwrap();\n    let server = Server::new(store, report, 64);\n    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {\n        server.serve_listener(listener).unwrap();\n    });\n    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));\n    (addr, handle)\n}\n\nstruct Resp {\n    status: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nfn request(addr: &str, raw: &[u8]) -> Resp {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    stream.write_all(raw).unwrap();\n    stream.flush().unwrap();\n    let mut all = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut all).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&all);\n    let (head, body) = text.split_once(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").unwrap_or((&text, \"\"));\n    let status = head\n        .lines()\n        .next()\n        .and_then(|l| l.split_whitespace().nth(1))\n        .and_then(|s| s.parse().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    Resp { status, body: body.to_string() }\n}\n\nfn post(addr: &str, path: &str, body: &[u8]) -> Resp {\n    let mut req = format!(\n        \"POST {path} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nContent-Type: application/octet-stream\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        body.len()\n    )\n    .into_bytes();\n    req.extend_from_slice(body);\n    request(addr, &req)\n}\n\nfn get(addr: &str, path: &str) -> Resp {\n    request(\n        addr,\n        format!(\"GET {path} HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: localhost\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\").as_bytes(),\n    )\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_append_read_status_rotate_recovery() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"http\");\n    let (addr, handle) = start_server(&dir);\n\n    // healthz\n    let r = get(&addr, \"/healthz\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"ok\\\"\"));\n\n    // 追加两条（小阈值 64B，第二条触发轮转）\n    let r = post(&addr, \"/append\", b\"hello-http\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{}\", r.body);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"seq\\\": 0\"));\n\n    let r = post(&addr, \"/append\", vec![0u8, 159, 152, 95].as_slice()); // 部分非 UTF-8\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"seq\\\": 1\"));\n\n    // 读回\n    let r = get(&addr, \"/records/0\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"hello-http\"), \"body: {}\", r.body);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"aGVsbG8taHR0cA\")); // base64\n\n    let r = get(&addr, \"/records/1\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"009f985f\")); // hex\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\\u0000\")); // 非法 UTF-8 被安全转义\n\n    // 不存在的序号 404\n    let r = get(&addr, \"/records/999\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 404);\n\n    // 强制轮转\n    let r = post(&addr, \"/rotate\", b\"\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200, \"{}\", r.body);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"active_segment\\\"\"));\n\n    // status\n    let r = get(&addr, \"/status\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"next_seq\\\": 2\"));\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"seg-000000.log\"));\n\n    // recovery 报告\n    let r = get(&addr, \"/recovery\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"next_seq\\\": 2\"));\n\n    // 404 路由\n    assert_eq!(get(&addr, \"/nope\").status, 404);\n\n    drop(addr);\n    drop(handle);\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn http_recovery_reflects_truncated_tail_after_restart() {\n    let dir = temp_dir(\"http-recovery\");\n    // 先写数据\n    {\n        let (store, _) = LogStore::open_dir(&dir, None).unwrap();\n        store.append(b\"one\").unwrap();\n        store.append(b\"two\").unwrap();\n    }\n    // 物理截断最后一条帧的 3 个字节\n    let seg = dir.join(\"seg-000000.log\");\n    let mut data = std::fs::read(&seg).unwrap();\n    data.truncate(data.len() - 3);\n    std::fs::write(&seg, data).unwrap();\n\n    let (store, report) = LogStore::open_dir(&dir, None).unwrap();\n    assert!(report.truncated_tail);\n    assert_eq!(report.truncated_bytes, 3);\n    let server = Server::new(store, report, 1024);\n    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    std::thread::spawn(move || { server.serve_listener(listener).unwrap(); });\n    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));\n\n    let r = get(&addr, \"/recovery\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"truncated_tail\\\": true\"), \"{}\", r.body);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"\\\"truncated_bytes\\\": 3\"));\n    let r = get(&addr, \"/records/0\");\n    assert_eq!(r.status, 200);\n    assert!(r.body.contains(\"one\"));\n    rm_dir(&dir);\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_58175360dcd7fa8dd5cdd7aa","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2810,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":105272,"output_tokens":2679,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_5ev0d5l4ua6i5h3z059nkb2a":{"content":"//! {"parentUuid":"c474e7c2-fdb8-4692-b2c7-e57b561c8400","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/a/tests/recovery.rs","snippet":"1\t//! 恢复语义集成测试 —— 在真实文件系统上直接篡改段文件字节。\n2\t//!\n3\t//! 覆盖验收点：\n4\t//! - 尾记录逐字节截断：只允许丢弃最后一段的不完整尾部，恢复后序号连续；\n5\t//! - 对中间记录翻位（bit flip）：必须报错，拒绝打开；\n6\t//! - 恢复后再次追加不覆盖已确认数据；\n7\t//! - 多段轮转场景下同样成立；\n8\t//! - 索引缺失/损坏/陈旧时自动重建。\n9\t\n10\tmod common;\n11\t\n12\tuse common::{open, open_report, rm_dir, temp_dir};\n13\tuse seglog::frame;\n14\tuse seglog::store::Error;\n15\tuse std::fs;\n16\tuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n17\t\n18\tfn seg_path(dir: &Path, id: u64) -> PathBuf {\n19\t    dir.join(format!(\"seg-{id:06}.log\"))\n20\t}\n21\t\n22\t/// 写入 n 条记录，载荷里带序号，便于比对。\n23\tfn fill(store: &seglog::LogStore, n: u64) {\n24\t    for i in 0..n {\n25\t        let payload = format!(\"record-{i}\").into_bytes();\n26\t        let seq = store.append(&payload).unwrap();\n27\t        assert_eq!(seq, i);\n28\t    }\n29\t}\n30\t\n31\tfn assert_all_records(store: &seglog::LogStore, n: u64) {\n32\t    for i in 0..n {\n33\t        assert_eq!(store.read(i).unwrap(), format!(\"record-{i}\").as_bytes());\n34\t    }\n35\t    assert_eq!(store.next_seq(), n);\n36\t}\n37\t\n38\t#[test]\n39\tfn reopen_preserves_all_confirmed_records() {\n40\t    let dir = temp_dir(\"reopen\");\n41\t    {\n42\t        let store = open(&dir, None);\n43\t        fill(&store, 20);\n44\t    } // drop\n45\t    let (store, report) = open_report(&dir, None);\n46\t    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 20);\n47\t    assert!(!report.truncated_tail);\n48\t    assert_all_records(&store, 20);\n49\t    rm_dir(&dir);\n50\t}\n51\t\n52\t#[test]\n53\tfn byte_by_byte_truncation_of_last_record() {\n54\t    // 写 3 条记录；把最后一条记录从末尾逐字节切掉。\n55\t    // 每个切点都重新打开：seq 0、1 必须完整可读，撕裂尾部被报告并丢弃。\n56\t    let base_dir = temp_dir(\"tail-base\");\n57\t    {\n58\t        let store = open(&base_dir, None);\n59\t        fill(&store, 3);\n60\t    }\n61\t    let segment = seg_path(&base_dir, 0);\n62\t    let full = fs::read(&segment).unwrap();\n63\t    // 算出前两条记录的完整字节长度\n64\t    let f0 = frame::encode_frame(0, b\"record-0\");\n65\t    let f1 = frame::encode_frame(1, b\"record-1\");\n66\t    let prefix_len = f0.len() + f1.len();\n67\t    assert_eq!(full.len(), prefix_len + frame::encode_frame(2, b\"record-2\").len());\n68\t\n69\t    for cut in (prefix_len + 1)..full.len() {\n70\t        let dir = temp_dir(&format!(\"tail-cut-{cut}\"));\n71\t        fs::copy(&segment, seg_path(&dir, 0)).unwrap();\n72\t        let (store, report) = open_report(&dir, None);\n73\t        assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 2, \"cut={cut}\");\n74\t        assert!(report.truncated_tail, \"cut={cut}\");\n75\t        assert_eq!(report.truncated_bytes as usize, cut - prefix_len, \"cut={cut}\");\n76\t        assert_eq!(report.truncated_segment, Some(0));\n77\t        assert_all_records(&store, 2);\n78\t        // 物理文件已被 fsync 截断到边界\n79\t        assert_eq!(fs::metadata(seg_path(&dir, 0)).unwrap().len(), prefix_len as u64);\n80\t        // 恢复后继续追加：新记录得到 seq 2，不覆盖任何已确认数据\n81\t        let seq = store.append(b\"record-2-replacement\").unwrap();\n82\t        assert_eq!(seq, 2);\n83\t        assert_eq!(store.read(0).unwrap(), b\"record-0\");\n84\t        assert_eq!(store.read(1).unwrap(), b\"record-1\");\n85\t        assert_eq!(store.read(2).unwrap(), b\"record-2-replacement\");\n86\t        rm_dir(&dir);\n87\t    }\n88\t    rm_dir(&base_dir);\n89\t}\n90\t\n91\t#[test]\n92\tfn {"parentUuid":"8a0ca242-24f0-48da-bd54-cfcd48b9b10f","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"signature":"","thinking":"Interesting: `injected_sync_file_failure` — the append wrote the frame (to SimFs work buffer),\n\nAfter a failed sync, the unacknowledged full frame remains in the work buffer. Recovery treats complete frames at the end as valid confirmed records, updating next_seq to 2. 失败：\n//!   失败的追加不产生确认记录；重新打开后从撕裂尾部恢复，已确认数据不丢；\n//!   存储库在故障后进入 poisoned 态，拒绝继续写入。\n//! - `SimFs` + `crash_and_reboot` 在追加/轮转/索引更新的每个持久化步骤上\n//!   注入掉电：反复重启直到收敛，所有此前已确认记录始终可读、序号连续。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse seglog::frame;\nuse seglog::store::Error;\nuse seglog::vfs::{\n    FaultFs, FaultPlan, FaultRule, Fault, Op, SimDisk, SimFs, Vfs,\n};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\n/// 带 FaultFs 的 store 构造（plan 用 Arc 暴露给测试）。\nfn open_fault(\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n) -> (\n    seglog::LogStore,\n    seglog::OpenReport,\n    Arc<std::sync::Mutex<usize>>,\n) {\n    // SimFs 更快且确定性强；短写语义在两种实现上一致。\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let fs = FaultFs::new(SimFs::new(disk), plan);\n    let (store, report) = seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), 1024).unwrap();\n    (store, report, Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(0)))\n}\n\n/// 在可崩溃 SimDisk 上打开。\nfn open_sim(disk: &SimDisk, threshold: u64) -> (seglog::LogStore, seglog::OpenReport) {\n    let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n    seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), threshold).unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn plain_writes_roundtrip_through_simfs_store() {\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let (store, _) = open_sim(&disk, 1024);\n    for i in 0..20u64 {\n        assert_eq!(store.append(format!(\"m{i}\").as_bytes()).unwrap(), i);\n    }\n    disk.crash_and_reboot();\n    let (store, report) = open_sim(&disk, 1024);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 20);\n    for i in 0..20u64 {\n        assert_eq!(store.read(i).unwrap(), format!(\"m{i}\").as_bytes());\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_write_error_does_not_advance_seq_and_poisons() {\n    let plan = FaultPlan::new();\n    let (store, _, _) = open_fault(plan.clone());\n    assert_eq!(store.append(b\"good-0\").unwrap(), 0);\n    assert_eq!(store.append(b\"good-1\").unwrap(), 1);\n\n    // 下一次数据写直接失败（什么都不落地）\n    plan.push(FaultRule { op: Op::Write, when: 1, fault: Fault::Error });\n    let err = store.append(b\"lost\").unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"got {err}\");\n\n    // poisoned：必须重开才能继续\n    assert!(matches!(store.append(b\"x\").unwrap_err(), Error::Poisoned));\n    assert_eq!(store.next_seq(), 2);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_short_write_leaves_torn_tail_and_recovery_discards_it() {\n    // 用真实 FS 才能在进程内直接观察到半截帧文件并重新打开（SimFs + FaultFs\n    // 也可以，这里直接走 SimFs 组合，避免落盘目录管理）。\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let plan = FaultPlan::new();\n    {\n        let fs = FaultFs::new(SimFs::new(disk.clone()), plan.clone());\n        let (store, _) = seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), 4096).unwrap();\n        store.append(b\"confirmed-zero\").unwrap();\n        store.append(b\"confirmed-one\").unwrap();\n        // 让下一条记录的帧只落地 7 字节就失败（撕裂尾部）\n        plan.push(FaultRule { op: Op::Write, when: 1, fault: Fault::ShortWrite(7) });\n        let err = store.append(b\"torn-record\").unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)));\n        assert!(matches!(store.append(b\"z\").unwrap_err(), Error::Poisoned));\n    }\n    // 重启恢复：撕裂尾部被丢弃，前两条已确认记录完好\n    let (store, report) = open_sim(&disk, 4096);\n    assert!(report.truncated_tail);\n    assert_eq!(report.truncated_bytes, 7);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 2);\n    assert_eq!(store.read(0).unwrap(), b\"confirmed-zero\");\n    assert_eq!(store.read(1).unwrap(), b\"confirmed-one\");\n    // 重新追加拿到 seq 2\n    assert_eq!(store.append(b\"after\").unwrap(), 2);\n    assert_eq!(store.read(2).unwrap(), b\"after\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_sync_file_failure_then_reopen_keeps_prior_acks() {\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let plan = FaultPlan::new();\n    {\n        let fs = FaultFs::new(SimFs::new(disk.clone()), plan.clone());\n        let (store, _) = seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), 4096).unwrap();\n        store.append(b\"a0\").unwrap();\n        // 下一次 fsync 失败：帧可能已写入工作缓冲但未确认。\n        plan.push(FaultRule { op: Op::SyncFile, when: 1, fault: Fault::Error });\n        let _ = store.append(b\"unacked\");\n HTTP 验证入口的端到端测试：真起一个线程内服务器，走 TCP 手写 HTTP/1.1 请求。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::{rm_dir, temp_dir};\nuse seglog::http::Server;\nuse seglog::store::LogStore;\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::TcpStream;\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\nfn start_server(dir: &std::path::Path) -> (String, std::thread::JoinHandle<()>) {\n    let (store, report) = LogStore::open_dir(dir, Some(64)).unwrap();\n    let server = Server::new(store, report, 64);\n    let listener = std::net::TcpListener::bind(\"127.0.0.1:0\").unwrap();\n    let addr = listener.local_addr().unwrap().to_string();\n    let handle = std::thread::spawn(move || {\n        server.serve_listener(listener).unwrap();\n    });\n    std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(50));\n    (addr, handle)\n}\n\nstruct Resp {\n    status: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nfn request(addr: &str, raw: &[u8]) -> Resp {\n    let mut stream = TcpStream::connect(addr).unwrap();\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(5))).unwrap();\n    stream.write_all(raw).unwrap();\n    stream.flush().unwrap();\n    let mut all = Vec::new();\n    stream.read_to_end(&mut all).unwrap();\n    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&all);\n    let (head, body) = text.split_once(\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\").unwrap_or((&text, \"\"));\n    let SimFs};","originalFile":"//! 故障注入与掉电恢复集成测试。\n//!\n//! - `FaultFs` 在真实追加路径上注入写入失败 / 短写 / sync 失败：\n//!   失败的追加不产生确认记录；重新打开后从撕裂尾部恢复，已确认数据不丢；\n//!   存储库在故障后进入 poisoned 态，拒绝继续写入。\n//! - `SimFs` + `crash_and_reboot` 在追加/轮转/索引更新的每个持久化步骤上\n//!   注入掉电：反复重启直到收敛，所有此前已确认记录始终可读、序号连续。\n\nmod common;\n\nuse seglog::frame;\nuse seglog::store::Error;\nuse seglog::vfs::{\n    FaultFs, FaultPlan, FaultRule, Fault, Op, SimDisk, SimFs, Vfs,\n};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\n/// 带 FaultFs 的 store 构造（plan 用 Arc 暴露给测试）。\nfn open_fault(\n    plan: FaultPlan,\n) -> (\n    seglog::LogStore,\n    seglog::OpenReport,\n    Arc<std::sync::Mutex<usize>>,\n) {\n    // SimFs 更快且确定性强；短写语义在两种实现上一致。\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let fs = FaultFs::new(SimFs::new(disk), plan);\n    let (store, report) = seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), 1024).unwrap();\n    (store, report, Arc::new(std::sync::Mutex::new(0)))\n}\n\n/// 在可崩溃 SimDisk 上打开。\nfn open_sim(disk: &SimDisk, threshold: u64) -> (seglog::LogStore, seglog::OpenReport) {\n    let fs = SimFs::new(disk.clone());\n    seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), threshold).unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn plain_writes_roundtrip_through_simfs_store() {\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let (store, _) = open_sim(&disk, 1024);\n    for i in 0..20u64 {\n        assert_eq!(store.append(format!(\"m{i}\").as_bytes()).unwrap(), i);\n    }\n    disk.crash_and_reboot();\n    let (store, report) = open_sim(&disk, 1024);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 20);\n    for i in 0..20u64 {\n        assert_eq!(store.read(i).unwrap(), format!(\"m{i}\").as_bytes());\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_write_error_does_not_advance_seq_and_poisons() {\n    let plan = FaultPlan::new();\n    let (store, _, _) = open_fault(plan.clone());\n    assert_eq!(store.append(b\"good-0\").unwrap(), 0);\n    assert_eq!(store.append(b\"good-1\").unwrap(), 1);\n\n    // 下一次数据写直接失败（什么都不落地）\n    plan.push(FaultRule { op: Op::Write, when: 1, fault: Fault::Error });\n    let err = store.append(b\"lost\").unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"got {err}\");\n\n    // poisoned：必须重开才能继续\n    assert!(matches!(store.append(b\"x\").unwrap_err(), Error::Poisoned));\n    assert_eq!(store.next_seq(), 2);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_short_write_leaves_torn_tail_and_recovery_discards_it() {\n    // 用真实 FS 才能在进程内直接观察到半截帧文件并重新打开（SimFs + FaultFs\n    // 也可以，这里直接走 SimFs 组合，避免落盘目录管理）。\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let plan = FaultPlan::new();\n    {\n        let fs = FaultFs::new(SimFs::new(disk.clone()), plan.clone());\n        let (store, _) = seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), 4096).unwrap();\n        store.append(b\"confirmed-zero\").unwrap();\n        store.append(b\"confirmed-one\").unwrap();\n        // 让下一条记录的帧只落地 7 字节就失败（撕裂尾部）\n        plan.push(FaultRule { op: Op::Write, when: 1, fault: Fault::ShortWrite(7) });\n        let err = store.append(b\"torn-record\").unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)));\n        assert!(matches!(store.append(b\"z\").unwrap_err(), Error::Poisoned));\n    }\n    // 重启恢复：撕裂尾部被丢弃，前两条已确认记录完好\n    let (store, report) = open_sim(&disk, 4096);\n    assert!(report.truncated_tail);\n    assert_eq!(report.truncated_bytes, 7);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 2);\n    assert_eq!(store.read(0).unwrap(), b\"confirmed-zero\");\n    assert_eq!(store.read(1).unwrap(), b\"confirmed-one\");\n    // 重新追加拿到 seq 2\n    assert_eq!(store.append(b\"after\").unwrap(), 2);\n    assert_eq!(store.read(2).unwrap(), b\"after\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_sync_file_failure_then_power_loss_rolls_back_unacked_frame() {\n    // fsync 失败后掉电：未同步的帧回滚，已确认记录保留。\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let plan = FaultPlan::new();\n    {\n        let fs = FaultFs::new(SimFs::new(disk.clone()), plan.clone());\n        let (store, _) = seglog::LogStore::open_with(Box::new(fs), threshold).unwrap()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn plain_writes_roundtrip_through_simfs_store() {\n    let disk = SimDisk::new();\n    let (store, _) = open_sim(&disk, 1024);\n    for i in 0..20u64 {\n        assert_eq!(store.append(format!(\"m{i}\").as_bytes()).unwrap(), i);\n    }\n    disk.crash_and_reboot();\n    let (store, report) = open_sim(&disk, 1024);\n    assert_eq!(report.next_seq, 20);\n    for i in 0..20u64 {\n        assert_eq!(store.read(i).unwrap(), format!(\"m{i}\").as_bytes());\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn {"parentUuid":"ce830029-5f25-40a2-890a-c24298142289","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_t6s5bqhy8l5hpm6yv26qieae","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp4/a/scripts/e2e.sh","content":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# 端到端验收脚本：在真实磁盘文件上\n#   1) 经 HTTP 追加 + 读回，验证序号连续；\n#   2) 逐字节截断最后一条记录，重启后验证尾部被丢弃、序号连续、再追加不覆盖；\n#   3) 对中间记录翻位（bit flip），重启必须报损坏错误、拒绝打开；\n#   4) 轮转后多段场景下重复 (2)(3)；\n#   5) 索引被删/被改坏时自动重建。\n#\n# 用法: scripts/e2e.sh [BIN]\nset -u\nROOT=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/..\" && pwd)\"\nBIN=\"${1:-$ROOT/target/release/seglog}\"\nWORK=\"$(mktemp -d \"${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/seglog-e2e.XXXXXX\")\"\nDATA=\"$WORK/data\"\nPORT=0\nPID=\"\"\nPASS=0; FAIL=0\nmkdir -p \"$DATA\"\n\nred()   { printf '\\033[31m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ngrn()   { printf '\\033[32m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ninfo()  { printf '\\033[36m-- %s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nok()   { PASS=$((PASS+1)); grn \"  PASS: $*\"; }\nbad()  { FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); red \"  FAIL: $*\"; }\n\ncheck() { # check <desc> <condition-string(eval)>\n  if eval \"$2\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok \"$1\"; else bad \"$1 ($2)\"; fi\n}\n\nstart_server() { # start_server <max-seg-bytes>\n  # 找一个空闲端口\n  PORT=\"$(python3 -c 'import socket;s=socket.socket();s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\",0));print(s.getsockname()[1]);s.close()')\"\n  \"$BIN\" serve \"$DATA\" --bind \"127.0.0.1:$PORT\" --max-segment-bytes \"${1:-8388608}\" \\\n      >\"$WORK/server.log\" 2>&1 &\n  PID=$!\n  # 等待端口就绪\n  for _ in $(seq 1 50); do\n    if curl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/healthz\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then return 0; fi\n    sleep 0.1\n  done\n  red \"server did not start; log:\"; cat \"$WORK/server.log\"; exit 1\n}\nstop_server() { [ -n \"$PID\" ] && kill \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; wait \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; PID=\"\"; }\n\napi() { # api METHOD PATH [data-file]\n  if [ \"${3:-}\" = \"\" ]; then\n    curl -s -o \"$WORK/resp.json\" -w '%{http_code}' -X \"$1\" \\\n      \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT$2\"\n  else\n    curl -s -o \"$WORK/resp.json\" -w '%{http_code}' -X \"$1\" \\\n      --data-binary @\"$3\" \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT$2\"\n  fi\n}\njget() { python3 -c 'import 用法: scripts/e2e.sh [BIN]\nset -u\nROOT=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/..\" && pwd)\"\nBIN=\"${1:-$ROOT/target/release/seglog}\"\nWORK=\"$(mktemp -d \"${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/seglog-e2e.XXXXXX\")\"\nDATA=\"$WORK/data\"\nPORT=0\nPID=\"\"\nPASS=0; FAIL=0\nmkdir -p \"$DATA\"\n\nred()   { printf '\\033[31m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ngrn()   { printf '\\033[32m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ninfo()  { printf '\\033[36m-- %s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nok()   { PASS=$((PASS+1)); grn \"  PASS: $*\"; }\nbad()  { FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); red \"  FAIL: $*\"; }\n\ncheck() { # check <desc> <condition-string(eval)>\n  if eval \"$2\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok \"$1\"; else bad \"$1 ($2)\"; fi\n}\n\nstart_server() { # start_server <max-seg-bytes>\n  # 找一个空闲端口\n  PORT=\"$(python3 -c 'import socket;s=socket.socket();s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\",0));print(s.getsockname()[1]);s.close()')\"\n  \"$BIN\" serve \"$DATA\" --bind \"127.0.0.1:$PORT\" --max-segment-bytes \"${1:-8388608}\" \\\n      >\"$WORK/server.log\" 2>&1 &\n  PID=$!\n  # 等待端口就绪\n  for _ in $(seq 1 50); do\n    if curl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/healthz\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then return 0; fi\n    sleep 0.1\n  done\n  red \"server did not start; log:\"; cat \"$WORK/server.log\"; exit 1\n}\nstop_server() { [ -n \"$PID\" ] && kill \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; wait \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; PID=\"\"; }\n\napi() { # api METHOD PATH [data-file]\n  if [ \"${3:-}\" = \"\" ]; then\n    curl -s -o \"$WORK/resp.json\" -w '%{http_code}' -X \"$1\" \\\n      \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT$2\"\n  else\n    curl -s -o \"$WORK/resp.json\" -w '%{http_code}' -X \"$1\" \\\n      --data-binary @\"$3\" \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT$2\"\n  fi\n}\njget() { python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get(sys.argv[2]))' \"$WORK/resp.json\" \"$1\"; }\n\ncleanup() { stop_server; rm -rf \"$WORK\"; }\ntrap cleanup EXIT\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"0) 二进制存在: $BIN\"\ncheck \"binary exists\" \"[ -x '$BIN' ]\"\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"1) HTTP 追加/读回：写 12 条，逐条读回，序号必须 0..11 连续\"\nstart_server 8388608\nfor i in $(seq 0 11); do\n  printf 'hello-record-%02d' \"$i\" > \"$WORK/p.bin\"\n  code=\"$(api POST /append \"$WORK/p.bin\")\"\n  [ \"$code\" = 200 ] || { bad \"append #$i http=$code body=$(cat \"$WORK/resp.json\")\"; continue; }\n  seq=\"$(jget seq)\"\n  [ \"$seq\" = \"$i\" ] && ok \"append #$i -> seq=$seq\" || bad \"append #$i -> seq=$seq\"\ndone\nfor i in $(seq 0 11); do\n  code=\"$(api GET /records/$i)\"\n  [ \"$code\" = 200 ] || { bad \"read #$i http=$code\"; continue; }\n  want=\"$(printf 'hello-record-%02d' \"$i\")\"\n  # base64 解码后比对\n  got=\"$(python3 -c 'import json,base64,sys;print(base64.b64decode(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))[\"base64\"]).decode(),end=\"\")' \"$WORK/resp.json\")\"\n  [ \"$got\" = \"$want\" ] && ok \"read seq=$i payload match\" || bad \"read seq=$i got='$got' want='$want'\"\ndone\nnext=\"$( { api GET /status; } >/dev/null; jget next_seq)\"\n[ \"$next\" = 12 ] && ok \"next_seq=12 after appends\" || bad \"next_seq=$next\"\nstop_server\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"2) 逐字节截断最后一条记录（28 字节帧），每个切点重启验证\"\nSEG=\"$DATA/seg-000000.log\"\nFULL_SZ=\"$(stat -c %s \"$SEG\")\"\nLAST_SZ=28\nPREFIX_SZ=$((FULL_SZ-LAST_SZ))\nfor CUT in $(seq 1 $((LAST_SZ-1))); do\n  truncate -s $((PREFIX_SZ+CUT)) \"$WORK\")/x\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n  # 用 CLI 输出行数判断确认记录数\n  cnt=\"$($BIN replay \"$DATA\" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^seq=')\"\n  tailmsg=\"$(grep -o 'discarded [0-9]* torn tail bytes' \"$SEG\"","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# 端到端验收脚本：在真实磁盘文件上\n#   1) 经 HTTP 追加 + 读回，验证序号连续；\n#   2) 逐字节截断最后一条记录，重启后验证尾部被丢弃、序号连续、再追加不覆盖；\n#   3) 对中间记录翻位（bit flip），重启必须报损坏错误、拒绝打开；\n#   4) 轮转后多段场景下重复 (2)(3)；\n#   5) 索引被删/被改坏时自动重建。\n#\n# 用法: scripts/e2e.sh [BIN]\nset -u\nROOT=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/..\" && pwd)\"\nBIN=\"${1:-$ROOT/target/release/seglog}\"\nWORK=\"$(mktemp -d \"${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/seglog-e2e.XXXXXX\")\"\nDATA=\"$WORK/data\"\nPORT=0\nPID=\"\"\nPASS=0; FAIL=0\nmkdir -p \"$DATA\"\n\nred()   { printf '\\033[31m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ngrn()   { printf '\\033[32m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ninfo()  { printf '\\033[36m-- %s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nok()   { PASS=$((PASS+1)); grn \"  PASS: $*\"; }\nbad()  { FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); red \"  FAIL: $*\"; }\n\ncheck() { # check <desc> <condition-string(eval)>\n  if eval \"$2\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok \"$1\"; else bad \"$1 ($2)\"; fi\n}\n\nstart_server() { # start_server <max-seg-bytes>\n  # 找一个空闲端口\n  PORT=\"$(python3 -c 'import socket;s=socket.socket();s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\",0));print(s.getsockname()[1]);s.close()')\"\n  \"$BIN\" serve \"$DATA\" --bind \"127.0.0.1:$PORT\" --max-segment-bytes \"${1:-8388608}\" \\\n      >\"$WORK/server.log\" 2>&1 &\n  PID=$!\n  # 等待端口就绪\n  for _ in $(seq 1 50); do\n    if curl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/healthz\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then return 0; fi\n    sleep 0.1\n  done\n  red \"server did not start; log:\"; cat \"$WORK/server.log\"; exit 1\n}\nstop_server() { [ -n \"$PID\" ] && kill \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; wait \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; PID=\"\"; }\n\napi() { # api METHOD PATH [data-file]\n  if [ \"${3:-}\" = \"\" ]; then\n    curl -s -o \"$WORK/resp.json\" -w '%{http_code}' -X \"$1\" \\\n      \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT$2\"\n  else\n    curl -s -o \"$WORK/resp.json\" -w '%{http_code}' -X \"$1\" \\\n      --data-binary @\"$3\" \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT$2\"\n  fi\n}\njget() { python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get(sys.argv[2]))' \"$WORK/resp.json\" \"$1\"; }\n\ncleanup() { stop_server; rm -rf \"$WORK\"; }\ntrap cleanup EXIT\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"0) 二进制存在: $BIN\"\ncheck \"binary exists\" \"[ -x '$BIN' ]\"\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"1) HTTP 追加/读回：写 12 条，逐条读回，序号必须 0..11 连续\"\nstart_server 8388608\nfor i in $(seq 0 11); do\n  printf 'hello-record-%02d' \"$i\" > \"$WORK/p.bin\"\n  code=\"$(api POST /append \"$WORK/p.bin\")\"\n  [ \"$code\" = 200 ] || { bad \"append #$i http=$code body=$(cat \"$WORK/resp.json\")\"; continue; }\n  seq=\"$(jget seq)\"\n  [ \"$seq\" = \"$i\" ] && ok \"append #$i -> seq=$seq\" || bad \"append #$i -> seq=$seq\"\ndone\nfor i in $(seq 0 11); do\n  code=\"$(api GET /records/$i)\"\n  [ \"$code\" = 200 ] || { bad \"read #$i http=$code\"; continue; }\n  want=\"$(printf 'hello-record-%02d' \"$i\")\"\n  # base64 解码后比对\n  got=\"$(python3 -c 'import json,base64,sys;print(base64.b64decode(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))[\"base64\"]).decode(),end=\"\")' \"$WORK/resp.json\")\"\n  [ \"$got\" = \"$want\" ] && ok \"read seq=$i payload match\" || bad \"read seq=$i got='$got' want='$want'\"\ndone\nnext=\"$( { api GET /status; } >/dev/null; jget next_seq)\"\n[ \"$next\" = 12 ] && ok \"next_seq=12 after appends\" || bad \"next_seq=$next\"\nstop_server\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"2) 逐字节截断最后一条记录（28 字节帧），每个切点重启验证\"\nSEG=\"$DATA/seg-000000.log\"\nFULL_SZ=\"$(stat -c %s \"$SEG\")\"\nLAST_SZ=28\nPREFIX_SZ=$((FULL_SZ-LAST_SZ))\nfor CUT in $(seq 1 $((LAST_SZ-1))); do\n  truncate -s $((PREFIX_SZ+CUT)) \"$SEG\"\n  out=\"$($BIN replay \"$DATA\" 2>\"$WORK/err.txt\")\" || { bad \"reopen at cut=$CUT failed: $(cat \"$WORK/err.txt\")\"; continue; }\n  n=\"$(grep -c '^seq=' \"$WORK/../$(basename \"$WORK\")/x\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"\n  # 用 CLI 输出行数判断确认记录数\n  cnt=\"$($BIN replay \"$DATA\" 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^seq=')\"\n  tailmsg=\"$(grep -o 'discarded [0-9]* torn tail bytes' \"$WORK/err.txt\" | head -1)\"\n  [ \"$cnt\" = 12 ] && ok \"cut=$CUT -> 12 confirmed records\" || bad \"cut=$CUT -> $cnt records\"\n  case \"$tailmsg\" in\n    \"discarded $CUT torn tail bytes\") ok \"cut=$CUT reported discarded $CUT bytes\" ;;\n    *) bad \"cut=$CUT recovery message: '$tailmsg'\" ;;\n  esac\n  # 物理长度必须已被 fsync 截回边界\n  sz=\"$(stat -c %s \"$SEG\")\"\n  [ \"$sz\" = \"$PREFIX_SZ\" ] && ok \"cut=$CUT file truncated back to $PREFIX_SZ\" || bad \"cut=$CUT file size=$sz\"\ndone\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"3) 恢复后再次追加不覆盖已确认数据（物理字节 + 序号连续性）\"\nstart_server 8388608\nprintf 'replacement-after-tail' > \"$WORK/p.bin\"\ncode=\"$(api POST /append \"$WORK/p.bin\")\"\n[ \"$code\" = 200 ] && ok \"append after recovery http=200\" || bad \"append after recovery http=$code\"\nseq=\"$(jget seq)\"\n[ \"$seq\" = 12 ] && ok \"new record seq=12 (no overwrite)\" || bad \"new record seq=$seq\"\n# 旧记录仍在\napi GET /records/11 >/dev/null\nold=\"$(python3 -c 'import json,base64;print(base64.b64decode(json.load(open(\"'$WORK'/resp.json\"))[\"base64\"]).decode(),end=\"\")')\"\n[ \"$old\" = \"hello-record-11\" ] && ok \"seq=11 payload intact\" || bad \"seq=11 payload='$old'\"\napi GET /records/12 >/dev/null\nnew=\"$(python3 -c 'import json,base64;print(base64.b64decode(json.load(open(\"'$WORK'/resp.json\"))[\"base64\"]).decode(),end=\"\")')\"\n[ \"$new\" = \"replacement-after-tail\" ] && ok \"seq=12 payload correct\" || bad \"seq=12 payload='$new'\"\nstop_server\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"4) 对中间记录翻位（bit flip），重启必须报 CRC 损坏并拒绝打开\"\n# 重新构造一个干净库：5 条单段记录\nrm -rf \"$DATA\"; mkdir -p \"$DATA\"\nstart_server 8388608\nfor i in 0 1 2 3 4; do\n  printf 'middle-flip-%d' \"$i\" > \"$WORK/p.bin\"\n  api POST /append \"$WORK/p.bin\" >/dev/null\ndone\nstop_server\nSEG=\"$DATA/seg-000000.log\"\n# 第 0 帧 29 字节；翻第 1 帧（中间帧）载荷首字节的最低位\npython3 - \"$SEG\" <<'PY'\nimport sys\np=sys.argv[1]; d=bytearray(open(p,'rb').read())\n# 帧: magic(4)+seq(8)+len(4)+payload+crc(4); payload \"middle-flip-1\"\noff=29+16\nd[off]^=0x01\nopen(p,'wb').write(d)\nprint(\"flipped byte\",off)\nPY\nif \"$BIN\" replay \"$DATA\" >\"$WORK/out.txt\" 2>\"$WORK/err.txt\"; then\n  bad \"open with bit-flipped middle record SUCCEEDED (should be rejected)\"\nelse\n  grep -q \"crc mismatch\" \"$WORK/err.txt\" \\\n    && ok \"bit flip in middle record rejected with crc mismatch\" \\\n    || bad \"bit flip rejected but message was: $(cat \"$WORK/err.txt\")\"\nfi\n# 数据未被修改：坏文件保持原样（库拒绝打开，不做“修复”）\npython3 - \"$SEG\" <<'PY' && ok \"corrupt segment file left untouched\" || bad \"corrupt file was modified\"\nimport sys\nd=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()\nassert d[29+16] & 1 == 1\nPY\n\n# 翻 magic 也必须报错（即使该帧在段尾，完整帧 magic 错不能当撕裂尾部）\npython3 - \"$SEG\" \"$0\")/..\" && pwd)\"\nBIN=\"${1:-$ROOT/target/release/seglog}\"\nWORK=\"$(mktemp -d \"${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/seglog-e2e.XXXXXX\")\"\nDATA=\"$WORK/data\"\nPORT=0\nPID=\"\"\nPASS=0; FAIL=0\nmkdir -p \"$DATA\"\n\nred()   { printf '\\033[31m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ngrn()   { printf '\\033[32m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ninfo()  { printf '\\033[36m-- %s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nok()   { PASS=$((PASS+1)); grn \"  PASS: $*\"; }\nbad()  { FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); red \"  FAIL: $*\"; }\n\ncheck() { # check <desc> <condition-string(eval)>\n  if eval \"$2\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok \"$1\"; else bad \"$1 ($2)\"; fi\n}\n\nstart_server() { # start_server <max-seg-bytes>\n  # 找一个空闲端口\n  PORT=\"$(python3 -c 'import >\"$WORK/server.log\" 2>&1 &\n  PID=$!\n  # 等待端口就绪\n  for _ in $(seq 1 50); do\n    if curl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/healthz\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then return 0; fi\n    sleep 0.1\n  done\n  red \"server did not start; log:\"; cat \"$WORK/server.log\"; exit 1\n}\nstop_server() { [ -n \"$PID\" ] && kill \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; wait \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; PID=\"\"; }\n\napi() { # api METHOD PATH [data-file]\n  if [ \"${3:-}\" = \"\" ]; then\n    curl -s -o \"$WORK/resp.json\" -w '%{http_code}' -X \"$1\" \\\n      \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT$2\"\n  else\n    curl -s -o \"$WORK/resp.json\" -w d=bytearray(open(p,'rb').read())\n# 先还原载荷位，再翻最后一帧(seq=4)的 magic；每帧 33 字节\nd[33+16]^=0x01\noff=4*33\nd[off]^=0xFF\nopen(p,'wb').write(d)\nPY","originalFile":"#!/usr/bin/env bash\n# 端到端验收脚本：在真实磁盘文件上\n#   1) 经 HTTP 追加 + 读回，验证序号连续；\n#   2) 逐字节截断最后一条记录，重启后验证尾部被丢弃、序号连续、再追加不覆盖；\n#   3) 对中间记录翻位（bit flip），重启必须报损坏错误、拒绝打开；\n#   4) 轮转后多段场景下重复 (2)(3)；\n#   5) 索引被删/被改坏时自动重建。\n#\n# 用法: scripts/e2e.sh [BIN]\nset -u\nROOT=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"$0\")/..\" && pwd)\"\nBIN=\"${1:-$ROOT/target/release/seglog}\"\nWORK=\"$(mktemp -d \"${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/seglog-e2e.XXXXXX\")\"\nDATA=\"$WORK/data\"\nPORT=0\nPID=\"\"\nPASS=0; FAIL=0\nmkdir -p \"$DATA\"\n\nred()   { printf '\\033[31m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ngrn()   { printf '\\033[32m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ninfo()  { printf '\\033[36m-- %s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nok()   { PASS=$((PASS+1)); grn \"  PASS: $*\"; }\nbad()  { FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); red \"  FAIL: $*\"; }\n\ncheck() { # check <desc> <condition-string(eval)>\n  if eval \"$2\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok \"$1\"; else bad \"$1 ($2)\"; fi\n}\n\nstart_server() { # start_server <max-seg-bytes>\n  # 找一个空闲端口\n  PORT=\"$(python3 -c 'import socket;s=socket.socket();s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\",0));print(s.getsockname()[1]);s.close()')\"\n  \"$BIN\" serve \"$DATA\" --bind \"127.0.0.1:$PORT\" --max-segment-bytes \"${1:-8388608}\" \\\n      >\"$WORK/server.log\" 2>&1 &\n  PID=$!\n  # 等待端口就绪\n  for _ in $(seq 1 50); do\n    if curl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/healthz\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then return 0; fi\n    sleep 0.1\n  done\n  red \"server did not start; log:\"; cat \"$WORK/server.log\"; exit 1\n}\nstop_server() { [ -n \"$PID\" ] && kill \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; FAIL=0\nmkdir -p \"$DATA\"\n\nred()   { printf '\\033[31m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ngrn()   { printf '\\033[32m%s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\ninfo()  { printf '\\033[36m-- %s\\033[0m\\n' \"$*\"; }\n\nok()   { PASS=$((PASS+1)); grn \"  PASS: $*\"; }\nbad()  { FAIL=$((FAIL+1)); red \"  FAIL: $*\"; }\n\ncheck() { # check <desc> <condition-string(eval)>\n  if eval \"$2\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok \"$1\"; else bad \"$1 ($2)\"; fi\n}\n\nstart_server() { # start_server <max-seg-bytes>\n  # 找一个空闲端口\n  PORT=\"$(python3 -c 'import socket;s=socket.socket();s.bind((\"127.0.0.1\",0));print(s.getsockname()[1]);s.close()')\"\n  \"$BIN\" serve \"$DATA\" --bind \"127.0.0.1:$PORT\" --max-segment-bytes \"${1:-8388608}\" \\\n      >\"$WORK/server.log\" 2>&1 &\n  PID=$!\n  # 等待端口就绪\n  for _ in $(seq 1 50); do\n    if curl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/healthz\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then return 0; fi\n    sleep 0.1\n  done\n  red \"server did not start; log:\"; cat \"$WORK/server.log\"; exit 1\n}\nstop_server() { [ -n \"$PID\" ] && kill \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; wait \"$PID\" 2>/dev/null; PID=\"\"; }\n\napi() { # api METHOD PATH [data-file]\n  if [ \"${3:-}\" = \"\" ]; then\n    curl -s -o \"$WORK/resp.json\" -w '%{http_code}' -X \"$1\" \\\n      \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT$2\"\n  else\n    curl -s -o \"$WORK/resp.json\" -w '%{http_code}' -X \"$1\" \\\n      --data-binary @\"$3\" \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT$2\"\n  fi\n}\njget() { python3 -c 'import json,sys;print(json.load(open(sys.argv[1])).get(sys.argv[2]))' \"$WORK/resp.json\" \"$1\"; }\n\ncleanup() { stop_server; rm -rf \"$WORK\"; }\ntrap cleanup EXIT\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"0) 二进制存在: $BIN\"\ncheck \"binary exists\" \"[ -x '$BIN' ]\"\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"1) HTTP 追加/读回：写 12 条，逐条读回，序号必须 0..11 连续\"\nstart_server 8388608\nfor i in $(seq 0 11); do\n  printf 'hello-record-%02d' \"$i\" > \"$WORK/p.bin\"\n  code=\"$(api POST /append \"$WORK/p.bin\")\"\n  [ \"$code\" = 200 ] || { bad \"append #$i http=$code body=$(cat \"$WORK/resp.json\")\"; continue; }\n  seq=\"$(jget seq)\"\n  [ \"$seq\" = \"$i\" ] && ok \"append #$i -> seq=$seq\" || bad \"append #$i -> seq=$seq\"\ndone\nfor i in $(seq 0 11); do\n  code=\"$(api GET /records/$i)\"\n  [ \"$code\" = 200 ] || { bad \"read #$i http=$code\"; continue; }\n  want=\"$(printf 'hello-record-%02d' \"$i\")\"\n  # base64 解码后比对\n  got=\"$(python3 -c 'import json,base64,sys;print(base64.b64decode(json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))[\"base64\"]).decode(),end=\"\")' \"$WORK/resp.json\")\"\n  [ \"$got\" = \"$want\" ] && ok \"read seq=$i payload match\" || bad \"read seq=$i got='$got' want='$want'\"\ndone\nnext=\"$( { api GET /status; } >/dev/null; jget next_seq)\"\n[ \"$next\" = 12 ] && ok \"next_seq=12 after appends\" || bad \"next_seq=$next\"\nstop_server\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"2) 逐字节截断最后一条记录，每个切点都从【原始文件】重新开始验证\"\nSEG=\"$DATA/seg-000000.log\"\ncp \"$SEG\" \"$WORK/seg.orig\"\nFULL_SZ=\"$(stat -c %s \"$SEG\")\"\n# 载荷固定为 15 字节 \"hello-record-NN\"，帧长 = 16 头 + 15 + 4 CRC = 35\nLAST_SZ=35\nPREFIX_SZ=$((FULL_SZ-LAST_SZ))\nEXPECTED=11   # 丢掉尾部帧后保留 seq 0..10\nfor CUT in $(seq 1 $((LAST_SZ-1))); do\n  cp \"$WORK/seg.orig\" \"$SEG\"\n  truncate -s $((PREFIX_SZ+CUT)) \"$SEG\"\n  out=\"$($BIN replay \"$DATA\" 2>\"$WORK/err.txt\")\" || { bad \"reopen at cut=$CUT failed: $(cat \"$WORK/err.txt\")\"; continue; }\n  cnt=\"$(printf '%s' \"$out\" | grep -c '^seq=')\"\n  tailmsg=\"$(grep -o 'discarded [0-9]* torn tail bytes' \"$WORK/err.txt\" | head -1)\"\n  [ \"$cnt\" = \"$EXPECTED\" ] && ok \"cut=$CUT -> $EXPECTED confirmed records\" || bad \"cut=$CUT -> $cnt records\"\n  case \"$tailmsg\" in\n    \"discarded $CUT torn tail bytes\") ok \"cut=$CUT reported discarded $CUT bytes\" ;;\n    *) bad \"cut=$CUT recovery message: '$tailmsg'\" ;;\n  esac\n  # 物理长度必须已被 fsync 截回边界\n  sz=\"$(stat -c %s \"$SEG\")\"\n  [ \"$sz\" = \"$PREFIX_SZ\" ] && ok \"cut=$CUT file truncated back to $PREFIX_SZ\" || bad \"cut=$CUT file size=$sz\"\ndone\n# 恢复结束后段文件停在干净边界，供第 3 步使用\ncp \"$WORK/seg.orig\" \"$SEG\"; truncate -s \"$PREFIX_SZ\" \"$SEG\"\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"3) 恢复后再次追加不覆盖已确认数据（物理字节 + 序号连续性）\"\nstart_server 8388608\nprintf 'replacement-after-tail' > \"$WORK/p.bin\"\ncode=\"$(api POST /append \"$WORK/p.bin\")\"\n[ \"$code\" = 200 ] && ok \"append after recovery http=200\" || bad \"append after recovery http=$code\"\nseq=\"$(jget seq)\"\n[ \"$seq\" = 11 ] && ok \"new record seq=11 (no overwrite)\" || bad \"new record seq=$seq\"\n# 旧记录仍在\napi GET /records/10 >/dev/null\nold=\"$(python3 -c 'import json,base64;print(base64.b64decode(json.load(open(\"'$WORK'/resp.json\"))[\"base64\"]).decode(),end=\"\")')\"\n[ \"$old\" = \"hello-record-10\" ] && ok \"seq=10 payload intact\" || bad \"seq=10 payload='$old'\"\napi GET /records/11 >/dev/null\nnew=\"$(python3 -c 'import json,base64;print(base64.b64decode(json.load(open(\"'$WORK'/resp.json\"))[\"base64\"]).decode(),end=\"\")')\"\n[ \"$new\" = \"replacement-after-tail\" ] && ok \"seq=11 payload correct\" || bad \"seq=11 payload='$new'\"\nstop_server\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"4) 对中间记录翻位（bit flip），重启必须报 CRC 损坏并拒绝打开\"\n# 重新构造一个干净库：5 条单段记录\nrm -rf \"$DATA\"; mkdir -p \"$DATA\"\nstart_server 8388608\nfor i in 0 1 2 3 4; do\n  printf 'middle-flip-%d' \"$i\" > \"$WORK/p.bin\"\n  api POST /append \"$WORK/p.bin\" >/dev/null\ndone\nstop_server\nSEG=\"$DATA/seg-000000.log\"\n# 第 0 帧 29 字节；翻第 1 帧（中间帧）载荷首字节的最低位\npython3 - \"$SEG\" <<'PY'\nimport sys\np=sys.argv[1]; d=bytearray(open(p,'rb').read())\n# 载荷 \"middle-flip-N\" 长 13，帧长 = 16+13+4 = 33\n# 翻第 1 帧（中间帧 seq=1）载荷首字节的最低位\noff=33+16\nd[off]^=0x01\nopen(p,'wb').write(d)\nprint(\"flipped byte\",off)\nPY\nif \"$BIN\" replay \"$DATA\" >\"$WORK/out.txt\" 2>\"$WORK/err.txt\"; then\n  bad \"open with bit-flipped middle record SUCCEEDED (should be rejected)\"\nelse\n  grep -q \"crc mismatch\" \"$WORK/err.txt\" \\\n    && ok \"bit flip in middle record rejected with crc mismatch\" \\\n    || bad \"bit flip rejected but message was: $(cat \"$WORK/err.txt\")\"\nfi\n# 数据未被修改：坏文件保持原样（库拒绝打开，不做“修复”）\npython3 - \"$SEG\" <<'PY' && ok \"corrupt segment file left untouched\" || bad \"corrupt file was modified\"\nimport sys\nd=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()\nassert d[33+16] & 1 == 1\nPY\n\n# 翻 magic 也必须报错（即使该帧在段尾，完整帧 magic 错不能当撕裂尾部）\npython3 - \"$SEG\" <<'PY'\nimport sys\np=sys.argv[1]; d=bytearray(open(p,'rb').read())\n# 先还原载荷位，再翻最后一帧(seq=4)的 magic；每帧 33 字节\nd[33+16]^=0x01\noff=4*33\nd[off]^=0xFF\nopen(p,'wb').write(d)\nPY\nif \"$BIN\" replay \"$DATA\" >/dev/null 2>\"$WORK/err.txt\"; then\n  bad \"open with bad magic in last frame SUCCEEDED\"\nelse\n  grep -q \"bad magic\" \"$WORK/err.txt\" && ok \"bad magic in complete frame rejected\" \\\n    || bad \"bad magic message: $(cat \"$WORK/err.txt\")\"\nfi\n\n# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\ninfo \"5) 多段轮转：极小阈值产生多段，截断最后段尾部可恢复，翻中间段位必须报错\"\nrm -rf \"$DATA\"; mkdir -p \"$DATA\"\nstart_server 40   # 40 字节阈值：每 1~2 条轮转\nfor i in $(seq 0 9); do\n  printf 'rotation-message-%02d-xxxxxxxx' \"$i\" > \"$WORK/p.bin\"\n  code=\"$(api POST /append \"$WORK/p.bin\")\"\n  [ \"$code\" = 200 ] || bad \"append $i http=$code\"\ndone\nnsegs=\"$(ls \"$DATA\"/seg-*.log | wc -l)\"\n[ \"$nsegs\" -ge 2 ] && ok \"rotation produced $nsegs segments\" || bad \"only $nsegs segments\"\napi GET /status >/dev/null\nnext=\"$(jget next_seq)\"; >\"$WORK/server.log\" 2>&1 &\n  PID=$!\n  # 等待端口就绪\n  for _ in $(seq 1 50); do\n    if curl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/healthz\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then return 0; fi\n    sleep 0.1\n  done\n  red code=\"$(api GET /records/$i)\"\n  [ \"$code\" = 200 ] || { bad \"read #$i http=$code\"; continue; }\n  want=\"$(printf 'hello-record-%02d' \"$i\")\"\n  # base64 解码后比对\n  got=\"$(python3 -c 'import = args.get(1).cloned().ok_or_else(|| usage())?;","newString":"    let cmd = args.get(1).cloned().ok_or_else(usage)?;","originalFile":"//! seglog 命令行入口（纯后端）。\n//!\n//! 用法：\n//! ```text\n//! seglog serve   <data-dir> [--bind 127.0.0.1:8080] [--max-segment-bytes N]\n//! seglog append  <data-dir> [--stdin | 文本参数...]   # 追加一条记录，打印 seq\n//! seglog read    <data-dir> <seq> [--hex]            # 读取一条记录\n//! seglog replay  <data-dir>                          # 顺序回放全部已确认记录\n//! ```\n\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\n\nuse seglog::store::{DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES, LogStore};\n\nfn main() {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();\n    let prog = args.first().map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"seglog\");\n    let code = match run(&args[..]) {\n        Ok(()) => 0,\n        Err(msg) => {\n            eprintln!(\"{prog}: {msg}\");\n            1\n        }\n    };\n    std::process::exit(code);\n}\n\nfn run(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let cmd = args.get(1).cloned().ok_or_else(|| usage())?;\n    match cmd.as_str() {\n        \"serve\" => cmd_serve(&args[2..]),\n        \"append\" => cmd_append(&args[2..]),\n        \"read\" => cmd_read(&args[2..]),\n        \"replay\" => cmd_replay(&args[2..]),\n        \"-h\" | \"--help\" | \"help\" => {\n            println!(\"{}\", usage());\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        other => Err(format!(\"unknown subcommand {other:?}\\n\\n{}\", usage())),\n    }\n}\n\nfn usage() -> String {\n    \"USAGE:\\n  \\\n     seglog serve   <data-dir> [--bind ADDR] [--max-segment-bytes N]\\n  \\\n     seglog append  <data-dir> (--stdin | <text>...)\\n  \\\n     seglog read    <data-dir> <seq> [--hex]\\n  \\\n     seglog replay  <data-dir>\"\n        .to_string()\n}\n\nfn parse_serve(args: &[String]) -> Result<(String, String, u64), String> {\n    let mut data_dir = None;\n    let mut bind = \"127.0.0.1:8080\".to_string();\n    let mut max_bytes = DEFAULT_MAX_SEGMENT_BYTES;\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < args.len() {\n        match args[i].as_str() {\n            \"--bind\" => {\n                bind = args.get(i + 1).cloned().ok_or(\"--bind needs a value\")?;\n                i += 2;\n            }\n            \"--max-segment-bytes\" => {\n                let v = args.get(i + 1).ok_or(\"--max-segment-bytes needs a value\")?;\n                max_bytes = v.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| \"bad size\".to_string())?;\n                i += 2;\n            }\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") && data_dir.is_none() => {\n                data_dir = Some(other.to_string());\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            other => return Err(format!(\"unexpected argument {other}\")),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok((data_dir.ok_or(\"missing <data-dir>\")?, bind, max_bytes))\n}\n\nfn cmd_serve(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let (data_dir, bind, max_bytes) = parse_serve(args)?;\n    seglog::http::serve_dir(&data_dir, &bind, Some(max_bytes)).map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n\nfn cmd_append(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut data_dir = None;\n    let mut from_stdin = false;\n    let mut text: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n    for a in args {\n        match a.as_str() {\n            \"--stdin\" => from_stdin = true,\n            other if data_dir.is_none() => data_dir = Some(other.to_string()),\n            _ => text.push(a.clone()),\n        }\n    }\n    let data_dir = data_dir.ok_or(\"missing <data-dir>\")?;\n    let payload: Vec<u8> = if from_stdin {\n        let mut buf = Vec::new();\n        std::io::stdin().read_to_end(&mut buf).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n        buf\n    } else {\n        text.join(\" \").into_bytes()\n    };\n\n    let (store, report) =\n        LogStore::open_dir(&data_dir, None).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    if report.truncated_tail {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"recovery: discarded {} torn tail bytes from segment {}\",\n            report.truncated_bytes,\n            report.truncated_segment.unwrap_or(0)\n        );\n    }\n    let seq = store.append(&payload).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    println!(\"{seq}\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn cmd_read(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut data_dir = None;\n    let mut seq = None;\n    let mut hex = false;\n    for a in args {\n        match a.as_str() {\n            \"--hex\" => hex = true,\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") && data_dir.is_none() => data_dir = Some(other.to_string()),\n            other if !other.starts_with(\"--\") &&
